The evaluation results reveal that there is a substantial gap between current agents and human performance. Furthermore, our diagnosis of state-of-the-art VLM-driven agents reveals that memory management is one of the bottlenecks, where raw multimodal history introduces noise that hinders decision quality. Motivated by this finding, we design MeMento, a preference-conditioned multimodal memory compressor that selectively compresses decision-relevant information from long-horizon history based on user preferences with a fixed set of memory tokens. Experiments show that MeMento helps VLM-driven agents improve accuracy by 7.18%, while reducing memory usage by 85.38% compared to the strongest baseline.

</details>


### [139] [VGER: Voxel-Guided Global Event Ranking for Event Cloud Attribution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01470)
*Youxin Jiang,Baoheng Fu,Hongwei Ren,Xiangqian Wu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出VGER（Voxel-Guided Global Event Ranking），一种训练无关的归因框架，用于基于点的事件云网络。VGER结合事件级梯度证据与任务感知的体素扰动证据，将区域贡献转化为事件级归因分数，并引入统一的事件排序策略。在三个事件基准、三种骨干网络（PointNet、PointNet++、EventMamba）共九种设置下，VGER在高尾和低尾删除任务上均优于点级显著性基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 事件相机产生稀疏异步事件流，虽然基于事件点的模型性能出色，但缺乏对预测背后事件级证据的可解释性。现有的点级显著性方法虽然能提供细粒度归因，却忽略了事件特有的时空结构，因此需要一种能够同时捕捉事件时空结构并提供细粒度归因的解释方法。

Method: VGER框架包含三个核心组件：(1) 事件级梯度证据：直接从事件点获取细粒度梯度信息；(2) 任务感知的体素扰动证据：通过体素级别的扰动评估区域贡献；(3) 统一的排序融合策略：将体素区域的贡献转化为事件级归因分数，对事件进行全局排序，高排名事件为预测关键事件，低排名事件对预测影响有限。整个框架无需额外训练。

Result: 在三个事件基准数据集上与PointNet、PointNet++和EventMamba三种骨干网络组合的九种设置上，VGER在高尾和低尾删除性能两方面均一致优于点级显著性基线方法。

Conclusion: VGER通过融合事件级梯度证据与体素扰动证据，有效弥补了点级显著性方法忽略事件时空结构的问题，在多种事件云网络上实现了更优的归因性能，为事件相机模型的透明度与可靠性提供了有力支撑。

Abstract: Event cameras produce sparse and asynchronous event streams that provide rich spatio-temporal information for efficient perception. Recent advances in event-based models have demonstrated strong performance by directly modeling asynchronous events without dense frame reconstruction. However, identifying the event-level evidence behind their predictions is crucial for improving model transparency and reliability. Directly adapting point-level saliency methods from point clouds provides fine-grained attribution but overlooks event-specific spatio-temporal structures. To address this limitation, we propose Voxel-Guided Global Event Ranking (VGER), a training-free attribution framework for point-based event cloud networks. VGER combines event-level gradient evidence with task-aware voxel perturbation evidence, transferring regional contribution into event-level attribution scores while preserving fine-grained resolution. Furthermore, VGER introduces a unified event ranking strategy, where high-ranked events are expected to be prediction-critical and low-ranked events are expected to have limited influence on predictions. We evaluate VGER on three event-based benchmarks with PointNet, PointNet++, and EventMamba. Across nine dataset-backbone settings, VGER consistently improves both high-tail and low-tail deletion performance over point-level saliency baselines.

</details>


### [140] [Slot2Text: Object-Centric Visual Tokenization for Efficient and Spatially Traceable Surgical MLLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01473)
*Guiqiu Liao,Matjaz Jogan,Daniel A. Hashimoto*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出Slot2Text，一种双模式手术多模态大语言模型（MLLM），通过将密集视觉特征压缩为少量slot潜在表示（仅47个token，相比基线1,295个token减少96.4%）来替代传统密集视觉token注入方案，同时提供快速问答（Slot2Text-Fast）和可追踪空间推理（Slot2Text-Reason）两种模式，在保持与SOTA基线竞争力的情况下将总token消耗平均降低91.8%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有外科场景理解的多模态大语言模型需要将数百个密集视觉token注入语言模型，导致推理成本高昂，且生成的答案缺乏空间可追溯性。作者希望以更紧凑的视觉表示替代密集token，在降低计算开销的同时保留空间定位能力。

Method: Slot2Text采用双模式设计：(1) 通过自监督视觉特征分组将视觉输入编码为少量区域slot潜在表示，并以区域标记的视觉token形式供语言模型消费；(2) Slot2Text-Fast使用slot前缀直接回答手术问题；(3) Slot2Text-Reason在推理过程中识别并定位相关区域，将语言输出与对应的slot token、掩码或区域相关联，实现可追踪的空间证据。方法不依赖视觉编码器与语言的对比对齐。

Result: 在多个视觉问答和视觉定位基准上，Slot2Text-Fast与SOTA基线性能相当但成本显著更低：平均总token消耗减少91.8%，视觉前缀从1,295个token降至47个（即96.4%的降幅）。Slot2Text-Reason以额外token和延迟为代价，提供明确的区域身份、位置和可追踪的空间证据。

Conclusion: 紧凑的slot潜在表示可作为外科MLLM的高效默认视觉接口，当需要更强的空间可追溯性时可调用基于接地（grounded）的推理模式。这为外科场景中多模态语言模型的可扩展、低成本部署提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLM) for surgical scene understanding typically inject hundreds of dense visual tokens into a language model, leading to costly inference and limited spatial traceability for generated answers. We present Slot2Text, a dual-mode surgical MLLM that replaces dense representations of visual input with a compact set of regions encoded as slot latents. Instead of relying on contrastive alignment of the visual encoder with language, Slot2Text groups self-supervised vision features into a few regions--slots that are consumed by the language model as area-labeled visual tokens. Slot2Text-Fast uses the slot prefix to answer surgical questions. Slot2Text-Reason also identifies and locates areas relevant for reasoning, linking language outputs to corresponding slot tokens, masks or regions. Experiments on multiple visual question answering and visual grounding benchmarks show that Slot2Text-Fast is competitive with state-of-the-art baseline at a much lower cost, reducing the average total token consumption by a 91.8\% and the visual prefix from 1,295 to 47 tokens (a 96.4\% reduction). Slot2Text-Reason trades additional tokens and latency for explicit area identities, locations, and traceable spatial evidence. These results establish compact slot latents as an efficient default visual interface for surgical MLLMs, with grounded reasoning invoked when greater spatial traceability is required.

</details>


### [141] [Towards Compact Unified Multimodal Tracking: Synergizing Knowledge Distillation with Structural Pruning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01488)
*Yuqi Li,Yuedong Tan,Huiran Duan,Weilun Feng,Chuanguang Yang,Zhulin An,Zongwei Wu,Shiping Wen,Tingwen Huang,Yingli Tian*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文针对多模态目标跟踪模型在边缘设备上推理开销大的问题，提出双对齐蒸馏（Dual-Alignment Distillation）框架，通过轻量化解码器架构并结合空间表征对齐（特征蒸馏）与语义分布对齐（logit蒸馏）两种互补的知识迁移流，在保持高精度的同时实现实时推理，在RGBT234上达到91.5% MPR和54 FPS，比教师模型快5倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 统一多模态目标跟踪（如RGB-T、RGB-D）虽凭借多传感器互补数据获得了显著鲁棒性，但最先进模型的巨大计算负担阻碍了其在资源受限的边缘设备上的部署。现有工作多聚焦于特征提取网络的轻量化，而忽略了预测头（decoder）这一关键的效率瓶颈，导致学生模型与教师模型之间存在能力差距。

Method: 首先通过策略性地精简解码器架构实现实时推理，但由此引入轻量学生与重型教师之间的能力鸿沟。为解决这一问题，作者系统分析了17种蒸馏策略，并提出了双对齐蒸馏框架，将知识迁移解耦为两条互补流：(1) 空间表征对齐（Spatial Representation Alignment）：采用特征蒸馏，强化学生对前景目标的空间关注，解决"跟踪哪里"的问题；(2) 语义分布对齐（Semantic Distribution Alignment）：利用logit蒸馏对齐决策边界并迁移判别性暗知识，解决"跟踪什么"的问题。

Result: 在五个基准数据集上的大量实验表明，该方法显著优于复杂的现有最先进方法。蒸馏后的模型在RGBT234上达到91.5% MPR，在单张RTX 4090上运行速度为54 FPS，相比教师模型实现了5倍加速，同时保持了更高的精度。

Conclusion: 预测头是高效多模态跟踪中被忽视的瓶颈环节，通过双对齐蒸馏（特征蒸馏+logit蒸馏）对知识进行解耦迁移，可以在大幅压缩模型的同时超越复杂SOTA方法，实现精度与速度的共赢，为多模态目标跟踪在边缘设备上的实时部署提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Unified multimodal object tracking has achieved remarkable robustness by leveraging complementary sensor data (e.g., RGB, Thermal, Depth), yet the heavy computational burden of state-of-the-art models hinders their deployment on resource-constrained edge devices. In this work, we identify the prediction head as a critical but often overlooked efficiency bottleneck. By strategically streamlining the decoder architecture, we unlock the potential for real-time inference but simultaneously introduce a capacity gap between the lightweight student and the heavy teacher. To resolve this, we conduct a systematic analysis of 17 distillation strategies and introduce a Dual-Alignment Distillation framework. Our key insight is that effective compression requires decoupling knowledge transfer into two complementary streams: (1) Spatial Representation Alignment, which employs feature distillation to sharpen the student's spatial focus on foreground targets ("Where to track"); and (2) Semantic Distribution Alignment, which utilizes logit-based distillation to align decision boundaries and transfer discriminative dark knowledge ("What to track"). Extensive experiments across five benchmarks demonstrate that our approach significantly outperforms complex state-of-the-art methods. Notably, our distilled model achieves 91.5% MPR on RGBT234 and operates at 54 FPS on a single RTX 4090, representing a 5x speedup over the teacher model while maintaining superior accuracy.

</details>


### [142] [GaussianSelector: Lightweight Human-Guided Object Selection in 3D Gaussian Splatting with Graph Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01492)
*Baihan Yang,Tiexin Li,Yuheng Liu,Xin Lin,Xinke Li,Xiaohui Xie,Truong Nguyen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: GaussianSelector是一个无需训练的交互式3D物体选择框架，它直接操作原生高斯图元，通过将稠密高斯粗化成超点并构建连续性加权图，利用稀疏用户的scribble指导通过可见性感知的透射覆盖率提升到3D空间，最终以全局图割能量最小化实现完整的3D物体选择，支持多轮交互优化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的3DGS-based物体选择方法要么需要重训练以嵌入逐对象标签，要么需要构建密集的多视角SAM观测，两者都要求高计算开销和密集视角覆盖，而这在实际场景编辑中往往难以获得。作者旨在用最少用户交互从稀疏视角下完成3D物体选择。

Method: 1) 将稠密高斯粗化为几何一致的超级点(superpoints)；2) 利用外观和空间线索构建连续性加权图；3) 通过可见性感知的透射覆盖率将稀疏用户scribbles提升至3D；4) 将选择问题建模为全局图割(graph-cut)能量最小化，从稀疏证据传播到完整3D物体；5) 支持多轮细化，用户可从额外视角迭代纠正选择。

Result: 实验表明，GaussianSelector在分割质量上与基于多视角SAM的最先进方法相当，但所需的交互视角显著更少，计算开销大幅降低。

Conclusion: GaussianSelector为真实世界的人机协同3D场景编辑和3D资产提取提供了实用解决方案，在保持竞争力的同时大幅降低了交互成本和计算负担。

Abstract: Selecting a complete 3D object from a reconstructed scene with minimal user effort is essential for practical scene editing and embodied interaction. Existing 3DGS-based methods either retrain the Gaussian representation to embed per-object labels, or build dense multi-view SAM observations, both requiring heavy computation and dense viewpoint coverage that is rarely available in practice. We present GaussianSelector, a training-free framework for interactive 3D object selection from sparse views and sparse scribble guidance. Operating directly on native Gaussian primitives, we coarsen dense Gaussians into geometrically coherent superpoints and construct a continuity-weighted graph using appearance and spatial cues. Sparse user scribbles are lifted into 3D via visibility-aware transmittance coverage, and selection is solved as a global graph-cut energy minimization that propagates sparse evidence to a complete 3D object. This design naturally supports multi-round refinement, where users iteratively correct the selection from additional viewpoints to progressively improve the result. Experiments demonstrate that GaussianSelector achieves competitive selection quality against state-of-the-art multi-view SAM-based methods, while requiring significantly fewer interaction views and substantially lower computational overhead. These properties make it well suited for human-in-the-loop 3D scene editing and 3D asset extraction in real-world deployment scenarios.

</details>


### [143] [Probing the 3D Object-Level Understanding of Pre-Trained Detection Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01495)
*Robin Kim,Colin Samplawski,Benjamin M. Marlin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文研究了2D检测transformer模型（如DETR及其扩展）的对象级嵌入中是否包含3D物体属性信息。通过线性和非线性探针，作者发现这些模型尽管没有3D监督预训练，却能惊人地编码物体的深度和相对于摄像机的3D位置等信息。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 先前工作表明DETR等2D检测模型能够学习丰富的对象级嵌入表示，但这些嵌入中是否隐含着3D空间信息尚不清楚。探明这一点有助于理解2D检测模型的表征能力，并可能为3D感知任务提供无需额外监督的特征来源。

Method: 作者使用预训练的2D检测transformer模型（DETR及其变体），提取对象级嵌入，并分别用线性探针和非线性探针来预测物体的深度以及相对于摄像机的3D位置等属性，以评估嵌入中编码的3D信息量。

Result: 在多种检测transformer模型上，实验结果表明2D DETR模型的对象级嵌入能够以令人惊讶的强度表征物体的3D属性信息，包括深度和3D位置，尽管模型在预训练过程中完全没有接受过3D监督。

Conclusion: 该发现揭示了一个此前未知的能力：2D检测transformer的嵌入表示中蕴含丰富的3D几何信息，这为利用2D预训练模型促进3D感知任务提供了新的可能性，同时也引发了对2D模型中3D信息来源与形成机制的进一步思考。

Abstract: Detection transformer models, including DETR and its extensions, learn to output a set of object-level embeddings that can be simultaneously decoded into 2D bounding boxes and class distributions. In this paper, we investigate what pre-trained 2D detection transformers understand about the 3D properties of objects. Specifically, we investigate the extent to which properties including the depth of objects from the camera and the 3D location of objects relative to the camera can be recovered from object-level embeddings using linear and non-linear probes. Across a range of detection transformer models, our results show a surprisingly strong and previously unknown ability of 2D DETR models to represent useful information about the 3D properties of objects, despite the complete lack of 3D supervision during model pre-training.

</details>


### [144] [Rolling Shutter Camera Self-Calibration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01509)
*Yongcong Zhang,Navid Rabbani,Bangyan Liao,Chengbo Wang,Yizhen Lao,Adrien Bartoli*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出首个无需标定靶的卷帘快门（RS）相机自标定方法，直接从图像序列中估计相机内参和读出时间比，通过统一双投影模型（dual-projection model）在捆绑调整中同时约束行相关时间戳和参考时间戳，实现更强的几何与时间一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 卷帘快门相机在消费设备中广泛使用，但其逐行曝光在运动下产生畸变，使得3D视觉问题同时依赖相机内参和读出时间比。现有RS标定方法依赖标定靶或专用硬件，限制了在无约束环境下的应用，因此需要一种无需标定目标的自标定方法。

Method: 提出一种自标定捆绑调整（BA）方法，结合两种互补的RS成像模型：(1) 连续时间轨迹估计下的行向位姿表示模型；(2) 将RS图像解释为时间畸变的全局快门（GS）图像并需估计校正场的模型。两者的组合形成统一的dual-projection模型，每个3D点在共享连续轨迹上同时在行相关时间戳和参考时间戳处受到约束，增强几何和时间一致性。

Result: 通过大量仿真实验分析了多种实现在不同条件下的适用性，并在真实数据实验中验证了方法的准确性、鲁棒性和实际有效性。

Conclusion: 本文提出的RS相机自标定方法不依赖任何标定靶或专用硬件，能够直接从图像序列中联合估计相机内参和读出时间比，为无约束场景下的RS相机几何标定提供了实用且有效的解决方案。

Abstract: Rolling shutter (RS) cameras are widely used in consumer devices, but their row-wise exposure causes distortions under motion, making geometric 3D vision problems dependent on both camera intrinsics and readout time ratio. Existing RS calibration methods rely on calibration targets or specialised hardware, limiting their use in unconstrained settings. We present the first self-calibration method for RS cameras that directly estimates camera intrinsics and the readout time ratio from image sequences, without requiring calibration targets. The method is implemented as a self-calibrating bundle adjustment (BA), which critically depends on the RS imaging model. We combine two known complementary models. The first formulates RS imaging as continuous-time trajectory estimation under a row-wise pose representation. The second interprets RS images as temporally distorted global shutter (GS) images and requires to estimate correction fields. The combination is non-trivial and results in a unified dual-projection model, in which each 3D point is simultaneously constrained at both row-dependent and reference timestamps along a shared continuous trajectory, enforcing stronger geometric and temporal consistency. Extensive simulations analyse the applicability of several implementations under varying conditions, and real data experiments demonstrate the accuracy, robustness, and practical effectiveness of the proposed approach.

</details>


### [145] [UCBound-Net: Uncertainty-Guided Boundary-Aware Continual Learning for Domain-Incremental Ultrasound Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01518)
*Mohammad Amanour Rahman*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出UCBound-Net，一个利用MC Dropout不确定性作为空间遗忘风险代理的持续分割框架，通过不确定性加权边界蒸馏、不确定性校准正则化和不确定性引导的样本选择三个组件，在乳腺超声到甲状腺超声的序列域增量学习基准上将BWT从-0.173改善至-0.098，平均DSC达0.755。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床影像持续学习面临双重挑战：既要学习新解剖领域知识，又要保持先前任务表征。现有缓解策略（正则化、知识蒸馏）对所有空间区域一视同仁，忽略了预测不确定性与遗忘倾向之间的强相关性。

Method: 提出三个协同组件：(i) 不确定性加权边界蒸馏，在冻结教师网络的高熵区域放大知识迁移信号；(ii) 不确定性校准正则化，显式惩罚过度自信的错误预测；(iii) 不确定性引导的样本选择，优先存储边界区域预测熵最高的样本到记忆缓冲区。

Result: 在乳腺超声(BUSI, Task 1)到甲状腺超声(TN3K, Task 2)的序列域增量基准上，相比朴素微调将BWT从-0.173改善至-0.098，两任务平均DSC达0.755，且无需任务边界监督。消融实验证明每个组件对遗忘缓解均有独立贡献。

Conclusion: UCBound-Net提供了一个实用的不确定性感知持续学习路径，用于临床图像分割，通过将空间不确定性信息集成到蒸馏、正则化和样本选择三个维度，有效缓解灾难性遗忘，且无需任务边界监督。

Abstract: Continual learning in clinical imaging faces a dual challenge: a model must assimilate knowledge from new anatomical domains while retaining representations learned from prior tasks, a problem known as catastrophic forgetting. Existing mitigation strategies, including regularization and knowledge distillation, treat all spatial regions equally, ignoring the fact that prediction uncertainty is strongly correlated with the propensity for forgetting. We introduce UCBound-Net, a continual segmentation framework that exploits Monte Carlo (MC) Dropout uncertainty as a spatial proxy for forgetting risk. Our method contributes three synergistic components: (i) uncertainty-weighted boundary distillation, which amplifies the knowledge transfer signal at high-entropy regions of the frozen teacher; (ii) uncertainty-calibration regularization, which explicitly penalizes overconfident erroneous predictions; and (iii) uncertainty-guided exemplar selection, a memory buffer that preferentially stores samples whose boundary regions exhibit the highest predictive entropy. Evaluated on a sequential domain-incremental benchmark comprising breast ultrasound (BUSI, Task 1) followed by thyroid ultrasound (TN3K, Task 2), UCBound-Net reduces forgetting relative to naive fine-tuning, achieving a backward transfer (BWT) of -0.098 compared with -0.173, while obtaining an average Dice Similarity Coefficient (DSC) of 0.755 across both tasks. The proposed framework outperforms baseline methods without requiring task-boundary supervision. An ablation study further demonstrates that each component contributes independently to forgetting mitigation, providing a practical pathway toward uncertainty-aware continual learning for clinical image segmentation.

</details>


### [146] [ST-LoRA: Single Trajectory LoRA Ensemble for Uncertainty Aware Agricultural Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01530)
*Mohamed Farag,Genc Hoxha,Yahia Maleki,Chris McCool,Ribana Roscher*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出ST-LoRA，一种参数高效的集成框架，通过将低秩适配（LoRA）与快照集成结合，从单一训练轨迹构建多样化的集成成员，在农业语义分割任务上以不到10%的可训练参数达到或超越全秩集成的分割精度与校准性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数字农业中的可靠决策支持需要准确的预测和良好的不确定性估计，尤其在语义分割等密集预测任务中。集成方法虽然提供强不确定性量化，但计算和内存开销大；而单模型近似方法常在不确定性质量与效率之间妥协。需要一种兼顾效率与不确定性质量的解决方案。

Method: ST-LoRA将低秩适配（LoRA）与快照集成（Snapshot Ensembling）结合：所有集成成员共享冻结的预训练骨干网络，仅在轻量级低秩适配器上有所不同，将可训练参数降至全模型的10%以下，同时保持集成的多样性。在GrowliFlower-L（花椰菜）和BUP20（甜椒）两个农业数据集上，使用SegFormer和Mask2Former架构进行评估，涵盖分布内性能、分布漂移下的校准以及分布外检测。

Result: 消融实验表明，对于密集预测任务，前馈层（feed-forward layers）而非注意力层是LoRA的关键目标，这与语言模型中仅关注注意力的惯例相反。ST-LoRA在分割精度和校准性能上匹配或超越全秩集成，同时大幅降低训练时间、推理延迟、内存占用和存储需求。相比于Snapshot Ensemble、MC Dropout和Deep Deterministic Uncertainty等高效基线，ST-LoRA在图像/像素级分布外检测、漂移下的校准稳定性以及跨种子的方差等方面一致地匹配或超越它们，且参数和计算量更少。

Conclusion: LoRA高效集成适配是面向不确定性感知农业视觉系统的一种高度有效且实用的方法，为资源受限环境下实现可靠的不确定性量化提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Reliable decision-support in digital agriculture requires accurate predictions and well-calibrated uncertainty estimates, particularly for dense prediction tasks such as semantic segmentation. Ensemble methods provide strong uncertainty quantification, but their computational and memory demands limit practical use, while single-model approximations often trade off uncertainty quality for efficiency. We propose ST-LoRA, a parameter-efficient ensemble framework that builds diverse ensemble members from a single training trajectory by combining Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) with snapshot ensembling. Each member shares a frozen pretrained backbone and differs only in lightweight low-rank adapters, reducing trainable parameters to under 10% of the full model while preserving ensemble diversity. We evaluate across two agricultural datasets - GrowliFlower-L (cauliflower, open field) and BUP20 (sweet pepper, glasshouse) - using SegFormer and Mask2Former, covering in-distribution performance, calibration under distribution shift, and out-of-distribution detection. Ablations show feed-forward layers, not attention layers, are the critical LoRA target for dense prediction, contrary to the attention-only convention from language models. ST-LoRA matches or exceeds full-rank ensembles in segmentation accuracy and calibration across both datasets and architectures, while substantially reducing training time, inference latency, memory footprint, and storage requirements. Against efficient baselines - Snapshot Ensemble, MC Dropout, and Deep Deterministic Uncertainty - ST-LoRA consistently matches or outperforms them in image/pixel-level OoD detection, calibration stability under shift, and cross-seed variance, with far fewer parameters and lower compute. These results show LoRA-efficient ensemble adaptation is a highly effective, practical approach for uncertainty-aware agricultural vision systems.

</details>


### [147] [Recursive Vision Language Models for General Symbolic Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01534)
*Omid Nejati Manzari,Guillaume Lajoie,Hassan Rivaz*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出R-Qwen递归推理框架，基于预训练Qwen主干模型，通过程序化自递归与深度监督反复细化候选解决方案，并结合分层监督加权（HSW）技术加速收敛，在八个符号推理基准上超越现有递归推理模型和更大的LLM。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM在符号推理任务（如数独、迷宫寻路、ARC）上表现受限，因其固定深度的自回归推理缺乏系统性搜索、细化和回溯能力。现有递归模型（HRM、TRM）虽能通过迭代潜状态细化解决问题，但通常是任务特化的，无法利用预训练语言先验。

Method: R-Qwen基于预训练Qwen主干构建递归推理框架，通过程序化自递归和深度监督反复细化候选解决方案。同时将分层监督加权（HSW）适配到自回归模型，在递归步骤间对损失进行指数加权，降低梯度方差（至少50%）、提升随机梯度信噪比并加速收敛。

Result: 在八个挑战性基准上，R-Qwen以可比的训练参数量 consistently 超越先前的递归推理模型和显著更大的LLM。在ARC-AGI数据集上较基线提升27.6%，验证了递归细化对通用符号推理的有效性。

Conclusion: 递归推理机制与预训练语言模型先验是互补的，二者结合可有效提升符号谜题求解能力。代码和模型将在论文接收后发布。

Abstract: Hard symbolic-reasoning tasks such as Sudoku, maze pathfinding, and ARC remain challenging for LLMs due to their fixed-depth autoregressive reasoning, which limits systematic search, refinement, and backtracking. While recursive models such as Hierarchical Reasoning Model (HRM) and Tiny Recursive Model (TRM) address this limitation through iterative latent-state refinement, they are typically task-specific and do not leverage pretrained language priors. We propose R-Qwen, a recursive reasoning framework built upon a pretrained Qwen backbone. R-Qwen repeatedly refines a candidate solution through programmatic self-recursion and deep supervision, combining the structured iterative computation of recursive models with the linguistic and reasoning priors of pretrained LLMs. We further adapt Hierarchical Supervision Weighting (HSW) to autoregressive models by exponentially weighting losses across recursive steps. HSW reduces gradient variance by at least 50\%, improves the signal-to-noise ratio of stochastic gradients, and accelerates convergence. Across eight challenging benchmarks, R-Qwen consistently outperforms prior recursive reasoning models and substantially larger LLMs while using a comparable number of trainable parameters. Notably, on ARC-AGI dataset, our model achieves a 27.6\% improvement over the baseline, highlighting the effectiveness of recursive refinement for general symbolic reasoning. These results suggest that recursive reasoning mechanisms and pretrained language model priors are complementary approaches for improving symbolic puzzle-solving. Code and models will be released after acceptance.

</details>


### [148] [STAR-VLM: Spatiotemporal Grounding Vision-Language Models for Motion and Velocity Estimation via Automotive Radar Supervision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01535)
*Pou-Chun Kung,Aryaman Rao,Utkrisht Sahai,Hemanth Murali,Yi Liu,Rui-Yu Lin,Katherine A. Skinner*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: STAR-VLM是一种利用车载雷达监督信号增强视觉语言模型时空推理与度量级速度估计能力的框架，通过雷达的距离和多普勒测量作为无标签监督，在运动分类和度量速度估计任务上达到SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有提升VLM时空推理能力的方法依赖复杂的预处理流程、昂贵的人工标注或合成数据，限制了可扩展性并引入sim-to-real差距；同时现有方法缺乏对动态场景的度量级推理能力（如以真实世界单位估计物体运动）。虽然已有基于LiDAR的度量深度监督提升空间感知的工作，但未直接解决时间推理问题。

Method: STAR-VLM采用车载雷达作为监督信号源。雷达是低成本、广泛部署的传感器，通过距离（range）和多普勒（Doppler）测量提供互补的时空监督。在训练过程中，将这些测量作为无标签的真实值（label-free ground truth），以提升VLM的度量级时空推理能力。

Result: 在驾驶场景实验中，STAR-VLM在运动分类和度量速度估计两项任务上均达到SOTA性能，甚至超越了专门为各任务设计的任务特定方法。

Conclusion: 车载雷达是一种可扩展且成本效益高的监督来源，可用于构建面向真实世界自动驾驶的、具备度量感知能力的时空VLM。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) are emerging as a key component of embodied intelligence, with growing applications in auto-labeling and end-to-end autonomous driving. However, existing approaches for improving spatiotemporal reasoning in VLMs often rely on complex preprocessing pipelines, expensive human annotations, or synthetic data, which limit scalability and introduce potential sim-to-real gaps. Moreover, although these methods have improved spatiotemporal understanding, they still lack strong metric reasoning capabilities for dynamic scenes, such as estimating object motion in real-world units. Prior work has explored LiDAR-based metric depth supervision to enhance spatial perception, but it does not directly address temporal reasoning. We introduce STAR-VLM, an automotive radar-supervised framework that enhances spatiotemporal VLMs with motion reasoning and metric velocity estimation for autonomous driving. Automotive radar is a low-cost and widely deployed sensor that provides complementary spatiotemporal supervision through range and Doppler measurements. By leveraging these measurements as label-free ground truth during training, STAR-VLM improves the metric spatiotemporal reasoning ability of VLMs. Through experiments on driving scenarios, we show that STAR-VLM achieves state-of-the-art performance on both motion classification and metric velocity estimation, outperforming even task-specific methods designed for each task. These results highlight automotive radar as a scalable and cost-effective source of supervision for building metric-aware spatiotemporal VLMs for real-world autonomous driving.

</details>


### [149] [Enhancing Visual Perception in Foggy Conditions via Multiclass Fog Density Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01572)
*Mohamad Mofeed Chaar,Galia Weidl*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文研究了自动驾驶在浓雾条件下的感知问题，通过生成合成雾数据（基于Waymo数据集，使用迭代学习方法生成深度图像），按五种雾浓度级别分别训练专用感知模型，而非统一模型。结果显示在极重雾条件下，每类专用模型的召回率从0.076提升至0.232（绝对提升15.6个百分点），表明多专用模型策略优于单一通用模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动驾驶系统虽有显著进展，但在恶劣天气（尤其是浓雾）下的鲁棒感知仍是重大挑战，现有方法通常训练单一统一模型应对所有条件，在严重雾况下性能退化严重。

Method: 使用迭代学习方法生成深度图像以支持雾模拟，基于Waymo数据集合成五种雾密度级别（清晰、轻雾、中雾、重雾、极重雾）的数据，并为每个雾密度级别分别训练独立的感知模型，而非训练单一统一模型。

Result: 在极重雾类别中，密度专用训练的召回率从0.076提升至0.232，绝对增益为15.6个百分点，表明雾密度专用训练在严重雾况下显著优于统一模型。

Conclusion: 部署多个雾密度专用模型而非单一通用模型，可提升自动驾驶车辆在挑战性可见度条件下的感知鲁棒性；未来将扩展到LiDAR和雷达等多传感模态，并评估在更多样天气场景中的泛化能力。

Abstract: Autonomous driving (AD) systems have advanced rapidly over the past decade; however, robust perception under adverse weather conditions remains a major challenge, particularly in dense fog. In this work, we investigate fog-aware perception using synthetically generated fog data derived from the Waymo dataset. To support fog simulation, depth images are generated using an iterative learning approach. We consider five fog-density levels: clear, light fog, moderate fog, heavy fog, and very heavy fog. Instead of training a single unified model across all conditions, we train separate perception models for each fog-density level. Experimental results show that density-specific training improves performance in severe fog conditions. In particular, for the very heavy fog class, recall improves from 0.076 to 0.232, corresponding to an absolute gain of 15.6 percentage points. These findings suggest that deploying multiple specialized models, rather than a single general-purpose model, can improve perception robustness for autonomous vehicles under challenging visibility conditions. Future work will extend this strategy to additional sensing modalities, including LiDAR and radar, and evaluate generalization across diverse weather scenarios.

</details>


### [150] [D^2-4DGS: Dual-Depth Guided Sparse-Camera 4D Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01588)
*Jijian Zhao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出D²-4DGS，一种利用双源深度先验（单目深度与多视角几何深度）引导的稀疏相机动态4D高斯泼溅框架，通过一致性验证、修剪、致密化和RGB-D联合优化，在9种数据集-视角设置下均取得最优PSNR，平均比最佳竞争方法高1.33 dB。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有动态4D高斯泼溅方法需要密集多视角视频提供足够的几何约束，导致采集成本高、稀疏相机部署受限。减少输入视角会削弱几何监督，引发结构缺失和漂浮高斯。单一深度来源无法同时兼顾密集覆盖与几何可靠性：单目深度密集但尺度模糊且有局部偏差；多视角几何深度与重建坐标系一致但覆盖不完整。

Method: 提出D²-4DGS框架：(1) 将单目深度估计与有效的多视角几何深度对齐，并通过一致性验证识别可靠的几何锚点；(2) 利用验证后的锚点进行一致性感知的修剪和深度监督；(3) 结合验证的几何深度与对齐后的单目深度估计，为欠重建区域提供候选几何以支持致密化；(4) 采用RGB-D联合优化，在稀疏视角监督下提升外观保真度和几何一致性。

Result: 在全部9种数据集-视角组合下，D²-4DGS均取得最高PSNR，每种设置下平均比最佳竞争方法提升1.33 dB。

Conclusion: 通过融合并验证互补的双源深度先验，D²-4DGS有效克服了稀疏相机下几何监督不足的问题，显著提升了动态新视角合成的质量和鲁棒性。

Abstract: Dynamic 4D Gaussian Splatting has emerged as an efficient representation for dynamic novel view synthesis through explicit scene modeling and real-time rendering. However, existing methods typically require dense multi-view videos for sufficient geometric constraints, making capture expensive and limiting sparse-camera deployment. Reducing input views lowers acquisition cost but weakens geometry supervision, often causing missing structures and floating Gaussians. Depth priors provide geometric cues, yet no single source offers both dense coverage and reliable geometry. Monocular depth provides dense structure but is scale-ambiguous and locally biased, whereas multi-view geometric depth provides incomplete anchors consistent with the reconstruction coordinate system. To exploit their complementarity, we propose D$^2$-4DGS, a sparse-camera dynamic 4D Gaussian Splatting framework guided by dual-source depth priors. We align monocular estimates with valid multi-view geometric depths and verify their consistency to identify reliable geometric anchors. These verified anchors support consistency-aware pruning and depth supervision, while verified geometric depths and aligned mono-only estimates provide candidate geometry for densification in under-reconstructed regions. Finally, RGB-D joint optimization improves appearance fidelity and geometric consistency under sparse-view supervision. Across all nine dataset--view settings, D$^2$-4DGS achieves the highest PSNR, improving by 1.33 dB on average over the best competing method in each setting.

</details>


### [151] [When Measurement Conventions Masquerade as Calibration Gains in Cardiac Digital Twins](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01602)
*Dang P. M. Cao,Hieu Pham*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文研究心脏数字孪生中的射血分数（EF）测量偏倚问题，指出相位条件化并未真正消除CAMUS基线偏倚；通过匹配参考分析发现单平面金标准EF误差在不同模型间无统计差异，而单平面金标准EF比CAMUS双平面临床EF高6.30分，这解释了几乎所有基线偏倚。作者提出了"约定感知EF审计"协议，区分真正的观测算子校准与测量伪影。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有心脏数字孪生校准研究常假设固定的参考约定，忽略了EF测量的参考标准（如单平面 vs 双平面、不同心尖切面）对结果的影响，导致将测量约定的差异误判为观测算子校准的成败。

Method: 跨四个共享骨干的超声EF前端进行相位条件化对比；采用匹配参考分析（matched-reference analysis）；用单平面金标准EF与CAMUS双平面临床EF进行对照；预设EchoNet-Dynamic复制实验并发布数据；结合共形残差宽度预算和EF分层变化，构建"约定感知EF审计"协议。

Result: 相位条件化看似移除CAMUS基线偏倚，但匹配参考分析拒绝该增益：各模型单平面金标准EF误差统计上无差异；单平面金标准EF超出CAMUS双平面临床EF 6.30分，几乎全部解释基线偏倚。EchoNet-Dynamic复制实验移除基线高估并逆转CAMUS排名。

Conclusion: 此前归因于观测算子校准的EF改进很可能是测量参考约定差异所致；应采用约定感知的审计协议，将真正的物理校准与测量伪影分离。

Abstract: Cardiac digital twins convert clinical images into physiological measurements through observation operators, yet calibration studies often assume a fixed reference convention. Across four shared-backbone echocardiographic EF front-ends, phase conditioning appears to remove CAMUS baseline bias. Matched-reference analysis rejects this gain: singleplane ground-truth EF error is statistically indistinguishable across models, while single-plane ground-truth EF exceeds CAMUS biplane clinical EF by +6.30 points, explaining nearly all baseline bias. A prespecified EchoNet-Dynamic replication, with released data and our extractor aligned to the apical four-chamber plane, removes baseline overestimation and reverses the CAMUS ranking. We also quantify haemodynamic effects, conformal residual-width budgets, and EF-stratum changes, yielding a Convention-Aware EF Audit protocol that separates genuine observation operator calibration from measurement artefacts. GitHub: EjectionFraction-Bias-in-Cardiac-Digital-Twin.git

</details>


### [152] [Linear Multi-Timescale Retention as a Memory-Efficient Vision-Language Bridge](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01614)
*Ashfak Yeafi,Mehedi Hasan,Md Khairul Islam*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出线性多时间尺度记忆（LIA-MTR）模块，一种内存高效的多模态桥接机制，通过ELU正特征映射、自适应写门控与对数线性递归衰减，将视觉序列压缩为有界记忆状态，实现严格的O(N)序列交互复杂度，在262,144个视觉patch上仅需11.2GB显存，并在MME基准上超越MLP基线（71.00% vs 68.11%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉语言模型（VLM）在处理高分辨率图像时面临Softmax多头注意力（MHA）的O(N²)内存复杂度瓶颈。虽然用独立MLP替代MHA可达到O(N)缩放，但会失去空间序列路由能力，严重损害全局场景理解与物体持久性。需要一种既能保持线性复杂度又能保留序列路由能力的解决方案。

Method: LIA-MTR的核心设计包括：(1) ELU-based正特征映射；(2) 自适应写门控（write-gating）；(3) 对数线性分布的递归衰减机制。这些组件协同将连续视觉序列数学上压缩为有界记忆状态，实现严格的O(N)序列交互复杂度。

Result: 合成检索实验中，LIA-MTR在16,000 token上完美路由上下文，消除了朴素线性注意力的"Lost in the Middle"退化。硬件基准测试显示原生处理262,144视觉patch仅需11.2GB显存，而标准MHA在16,384 patch即内存溢出。指令微调后MME基准达到71.00% vs MLP基线68.11%，物体持久性提升10个百分点。

Conclusion: LIA-MTR为无限上下文视觉语言集成提供了数学上严谨、计算复杂度平坦的基础，在保持线性内存缩放的同时恢复了序列路由能力，实现了全局场景理解与物体持久性的显著提升。

Abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) face a critical computational bottleneck when processing high-resolution imagery due to the $O(N^2)$ memory complexity of Softmax Multi-Head Attention (MHA). While substituting MHA with independent Multi-Layer Perceptrons (MLPs) achieves $O(N)$ scaling, it strips the architecture of spatial sequence routing, severely degrading global scene understanding and object permanence. In this paper, we propose the Linear Multi-Timescale Retention (LIA-MTR) module, a memory-efficient cross-modal bridge. By integrating an ELU-based positive feature mapping with adaptive write-gating and log-linearly distributed recurrent decays, LIA-MTR mathematically compresses continuous visual sequences into bounded memory states. Theoretical analysis proves the architecture operates with strict $O(N)$ sequence-interaction complexity. Empirically, synthetic retrieval evaluations demonstrate that LIA-MTR flawlessly routes context across 16,000 tokens, eliminating the "Lost in the Middle" degradation typical of naive linear attention. Hardware benchmarking reveals infinite-context scaling capabilities, natively processing 262,144 visual patches within an 11.2 GB VRAM footprint, whereas standard MHA suffers out-of-memory failure at 16,384 patches. Furthermore, following instruction tuning on 665K conversational samples, LIA-MTR significantly outperforms an industry-standard MLP baseline on the MME benchmark (71.00% vs. 68.11%), driven by a 10% absolute improvement in object permanence and superior global semantic extraction. This work establishes a mathematically rigorous, computationally flat foundation for infinite-context Vision-Language integration.

</details>


### [153] [Motion Beyond Morphology: Bootstrapping Cross-Category Motion Transfer from Abstract Motion Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01628)
*Zhixue Fang,Zhimin Zhang,Bi'an Du,Zijie Meng,Yan Zhou,Wei Hu,Guoxin Zhang,Pengfei Wan,Kun Gai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出"超越形态的运动"视角，通过两阶段框架（多粒度抽象运动学习+直接条件生成）实现跨形态、跨类别的视频运动迁移，并发布OpenVMT数据集与基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频运动迁移方法依赖固定结构对应（如关键点、姿态），当参考对象与目标对象在形态、关节结构或形变机制上差异显著时，结构对应关系不再成立，导致运动迁移失效。因此需要超越固定结构对应的运动迁移范式。

Method: 两阶段框架：Stage I 学习多粒度互补的抽象运动视图，并利用其引导生成跨类别视频对，保留不同形态间可迁移的动态信息；Stage II 将监督信号内化为直接以参考视频为条件的生成式模型，推理时无需显式运动提取。同时构建OpenVMT-Dataset与OpenVMT-Bench，支持图像/文本条件运动迁移在Same、Near、Far类别差距下的训练与评测。

Result: 在OpenVMT-Bench上相比现有方法取得SOTA运动保真度与目标保持效果，实验覆盖同类别、近类别与远类别三种迁移难度。

Conclusion: 通过抽象多粒度运动表示与直接条件生成相结合，可以实现跨形态差异的运动迁移，为超越结构对应的运动理解开辟了新路径。代码、数据与基准将开源。

Abstract: Video motion transfer aims to animate a target object using dynamics from a reference video. Existing formulations largely rely on fixed structural correspondence, which becomes ill-defined when reference and target objects differ substantially in morphology, articulation, or deformation mechanisms. We introduce Motion Beyond Morphology, a perspective that seeks to transfer motion beyond fixed structural correspondence, by preserving dynamics that remain meaningful across different target morphologies. To realize this, we propose a two-stage framework. Stage~I learns complementary multi-granularity abstract motion views and uses them to bootstrap cross-category video pairs that preserve transferable dynamics across diverse morphologies. Stage~II internalizes this supervision into direct reference-video-conditioned generation, removing the need for explicit motion extraction at inference. We further introduce OpenVMT-Dataset and OpenVMT-Bench for training and evaluating image- and text-conditioned motion transfer across Same, Near, and Far category gaps, and plan to release both upon acceptance. Extensive experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art motion fidelity and target preservation. Project page: https://miniz233.github.io/MotionBeyondMorphology/

</details>


### [154] [Mitigating Visual Degradation in MLLMs via Spatial-Spectral Visual Anchor Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01635)
*Qianlong Yang,Bowen Ye,Xianda Guo,Yanlun Peng,Wenke Huang,Hongyuan Zhang,Yulei Jia*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出SSVAL（空间-频谱视觉锚点学习）方法来解决多模态大语言模型（MLLM）在视觉指令微调后内部表示发生漂移、导致视觉信息退化的问题。其核心是视觉锚点提示注入（VAPI），通过引入从外部视觉基础模型（VFM）学习的提示作为稳定视觉锚点来缓解推理时的表示偏差，并辅以空间域和频域表示对齐损失提供中层视觉监督，实验显示该方法显著优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态大语言模型在视觉指令微调后，内部表示会在推理过程中迅速偏离原始语义状态，导致严重的视觉信息退化。已有方法尝试利用外部视觉基础模型对齐内部表示，但研究发现直接对齐虽然增强了视觉语义，却无法缓解表示偏差问题，因此需要新的解决方案。

Method: 提出SSVAL方法，包含两个核心组件：(1) 视觉锚点提示注入（VAPI），在训练阶段引入能吸收外部视觉基础模型丰富知识的提示，使其作为稳定视觉锚点在推理时缓解表示偏差；(2) 辅助的空间域和频域表示对齐损失，在LLM中间层提供互补的视觉特定监督。

Result: 大量实验表明SSVAL在多种任务上显著优于现有方法，验证了其在缓解视觉表示偏差、增强视觉语义理解方面的有效性。

Conclusion: SSVAL通过视觉锚点提示注入与空间-频谱对齐损失相结合，有效解决了MLLM推理时内部视觉表示漂移的问题，为多模态大语言模型的视觉感知能力提升提供了一条新路径。

Abstract: Despite the progress of multimodal large language models (MLLMs), they continue to exhibit deficiencies in visual perception. Following visual instruction tuning, internal MLLM representations rapidly deviate from their original semantic states during inference, causing severe information degradation. While existing methods attempt to leverage external vision foundation models (VFMs) to align internal representations, we find that direct alignment with VFMs enhances visual semantics but fails to mitigate representation deviation. To address this, we propose Spatial-Spectral Visual Anchor Learning (SSVAL). The core of SSVAL is Visual Anchor Prompt Injection (VAPI), which introduces prompts that absorb rich knowledge from external VFMs during training, enabling them to serve as stable visual anchors that mitigate representation deviation during inference. Additionally, we incorporate auxiliary spatial and frequency-domain representation alignment losses to provide complementary vision-specific supervision at intermediate LLM layers. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SSVAL significantly outperforms existing methods. Code are available on our \href{https://msls38.github.io/SSVAL/}{project page}.

</details>


### [155] [Dynamic Resolution Routing for Efficient Egocentric Grounding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01638)
*Huixin Sun,Wangbo Zhao,Fanyue Wei,Qiuxia Lin,Pengzhan Sun,Angela Yao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出SmartRes框架，在像素空间中通过动态分辨率路由实现自我中心视觉接地任务的高效推理，减少67%视觉token并保留86.4%全分辨率性能，推理速度提升1.66倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自我中心视觉接地需要高分辨率输入来定位小物体，但多模态大语言模型在此领域面临视觉token处理成本过高的问题。现有的基于token缩减的高效策略无法可靠地选择以物体为中心的空间证据。

Method: SmartRes框架在像素空间进行效率优化，通过动态分辨率路由实现。具体包括：1) 先编码低分辨率视图获取全局上下文；2) 使用轻量级路由器激活物体中心区域的高分辨率补丁，构建保序的视觉序列；3) 引入边缘正则化的路由目标，增加前景-背景logit分离度并提升前景召回率，以应对严重的前景-背景不平衡问题。

Result: 在Ego4D和EgoIntention数据集上的实验表明，SmartRes可减少高达67%的视觉token，同时保留86.4%的全分辨率性能，推理速度比最先进的token缩减方法快1.66倍且准确率更高。在小物体接地任务上表现强劲。

Conclusion: SmartRes通过像素空间的动态分辨率路由有效解决了自我中心视觉接地中的效率与精度权衡问题，特别在定位小物体方面展现出优越性能，为自我中心应用提供了高效且可靠的解决方案。

Abstract: Egocentric visual grounding requires high-resolution inputs to localize small objects. However, scaling Multimodal Large Language Models to this domain is constrained by the excessive cost of visual token processing. We identify that current efficient strategies based on token reduction are unreliable for selecting object-centric spatial evidence. To overcome this, we propose SmartRes, a framework that performs efficiency optimization in the pixel space via dynamic resolution routing. SmartRes first encodes a low-resolution view for global context and uses a lightweight router to activate high-resolution patches in object-centric regions and constructs an order-preserving visual sequence. To further enable robust routing under severe foreground-background imbalance, we introduce a margin-regularized routing objective that increases foreground-background logit separation and improves foreground recall. Experiments on Ego4D and EgoIntention show that SmartRes reduces visual tokens by up to 67% while retaining 86.4% of full-resolution performance, and achieves up to 1.66X faster inference than state-of-the-art token reduction methods with higher accuracy. Furthermore, strong performance on small object grounding indicates the effectiveness of SmartRes towards egocentric applications. Code will be publicly available.

</details>


### [156] [StreamTalk: Streaming Co-Speech Gesture Generation with Key-Pose Anchoring](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01643)
*Xiangyue Zhang,Jianfang Li,Jiaxu Zhang,Kaixing Yang,Steven Hoi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: StreamTalk是一个用于实时共语音手势生成的闭环框架，通过"生成-检索-细化"周期不断为每个片段锚定尾部关键姿态，有效抑制了开放性（开环）流式方法中长期累积的漂移问题，在BEAT2上达到SOTA FGD并支持76 FPS的实时运行。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的流式共语音手势生成方法采用开环架构，每个片段仅依赖过去上下文生成，模型无法自我检查或纠正轨迹，导致小误差随长序列累积而漂移。作者观察到这种失败主要源于缺乏前向约束（即对末端姿态的锚定），而非短片段本身质量不佳。

Method: 提出StreamTalk闭环框架，包含周期性"生成-检索-细化"循环：1) 流式姿态引导生成模块先预测粗略片段；2) 从说话人专属动作数据库中检索一个合理的尾部姿态作为目标锚点；3) 利用该姿态对片段进行细化后再进入下一窗口。训练阶段采用随机锚点掩码（Stochastic Anchor Masking），随机掩盖姿态与平移帧以训练模型从稀疏边界条件恢复完整动作；另外，部分感知DiT（part-aware DiT）将手部、身体和平移流分离，降低全局位移与局部关节运动之间的干扰。

Result: 在BEAT2基准上，StreamTalk在FGD指标上达到最先进水平，显著降低了相对于开环基线的长时程漂移，并以76 FPS的速度实时运行。

Conclusion: StreamTalk通过引入闭环的姿态锚定约束和检索-细化机制，有效解决了流式手势生成中的累积漂移问题，验证了"前向约束缺失是漂移主因"这一观察，实现了高质量与实时性的兼顾。

Abstract: Real-time co-speech gesture generation must produce 3D motion clip by clip as speech arrives. Existing streaming methods are open-loop: each clip depends on past context, but the model cannot check or correct its trajectory. Small errors therefore accumulate and cause drift over long sequences. We observe that this failure is mainly caused by the lack of a forward constraint rather than poor short-clip quality. A plausible key pose at the end of each clip provides a destination anchor that limits drift. Based on this observation, we propose StreamTalk, a closed-loop framework with a periodic generate-retrieve-refine cycle. Streaming Pose-Guided Generation first predicts a coarse clip, retrieves a plausible tail pose from a speaker-specific motion database, and refines the clip using this pose before continuing to the next window. During training, Stochastic Anchor Masking randomly masks pose and translation frames, teaching the model to recover complete motion from sparse boundary conditions. A part-aware DiT separates hand, body, and translation streams to reduce interference between global displacement and local articulation. On BEAT2, StreamTalk achieves state-of-the-art FGD, reduces long-horizon drift relative to open-loop baselines, and runs in real time at 76 FPS. Project page: https://xiangyue-zhang.github.io/StreamTalk/.

</details>


### [157] [CRAFT: Compression via Recursive Adaptive Fusion of Video Tokens for Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01644)
*Yu Chen,Xiaohong Li,Xiaole Wang,Jianjin Zhang,Jun Sun,Yafeng Deng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: CRAFT提出了一种名为"递归自适应视频令牌融合"的视频令牌压缩方法，通过将无参数令牌选择与可学习的令牌融合解耦，在高效压缩视频令牌的同时保留关键细节，在约8倍压缩率下保留了骨干网络约97%的平均准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频理解中，视觉-语言模型需要处理大量视觉令牌，导致预填充阶段的计算和内存成本急剧上升。现有令牌压缩方法存在两难：启发式免训练方法缺乏内容自适应性，而引入额外模块的方法需要昂贵的对齐训练，效率与自适应性之间的权衡尚未解决。

Method: CRAFT通过递归合并令牌来实现压缩，核心思路是解耦参数无关的令牌选择与可学习的令牌融合。具体而言，使用全局相似度决定哪些令牌需要合并；同时引入位置感知加权模块和内容自适应通道门控来学习如何融合令牌。整个压缩流程与查询无关（query-agnostic）。由于每个保留的令牌都是原始令牌的线性组合，因此保持了真实时空坐标，并与预训练语言模型的输入分布保持一致。

Result: 在多个代表性视频基准上的实验表明，CRAFT一致优于先前的SOTA令牌压缩方法。在约8倍压缩率下，保留了骨干网络约97%的平均准确率，同时展现了显著的效率提升。

Conclusion: CRAFT通过将令牌选择与令牌融合解耦，有效解决了令牌压缩中效率与自适应性之间的权衡问题，在保持高压缩率的同时最大限度地保留了关键视频信息，为视频理解中的令牌压缩提供了一种更优方案。

Abstract: In video understanding, vision-language models (VLMs) must ingest massive numbers of visual tokens, causing the computational and memory cost of the prefill stage to rise sharply. Such visual sequences are highly redundant along the spatio-temporal dimension, yet a high compression ratio is often accompanied by the loss of critical details. Existing token-compression methods either employ heuristic, training-free compression with limited content adaptivity or introduce additional modules that require expensive alignment training, leaving the trade-off between efficiency and adaptivity unresolved. To alleviate this limitation, we propose CRAFT: Compression via Recursive Adaptive Fusion of Video Tokens. CRAFT recursively merges tokens by decoupling parameter-free token selection from learnable token fusion: global similarity determines which tokens to merge, while a position-aware weighting module and a content-adaptive channel-wise gate learn how to fuse them. The whole compression pipeline is query-agnostic. Because every retained token is a linear combination of the original tokens, CRAFT preserves their true spatio-temporal coordinates and stays aligned with the pre-trained language model's input distribution. Experiments on multiple representative video benchmarks show that CRAFT consistently outperforms prior state-of-the-art token-compression methods. At about $8\times$ compression, it retains roughly $97\%$ of the backbone's average accuracy and shows significant efficiency improvement.

</details>


### [158] [StreamSplat: Streaming Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01659)
*Changhao Song,Yuxuan Wang,Qibiao Li,Youcheng Cai,Ligang Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: StreamSplat是一个流式前馈3D高斯溅射框架，通过Voxel-Aligned Causal Cache（VACC）增量维护持久化的场景状态，支持在线顺序输入视图的因果式新颖视角合成，在长输入流（256/512/1024视图）下显著优于固定视图基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有前馈3DGS方法假设固定的上下文视图集合并联合处理，无法适应在线场景中视图按顺序到达且需要因果更新的需求。作者旨在解决这一限制，使前馈3DGS能够处理流式输入。

Method: StreamSplat包含三个核心组件：1) Voxel-Aligned Causal Cache（VACC）——在内存受限的体素结构中存储历史3D token，使内存随场景几何而非流长度增长；2) History-Projected Depth Anchoring（HPDA）——将缓存几何投影为深度引导，用于当前成本体估计；3) Cache-Guided Feature Injection（CGFI）——将缓存潜在证据注入到高斯token回归中。

Result: 在DL3DV、RealEstate10K和ScanNet数据集上，StreamSplat在稀疏因果输入下与最先进的前馈3DGS方法保持竞争力。在256、512和1024视图的长流场景中，基线方法内存溢出而StreamSplat仍能工作，并随更多观测到达持续提升新颖视角合成质量。

Conclusion: StreamSplat证明了流式前馈3DGS的可行性，通过几何感知的因果缓存机制实现了无需未来视图或全场景上下文的高质量长流新颖视角合成，为在线3D重建提供了新范式。

Abstract: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting enables efficient novel-view synthesis without per-scene optimization, but most existing methods assume a fixed set of context views and process them jointly. This limits their applicability to online scenarios where calibrated views arrive sequentially and the scene must be updated causally. We present \emph{StreamSplat}, a streaming feed-forward 3DGS framework that incrementally maintains a persistent geometry-grounded scene state and decodes it into renderable 3D Gaussians after each input chunk. StreamSplat centers on a \textbf{Voxel-Aligned Causal Cache (VACC)}, which stores historical 3D tokens in a memory-bounded voxel structure so that memory grows with explored scene geometry rather than stream length. To better reuse history during causal prediction, we introduce \textbf{History-Projected Depth Anchoring (HPDA)} to project cached geometry as depth guidance for current cost-volume estimation, and \textbf{Cache-Guided Feature Injection (CGFI)} to inject cached latent evidence into Gaussian-token regression. Experiments on DL3DV, RealEstate10K, and ScanNet show that StreamSplat remains competitive with state-of-the-art feed-forward 3DGS methods under sparse causal inputs, despite not using future views or full-scene context. More importantly, it scales to long input streams with 256, 512, and 1024 views where fixed-view baselines run out of memory, yielding sustained improvements in novel-view synthesis quality as more observations arrive. The code will be made publicly available upon acceptance.

</details>


### [159] [Ground, Cover, and Refine: Evidence-Centric Frame Selection for Long-Video Question Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01660)
*Fan Wei,Siru Zhong,Runmin Dong,Miao Yang,Zhaoyang Luo,Haohuan Fu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出GCR，一种免训练的固定预算长视频问答证据筛选框架，通过Ground（将时间戳文本转为时序事件并渲染到对齐帧）、Cover（补充视觉锚点并应用全局最大边际相关性保持多样性）、Refine（回访被遗漏的时间区域，用证据价值更高的真实帧中位数替换最弱上下文帧）三个步骤实现联合证据策展，在LongVideoBench和Video-MME上以7B LLaVA-OV和32帧达到64.25%和62.15%准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有长视频问答方法存在两个关键局限：一是单次查询感知选帧会在局部相关性峰值附近聚类，预算耗尽后遗漏的证据无法恢复；二是文本证据与视觉证据对齐薄弱。这些问题导致固定视觉标记预算下无法有效识别稀疏但关键的视频证据。

Method: GCR由三个阶段组成：(1) Ground将带时间戳的文本转换为时序事件，选择查询相关的真实帧锚点，并将每个事件文本渲染到其时间对齐的帧上；(2) Cover用直接视觉锚点补充已接地事件以获取互补视觉证据，并应用全局最大边际相关性（global MMR）保持多样化的上下文；(3) Refine重新审视被遗漏的时间区域，仅当真实帧中位数（real-frame medoid）具有更高证据价值时，才用它替换最弱的可修订上下文帧。GCR保持固定数量且按时间顺序排列的帧，无需VLM训练或架构修改。

Result: 在LongVideoBench和Video-MME上，使用三个7B主干模型以及8、32、64帧预算进行实验，GCR在长视频问答上取得一致改进。以7B LLaVA-OV为主干、32帧预算时，在两个基准上分别达到64.25%和62.15%，超过最强复现基线2.54和1.93个百分点。

Conclusion: GCR通过将固定预算帧选择建模为联合证据策展问题，有效解决了现有方法中选帧聚簇和文本-视觉证据弱对齐的问题，在多个主干和预算下均实现长视频问答性能提升，且训练免费、无需架构改动。

Abstract: Long-video question answering requires identifying sparse yet critical evidence from videos containing thousands of frames under a constrained visual-token budget. Existing methods either select query-aware frames in a single pass or rely on timestamped text solely as retrieval guidance, leading to two key limitations. First, selected frames tend to cluster around local relevance peaks, and once the budget is exhausted, omitted evidence cannot be recovered. Second, textual and visual evidence remain weakly aligned. We propose GCR, a training-free framework that casts fixed-budget frame selection as a joint evidence curation problem. Ground converts timestamped text into temporal events, selects query-relevant real frame anchors, and renders each event text onto its temporally aligned frame. Cover supplements grounded events with direct visual anchors for complementary visual evidence and applies global maximal marginal relevance to preserve diverse context. Refine revisits omitted temporal regions and replaces the weakest revisable context frame with a real-frame medoid---but only when the medoid offers greater evidence value. GCR maintains a fixed number of chronologically ordered frames and requires no VLM training or architectural modification. Experiments on LongVideoBench and Video-MME, across three 7B backbones and frame budgets of 8, 32, and 64, demonstrate consistent improvements in long-video QA. With the 7B LLaVA-OV backbone and 32 frames, GCR achieves 64.25% and 62.15% on the two benchmarks, outperforming the strongest reproduced baselines by 2.54 and 1.93 percentage points, respectively.

</details>


### [160] [Enriched text-guided variational multimodal knowledge distillation network (VMD) for automated diagnosis of plaque vulnerability in 3D carotid artery MRI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.11924)
*Bo Cao,Fan Yu,Mengmeng Feng,SenHao Zhang,Xin Meng,Yue Zhang,Zhen Qian,Jie Lu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于变分推理和多模态知识蒸馏（VMD）的策略，利用放射科医生的领域知识来自动诊断颈动脉斑块易损性，从而提升对未标注3D MRI图像的诊断准确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态学习在有效利用不同模态数据特征方面具有重要意义。从颈动脉3D MRI图像直接诊断动脉粥样硬化斑块易损性对放射科医生和传统3D视觉网络都较为困难。临床实践中，放射科医生通过结合多种影像模态和领域专业知识进行多模态评估，这为构建多模态诊断网络提供了思路，但现有方法难以充分利用有限的图像标注和放射学报告中的跨模态先验知识。

Method: 开发了一种VMD（Variation inference and Multimodal knowledge Distillation）策略，通过变分推理和多模态知识蒸馏，从训练数据中有限的图像标注和放射学报告中提取跨模态先验知识，用于自动化诊断颈动脉斑块易损性。

Result: 在自建数据集上进行了深入实验，验证了VMD策略的有效性，增强了未标注3D MRI图像的诊断网络准确性。

Conclusion: VMD方法能够有效利用多模态信息中的领域知识，提升颈动脉斑块易损性诊断的自动化水平，为临床辅助诊断提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Multimodal learning has attracted much attention in recent years due to its ability to effectively utilize data features from a variety of different modalities. Diagnosing the vulnerability of atherosclerotic plaques directly from carotid 3D MRI images is relatively challenging for both radiologists and conventional 3D vision networks. In clinical practice, radiologists assess patient conditions using a multimodal approach that incorporates various imaging modalities and domain-specific expertise, paving the way for the creation of multimodal diagnostic networks. In this paper, we have developed an effective strategy to leverage radiologists' domain knowledge to automate the diagnosis of carotid plaque vulnerability through Variation inference and Multimodal knowledge Distillation (VMD). This method excels in harnessing cross-modality prior knowledge from limited image annotations and radiology reports within training data, thereby enhancing the diagnostic network's accuracy for unannotated 3D MRI images. We conducted in-depth experiments on the dataset collected in-house and verified the effectiveness of the VMD strategy we proposed.

</details>


### [161] [FairForensics: Seeing Expressions and Parsing Demographics via Vision-Language Modeling for Generalizable Fair Deepfake Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01661)
*Yaning Zhang,Jiao Wu,Zan Gao,Linlin Shen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了FairForensics，一个基于视觉语言模型的公平深度伪造检测方法，通过构建人口学平衡的基准数据集以及结合表情感知视觉编码器和人口学感知公平正则化，实现了在未见伪造类型上更好的泛化能力和跨人口群体的公平性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有公平深度伪造检测方法在两个关键问题上表现不佳：对未见过的伪造操作的泛化能力差，以及对不同人口统计群体的公平性不足。这些方法通常在人口统计不平衡的数据分布上开发和评估，导致对少数群体的预测存在偏差。

Method: FairForensics包含两个核心模块：(1) 人脸伪造泛化增强：利用原始和伪造表情向量间的分布差异构建表情编码器来捕获高层表情引导的伪造模式，并通过身份感知补丁扰动模块的表情感知视觉编码器整合全局外观和表情伪造特征以缓解身份偏差；(2) 人口感知公平正则化：提出人口引导的语言编码器提取群体感知的全局语言嵌入，通过视觉-语言对齐促进伪造特征与人口信息的解耦，并设计群体感知原型公平目标函数同时实现跨子群的类间可分离性和类内对齐。此外，构建了人口统计平衡的FDD基准数据集用于训练和评估。

Result: 在人口统计平衡基准上的大量实验表明，FairForensics在泛化能力和公平性方面均达到了最先进水平。

Conclusion: 通过人口统计平衡的基准构建和视觉语言模型的设计，FairForensics同时在未见伪造泛化和人口公平性两个维度上取得了显著提升，为公平深度伪造检测提供了新范式。

Abstract: The challenge of fair deepfake detection (FDD) has attracted increasing attention. Existing fairness-enhanced detectors often suffer from suboptimal generalization to unseen manipulations and fairness across demographic groups. They are typically developed and evaluated on demographically imbalanced distributions, resulting in biased predictions toward minority groups. In this paper, we construct a novel demographically balanced FDD benchmark to train and evaluate the fairness of detectors under both balanced and imbalanced population scenarios. Additionally, we introduce a novel expression and demographic perceptual vision-language model, termed FairForensics, for generalizable fair deepfake detection. FairForensics conducts face forgery generalization enhancement and demographic-aware fairness regularization. During face forgery generalization enhancement, built upon the novel observation of significant distribution differences between pristine and forged expression vectors, we design an expression encoder to capture high-level expression-guided forgery patterns, and an expression-perceptual visual encoder that integrates global appearance and expression forgery features while mitigating identity bias using an identity-aware patch perturbation module. Under demographic-aware fairness regularization, we propose a demographic-guided language encoder to extract population-aware global language embeddings, which boosts the decoupling of forgery features from demographic information via vision-language alignment. We devise a population-aware prototype fairness objective to enforce both inter-class separability and intra-class alignment across demographic subgroups. Extensive experiments on our balanced demographic benchmark show that our method achieves the state-of-the-art in terms of generalization and fairness.

</details>


### [162] [Posterior Variance Is a Constraint Map, Not an Error Map: Closed-Form Uncertainty for Radiative Gaussian Splatting in Sparse-View CT](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.13682)
*Chulin Zhao,Yiran Xu,Shu Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文系统性地审视了辐射高斯溅射（Radiative Gaussian Splatting）中基于逐高斯后验方差的体素级不确定性图。作者发现该不确定性本质上是数据约束图而非误差图：其告警可信但"全清"不可信。利用X射线渲染对逐高斯密度的严格线性性，推导出clamp-aware闭式解，可在单次前向传播中精确计算体积与投影空间的无限采样极限（较并发工作成本低约8倍）。在15场景基准上，该不确定性在14/15场景中成功对真实误差排序，但在物体内部（临床医生关注的组织）排序完全失效（中位Spearman 0.11，0/15通过），深度集成和严格正对数正态后验同样失败。机制是结构性的：约90%的体内误差是跨重训练复现的偏置，对模型分歧不可见；73-81%的全体积相关性由物体/背景对比度承载；精确可解的对照组表明观测到的体内排序比校准完美且具有相同sigma扩展的后验低4-5倍。此外，通过重参数化后验将跨场景温度散布从19.3倍压缩至2.6倍，单一场景无关温度可迁移到未见场景（10/15留一场景），修复后的尺度符合泊松预测的光子计数-1/2次幂规律。最后提出可捕获该幻觉的评估实践（掩码校准、种子级偏置分解、精确后验参照），并公开发布全部协议、种子和逐次运行证据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于辐射高斯溅射的稀疏视角CT重建不确定性图（逐后验方差）虽被广泛使用，但其实际含义缺乏严格验证。作者质疑这种不确定性图测量到的究竟是什么，尤其是它是否为可靠的误差指示器，以及在临床关键的物体内部区域是否仍有效。

Method: 1) 利用X射线渲染在逐高斯密度上的严格线性性，推导出clamp-aware闭式解，使不变栅格化器在单次前向传播中精确计算无限采样极限（体积与投影空间）。2) 在官方15场景基准上系统评估不确定性图的排序性能，区分全体积与物体内部区域。3) 比较三种不确定性构造（论文提出方法、深度集成、严格正对数正态后验）与两类估计器族。4) 通过种子级偏置分解、物体/背景对比度相关分析及精确可解的对照实验揭示失效机制。5) 通过重参数化后验压缩跨场景温度散布，实现场景无关温度迁移。

Result: 1) 提出的闭式解以约8倍更低的成本精确计算无限采样极限。2) 不确定性在全体积层面能在14/15场景中正确排序误差，但在物体内部完全失效（中位Spearman 0.11，0/15通过），三种构造和两类估计器族均失败。3) 揭示结构性机制：约90%体内误差为跨重训练复现的偏置，对模型分歧不可见；73-81%全体积相关性由物体/背景对比度承载；体内排序比完美校准后验的理论期望低4-5倍。4) 重参数化将跨场景温度散布从19.3x压缩至2.6x，场景无关温度在10/15留一场景实验中有迁移性，修复后的尺度符合泊松预测的-1/2次幂规律。

Conclusion: 后验方差不确定性图在全体积上看似有效，但实际上其相关性由物体/背景对比度承载，在临床关键的组织内部区域完全不可靠。不确定性尺度的失真属于可修复的工程问题（通过重参数化解决），但排序失效是结构性的方法论问题。作者提炼出掩码校准、种子级偏置分解和精确后验参照三种评估实践，可作为此类不确定性方法验证的标准协议。

Abstract: Radiative Gaussian splatting reconstructs sparse-view CT fast and accurately, and recent work attaches per-Gaussian posteriors to yield per-voxel uncertainty maps. We ask what such a map actually measures: posterior variance is a data-constraint map, not an error map -- its alarms are trustworthy, its all-clears are not. Exploiting the strict linearity of X-ray rendering in the per-Gaussian densities, we derive a clamp-aware closed form that the unchanged rasterizer evaluates exactly in one forward pass, in volume and projection space: the infinite-sample limit of the sampling estimator of concurrent work, at ~8x lower cost. On the official 15-scene benchmark this uncertainty ranks true error on 14 of 15 scenes. Restricted to the object interior -- the tissue a clinician reads -- the ranking collapses (median Spearman 0.11, 0/15 pass), identically for a deep ensemble and for a strictly positive log-normal posterior: three constructions, two estimator families, no survivors. The mechanism is structural: about 90% of in-object error is bias that reproduces across retrainings, invisible to model disagreement; 73-81% of the full-volume correlation is carried by object/surround contrast; and an exactly solvable control puts the observed in-object ranking 4-5x below what a perfectly calibrated posterior with the same sigma-spread would score. The error scale, by contrast, is an engineering problem, and we solve it: reparameterizing the posterior contracts the cross-scene temperature spread from 19.3x to 2.6x, one scene-agnostic temperature transfers to unseen scenes (10/15 leave-one-scene-out), and the repaired scale tracks photon count at the Poisson-predicted -1/2 power. We distill evaluation practice that would have caught the illusion -- masked calibration, seed-wise bias decomposition, an exact-posterior reference -- and release all protocols, seeds and per-run evidence.

</details>


### [163] [Few-Shot Concept Prompt Learning for Segmentation Foundation Models via Visual Grounding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01663)
*Rahul Venkataramani,Rachana Sathish*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出Few-Shot Concept Prompt Learning (FS-CPL)方法，通过学习连续概念提示嵌入（而非自然语言提示）来提升医学图像分割基础模型（SAM3和Medical SAM3）的性能。该方法仅需K个图像-掩码对的支持集，通过掩码监督学习提示嵌入，无需额外图像-文本数据或骨干网络重训练。在BUSI、HC18、TN3K、CVC-Clinic四个公开基准上，FS-CPL相比标准文本提示在Dice系数上最高提升+0.62，且与骨干网络无关，对基础SAM3和领域预训练的Medical SAM3均有效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 提示性分割基础模型（如SAM3、Medical SAM3）承诺通过自然语言接口实现少样本、交互式医学图像分割，但实际临床任务表现远低于预期。作者认为这种不足并非医学预训练不足或提示措辞不完善所致，而是结构性限制——在大多数临床模态中，配对图像-文本监督数据稀缺，这种限制将持续存在。进一步假设该限制仅针对自然语言作为控制信号，而直接从目标分布学习的视觉引导提示应能恢复丢失的性能。

Method: FS-CPL学习一个连续概念提示嵌入p*（维度T×d），从K个图像-掩码对的小支持集中通过掩码监督训练获得，编码器-解码器骨干网络保持冻结。该方法不依赖自然语言作为控制信号，而是通过视觉引导的连续提示嵌入来指导分割。

Result: 在四个公共基准（BUSI、HC18、TN3K、CVC-Clinic）上覆盖超声和内镜模态，FS-CPL相比标准文本提示实现Dice系数绝对值最高提升+0.62。方法具有骨干无关性：同时提升了vanilla SAM3和领域特化预训练的Medical SAM3的性能。

Conclusion: 视觉概念提示学习与领域内预训练是互补的，在图像-文本配对数据稀缺的临床场景下，用视觉引导的连续提示替代自然语言提示可以有效恢复分割基础模型的性能，为少样本医学图像分割提供了一条不依赖额外图像-文本数据的新路径。

Abstract: Promptable segmentation foundation models (FMs) such as SAM3 and Medical SAM3 promise few-shot, interactively-specified segmentation for medical imaging through a natural language interface, yet their performance on clinical tasks falls well short of this promise. We posit that this shortfall is not an artefact of insufficient medical pretraining or imperfect prompt phrasing, but a structural limitation that will persist in any domain where paired image-text supervision is scarce, as it is across most clinical modalities. We further hypothesize that the limitation is specific to natural language as a control signal: a visually grounded prompt, learned directly from the target distribution, should recover the lost performance without additional image-text data or backbone retraining. We propose Few-Shot Concept Prompt Learning (FS-CPL), which learns a continuous concept prompt embedding $\mathbf{p}^* \in \mathbb{R}^{T \times d}$ from a small support set of $K$ image--mask pairs via mask supervision, with the encoder-decoder backbone frozen. Across four public benchmarks spanning ultrasound and endoscopy (BUSI, HC18, TN3K, CVC-Clinic), FS-CPL delivers absolute Dice improvements of up to $+0.62$ over canonical text prompts and is \emph{backbone-agnostic}: it lifts both vanilla SAM3 and the domain-specifically pretrained Medical SAM3, showing that visual concept prompting is complementary to in-domain pretraining.

</details>


### [164] [FAU at ImageCLEF 2026 Task on Multimodal Reasoning Robust Candidate Scoring and Concise Multilingual Visual Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01664)
*Mohamed Basem,Vincent Christlein*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文介绍了ImageCLEF 2026多模态推理系统的设计方案，针对视觉多项选择问答（Visual MCQ）和视觉开放问答（Visual OpenQA）两个子任务。核心发现是输出控制比模型选择更重要：MCQ任务通过直接对候选标签进行VLM logits打分并结合分数融合与投票，取代了脆弱的自由文本生成；OpenQA任务则通过图像增强、简洁答案提示、确定性解码和针对性后处理来提升结果。在无任务特定训练的情况下，该系统在Visual MCQ上获得第三名（准确率0.7108），在Visual OpenQA上获得第一名（COMET 0.6488等指标），证明了推理工程（inference engineering）的实用价值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态推理挑战任务要求模型对包含密集文本、图表、公式和单位的多语言教育与科学图像进行可靠推理，并严格遵守答案格式。现有方法依赖脆弱的自由文本生成，难以保证输出格式的准确性和可靠性，因此需要探索通过推理工程手段而非任务特定训练来提升视觉语言模型在竞赛场景中的表现。

Method: 对于Visual MCQ子任务，采用候选标签直接打分策略，从视觉语言模型的logits中获取候选标签的得分，替代自由生成的方式，再通过分数融合和投票组合互补的多次运行结果。对于Visual OpenQA子任务，综合运用图像增强、简洁最终答案提示、确定性解码以及针对性后处理来移除推理痕迹与格式伪影。

Result: 官方提交在Visual MCQ子任务中获得第三名，准确率为0.7108；在Visual OpenQA子任务中获得第一名，COMET为0.6488、BLEU为0.1391、ROUGE L为0.2762、METEOR为0.2383。所有结果均未经过任务特定模型训练。

Conclusion: 研究表明，在无需任务特定训练的前提下，通过精心设计的推理工程——包括细致的打分、集成、提示和后处理——可以将强视觉语言模型转化为可靠的竞赛系统。输出控制的重要性不亚于模型选择本身。

Abstract: We present our ImageCLEF 2026 Multimodal Reasoning system for the Visual Multiple Choice Question Answering (Visual MCQ) and Visual Open Question Answering (Visual OpenQA) subtasks. The challenge requires reliable reasoning over multilingual educational and scientific images with dense text, diagrams, charts, tables, formulas, and units, while enforcing strict answer formats. Our central finding is that robust output control is as important as model choice. For Visual MCQ, we replace fragile free-form generation with direct candidate label scoring from vision-language model logits, then combine complementary runs through score fusion and voting. For Visual OpenQA, we use image enhancement, concise final answer prompting, deterministic decoding, and targeted post-processing to remove reasoning traces and formatting artifacts. Without task-specific model training, our official submissions achieved third place in Visual MCQ with 0.7108 accuracy and first place in Visual OpenQA with 0.6488 COMET, 0.1391 BLEU, 0.2762 ROUGE L, and 0.2383 METEOR. The results highlight the practical value of inference engineering: careful scoring, ensembling, prompting, and cleanup can turn strong VLMs into reliable competition systems.

</details>


### [165] [Generative Brownian Bridge Diffusion In Motion Space For Enhanced Myocardial Strain Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01677)
*Rishov Paul,Frederick H. Epstein,Miaomiao Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于布朗桥扩散模型的生成式方法，从常规采集的CMR序列中合成高质量的应变值，通过学习标准配准方法估计的运动与先进应变成像技术提供的精确运动之间的概率映射，并结合CMR图像作为条件约束，显著提高了标准CMR的应变分析精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的心肌应变分析技术要么依赖人工调整的后处理且区域精度欠佳，要么需要专门且昂贵的成像采集方案。作者希望利用生成模型的强大能力，从临床常规获取的CMR序列中合成高质量的运动应变值，从而降低临床部署成本和门槛。

Method: 提出了一种在运动空间中构建的布朗桥扩散模型，用于学习标准CMR运动（来自广泛采用的配准方法）与先进应变成像技术提供的高精度运动之间的概率映射。模型以对应的CMR图像作为条件，以促进生成过程中解剖结构的保真度。

Result: 在包含标准电影CMR和先进应变成像配对数据的大规模多中心CMR数据集上进行了验证，实验结果表明该框架相比现有基于学习的方法，在运动预测和应变分析的准确性上均有显著提升。

Conclusion: 该研究代表了一种新范式，有望开发出经济高效、可临床部署的心脏功能评估AI工具，在繁忙的临床工作流程中以更低的成本实现更高的应变分析精度。代码已公开。

Abstract: Myocardial strain analysis of cardiac magnetic resonance (CMR) images provides an important tool for evaluating cardiac function. However, current techniques require either human-adjusted post-processing with suboptimal regional accuracy, or specialized and costly imaging acquisitions. In this paper, we propose to leverage the power of generative models to synthesize high-quality motion-derived strain values from routinely acquired CMR sequences. Specifically, we develop a novel Brownian bridge diffusion model in motion space to learn the probabilistic mapping between standard CMR motion estimated from widely adopted registration methods and highly accurate motion provided by advanced strain imaging techniques. To promote the fidelity of anatomical structure in the generation process, our model is conditioned on the corresponding CMR images. We validate our method on large-scale multi-center CMR datasets including subjects of paired standard cine CMR and advanced strain imaging acquisitions. Experimental results demonstrate that our framework significantly improves the accuracy of motion prediction and strain analysis from standard CMRs compared to existing learning-based approaches. Our research represents a new paradigm for potentially developing cost-effective, clinically deployable AI tools for cardiac function assessment with enhanced strain accuracy in busy clinical workflows. Our code is publicly available at anonymous.4open.science/r/Brownian-Bridge-strain-analysis-1140.

</details>


### [166] [Generative AI and Foundation Models in Medical Image](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01686)
*Masahiro Oda*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文综述了生成式AI（特别是扩散模型和大型语言模型）在医学支持中的应用，并探讨了基础模型的构建方法及其在医疗领域的潜在应用，提出了利用国家数据和计算资源开发高性能医疗AI的路径。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式AI和基础模型的快速发展正在深刻改变医疗影像处理与AI开发范式，有必要系统梳理其技术原理、应用现状及未来发展方向，以指导医疗AI的进一步开发。

Method: 本文采用综述性研究方法，系统介绍图像生成AI中的扩散模型与文本生成AI中的大型语言模型（LLMs），阐述其技术原理，并引入其在医学支持任务中的具体应用案例；同时讨论基础模型的构建方法及其在医疗领域的应用，最后探讨如何利用国家数据和计算资源开发医疗基础模型。

Result: 本文提供了扩散模型和LLM在医疗支持中应用的全面概述，并梳理了基础模型的构造方法及其在医学领域的应用场景，提出了充分利用国家数据和计算资源开发医疗基础模型与高性能AI的战略方向。

Conclusion: 生成式AI与基础模型正推动医疗AI开发框架的根本性变革，通过有效整合国家层面的大规模数据和计算资源，有望构建出性能更优的医疗基础模型，从而为医学支持提供更强大的AI能力。

Abstract: In recent years, generative AI has attracted significant public attention, and its use has been rapidly expanding across a wide range of domains. From creative tasks such as text summarization, idea generation, and source code generation, to the streamlining of medical support tasks like diagnostic report generation and summarization, AI is now deeply involved in many areas. Today's breadth of AI applications is clearly distinct from what was seen before generative AI gained widespread recognition. Representative generative AI services include DALL-E 3 (OpenAI, California, USA) and Stable Diffusion (Stability AI, London, England, UK) for image generation, ChatGPT (OpenAI, California, USA), and Gemini (Google, California, USA) for text generation. The rise of generative AI has been influenced by advances in deep learning models and the scaling up of data, models, and computational resources based on the scaling laws. Moreover, the emergence of foundation models, which are trained on large-scale datasets and possess general-purpose knowledge applicable to various downstream tasks, is creating a new paradigm in AI development. These shifts brought about by generative AI and foundation models also profoundly impact medical image processing, fundamentally changing the framework for AI development in healthcare. This paper provides an overview of diffusion models used in image generation AI and large language models (LLMs) used in text generation AI, and introduces their applications in medical support. This paper also discusses foundation models, which are gaining attention alongside generative AI, including their construction methods and applications in the medical field. Finally, the paper explores how to develop foundation models and high-performance AI for medical support by fully utilizing national data and computational resources.

</details>


### [167] [Entity-Aware Sequence Transduction for Player-Centric Ball Action Spotting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01696)
*Ruifeng Wang,Di Yang,Jiangtao Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出多实体去噪序列转导（ME-DST）模型，用于球员中心的足球比赛事件检测。通过保留角色槽（role-slot）维度进行编码，使用时间注意力建模每个角色槽的历史轨迹、空间注意力跨角色槽交换信息，并加入可学习的角色嵌入、追踪战术特征及X3D-L和Swin3D-S的融合视觉预测，在FOOTPASS数据集上达到Micro F1 0.778，比最强官方TAAD+DST基线提升10.3个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有去噪序列转导（DST）基线将球员角色维度展平为帧级表示，削弱了对球员特定时间演化和球员间交互进行建模的归纳偏置，导致球员中心球类事件检测的精度受限。

Method: ME-DST在编码过程中保留角色槽维度：采用时间注意力建模每个角色槽的历史演化，空间注意力在每一帧上跨角色槽交换信息；同时引入可学习角色嵌入、基于追踪的战术特征，以及X3D-L和Swin3D-S双骨干网络的融合视觉预测。

Result: 在FOOTPASS数据集上，ME-DST达到Micro F1 0.778，较最强官方TAAD+DST基线提升10.3个百分点；消融实验表明保留实体轴和编码角色身份是性能提升的核心因素。

Conclusion: 显式实体建模是一种有效的归纳偏置，能够显著提升球员中心体育事件理解任务的性能。

Abstract: Player-centric ball action spotting requires temporally precise event detection together with actor attribution in crowded, partially observed multi-agent sports videos. Existing Denoising Sequence Transduction (DST) baselines treat the player-role dimension as part of a flattened frame-level representation, which weakens the inductive bias for modeling player-specific temporal evolution and inter-player interactions. To address this limitation, we propose Multi-Entity Denoising Sequence Transduction (ME-DST). ME-DST keeps the role-slot dimension throughout encoding. It uses temporal attention to model the history of each role slot, and spatial attention to exchange information across role slots at each frame. This factorized design gives the model a direct structure for separating within-player evolution from inter-player context. We also add learnable role embeddings, tracking-derived tactical features, and fused visual predictions from X3D-L and Swin3D-S. Experiments on the FOOTPASS dataset show that ME-DST reaches a Micro F1 of 0.778. This improves the strongest official TAAD+DST baseline by 10.3 percentage points. Controlled ablations show that preserving the entity axis and encoding role identity are central to this gain. These results suggest that explicit entity modeling is an effective inductive bias for player-centric sports event understanding.

</details>


### [168] [UniSim-SLAM: Feed-Forward SLAM with Unified Sim(3) Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01706)
*Inha Lee,Dongjae Jeong,Junhee Lee,Kyungdon Joo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: UniSim-SLAM 是一个集成的 SLAM 系统：前端采用轻量级两视图关键帧跟踪，后端周期性地进行多视图子图精化，通过统一的 Sim(3) 多层级因子图联合优化全局关键帧位姿和子图位姿，解决了几何基础模型在多视图推理中的尺度不一致与轨迹漂移问题，在未标定设置下达到业界最优精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近年来几何基础模型支持前馈式 SLAM 推理，但其预测强烈依赖于输入视图集合，导致在长序列中链接结果时出现几何不一致和轨迹漂移。此外，在线部署面临两视图跟踪的低延迟与多视图推理的约束丰富性之间的权衡问题。

Method: 提出 UniSim-SLAM 集成系统：前端运行轻量级两视图关键帧跟踪，后端进行周期性多视图子图精化。核心技术是在 Sim(3) 上构建统一的多层级因子图，联合优化全局关键帧位姿和子图位姿。因子图包含三类边：时间视图间里程计边、带深度统计尺度锚定的视图-子图桥接边、以及子图间绑定与尺度约束边，用于在异构局部坐标和尺度不一致的情况下强制执行一致的相似性关系。

Result: 在 TUM RGB-D 和 7-Scenes 数据集上，UniSim-SLAM 在未标定设置下实现了最先进的精度，相比此前最优结果，轨迹误差在 TUM RGB-D 上降低 38.5%，在 7-Scenes 上降低 45.9%。

Conclusion: UniSim-SLAM 通过 Sim(3) 统一因子图框架有效融合了前端两视图跟踪与后端多视图子图精化，解决了几何基础模型在长序列 SLAM 中的尺度不一致与漂移问题，显著提升了未标定场景下的轨迹精度。

Abstract: Recent geometric foundation models enable feed-forward inference for SLAM, but their predictions are strongly dependent on the input view set, which leads to geometric inconsistencies and trajectory drift when results are chained over long sequences. Online deployment further exposes a trade-off between the low latency of two-view tracking and the constraint richness of multi-view inference. We introduce UniSim-SLAM, an integrated system that runs lightweight two-view keyframe tracking in the frontend and performs periodic multi-view submap refinement in the backend. To combine predictions defined in heterogeneous local coordinates with inconsistent scales, we formulate a unified multi-level factor graph on $Sim(3)$ that jointly optimizes global keyframe poses and submap poses. The graph integrates temporal view-to-view odometry edges, view-to-submap bridge edges with depth-statistics scale anchoring, and submap-to-submap tie and scale constraints to enforce consistent similarity relations across submaps. Experiments on TUM RGB-D and 7-Scenes show that UniSim-SLAM achieves state-of-the-art accuracy in the uncalibrated setting, reducing trajectory error by $38.5\% $ on TUM RGB-D and $45.9\%$ on 7-Scenes compared to prior best results. Project page: https://vision3d-lab.github.io/unisim-slam/

</details>


### [169] [SpatialQuery: Benchmarking Geometry-Grounded Multi-Instance Spatial Reasoning in Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01709)
*Hai Nguyen,Tung Vu,Cong Tran*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出SPATIALQUERY，一个无需训练的框架，用于从单张RGB图像中进行最近实例空间距离查询（CIDQ）推理，并配套发布包含100万条问答对的SPATIALQUERY-1M基准数据集。该方法通过场景立方化（Scene Cubifying）将实例级度量几何转换为规范的鸟瞰视角表示，并结合不确定性感知思维链（UA-CoT）提示策略，在无微调的情况下显著优于各类基线模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉语言模型（VLMs）在语义理解上表现优异，但在度量空间推理方面并不可靠，特别是在需要比较同一物体类别多个实例的场景中。现有模型难以准确回答"到参考物体最近的候选实例及其距离"这类查询，因此需要一种专门针对最近实例距离查询的训练-free推理框架。

Method: SPATIALQUERY框架包含三大核心组件：（1）从单张RGB图像中恢复实例级度量几何；（2）通过场景立方化（Scene Cubifying）将几何信息转换为规范鸟瞰视角，将物体表示为统一大小、类别编码的方块以强调相对地面平面位置；（3）提出不确定性感知思维链（UA-CoT）提示，将逐实例的几何推导不确定性融入VLM推理过程。整个框架无需任务特定微调或架构修改。

Result: SPATIALQUERY配合Qwen3-VL-8B在CIDQ任务上取得Floor-MAE为0.259米，Unc-Acc@0.3m达到90.5%，邻近性决策准确率为84.18%，超越了微调的空间专家模型、通用VLM和闭源前沿模型。SPATIALQUERY-1M基准包含来自200个室内场景的超一百万条仅RGB问答对。

Conclusion: 该工作证明了通过几何提取与提示工程相结合，可以在不进行任务特定微调的情况下大幅提升VLM的度量空间推理能力，为提升VLM在空间智能方面的可靠性提供了一条高效路径。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) achieve strong semantic understanding but remain unreliable in metric spatial reasoning, particularly when queries require comparing multiple instances of the same object category. We study this problem through the Closest-Instance Distance Query (CIDQ), where a model must identify the nearest visible candidate to a unique reference object and estimate their gravity-aligned floor-plane distance. We introduce SPATIALQUERY, a training- free framework for CIDQ reasoning from a single RGB image, together with SPATIALQUERY-1M, a benchmark containing over one million RGB-only question-answer pairs from 200 indoor scenes. SPATIALQUERY recovers instance-level metric geometry and transforms it into a canonical Bird's-Eye View through Scene Cubifying, which represents objects as uniformly sized, category-coded blocks to emphasize their relative floor- plane locations. We further propose Uncertainty-Aware Chain-of-Thought (UA-CoT) prompting, which incorporates geometry- derived per-instance uncertainty into the VLM reasoning process. Without task-specific fine-tuning or architectural modification, SPATIALQUERY with Qwen3-VL-8B achieves a Floor-MAE of 0.259 m, an Unc-Acc@0.3 m of 90.5%, and a proximity-decision accuracy of 84.18%, outperforming fine-tuned spatial specialists, general-purpose VLMs, and closed-source frontier models. Code, benchmark resources, and an interactive demo are available at https://namhai1810.github.io/SpatialQuery/.

</details>


### [170] [STC-Net: Electroluminescence-Based Solar Cell Crack Segmentation for Power Loss Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01714)
*Shanaka Ramesh Gunasekara,Akila Eranda Devanarayana,Imasha Guruge,Nuwantha Fernando,Ehsan Asadi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出STC-Net，一种结合边缘先验、光谱先验和边界-拓扑细化模块的太阳能拓扑裂纹网络，用于光伏EL图像中的裂纹分割，并进一步扩展到功率损耗估计，在PVEL-S数据集上达到95.98 MIoU的训练精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 光伏电池EL图像中的裂纹缺陷具有细长、结构受限的特点，现有分割方法难以准确捕捉这类缺陷的连续性和边界，影响光伏可靠性分析的准确性。

Method: 提出STC-Net架构，包含三个核心组件：(1) 边缘先验用于增强裂纹边界信息；(2) 光谱先验用于利用EL图像的光谱特征；(3) 边界-拓扑细化模块用于改善裂纹连续性和边界保持。此外，通过从预测掩码推导与裂纹关联的非活性区域代理，将分割结果扩展到功率损耗估计。

Result: 在PVEL-S数据集上，STC-Net训练时达到95.98 MIoU、98.01 MDice和98.00 MAcc；在未见测试样本上达到72.52 MIoU和80.16 MDice。

Conclusion: STC-Net能够提供准确的裂纹定位，并在EL缺陷分割与光伏退化评估之间建立了实用的桥梁，推动光伏可靠性分析的发展。

Abstract: Accurate crack assessment in electroluminescence (EL) images is important for photovoltaic (PV) reliability analysis, yet existing segmentation methods often fail to capture the thin, elongated, and structurally constrained nature of crack defects. This paper proposes a Solar Topology Crack Network (STC-Net) that incorporates edge priors, spectral priors, and a boundary-topology refinement module to improve crack continuity and boundary preservation. The framework further extends segmentation to power-loss estimation by deriving a crack-associated inactive-area proxy from the predicted masks. Experiments on the PVEL-S dataset show that STC-Net achieves 95.98 MIoU, 98.01 MDice, and 98.00 MAcc during training, and 72.52 MIoU and 80.16 MDice on unseen test samples. These results demonstrate that STC-Net provides accurate crack localization while offering a practical link between EL-based defect segmentation and PV degradation assessment.

</details>


### [171] [When Extreme Darkness Meets Motion Blur: MeanFlow for Unified RAW Restoration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01720)
*Zepu Wang,Jingze Liang,Weijie Xiao,Kexin Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一个面向真实采集退化条件下的极低光RAW图像增强框架，首次引入运动退化建模（SIDED数据集）、统一RAW tokenizer（域条件表示校准）和MeanFlow增强模块，并结合物理引导的细化模型，在耦合运动与噪声退化下达到SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有极低光RAW增强方法主要关注光照和噪声，忽视了实际低光成像中固有的运动退化（如相机抖动、物体运动），导致在真实场景下鲁棒性不足。

Method: (1) 构建SIDED数据集：对极低光RAW配对数据施加受控运动退化，同时保留原始传感器噪声；(2) 提出统一RAW tokenizer，引入显式域条件表示校准以对齐极低光与正常曝光RAW数据；(3) 采用MeanFlow在单次函数评估中完成增强；(4) 引入物理引导的细化模型，强化光照-反射一致性、像素保真度和颜色保持，且不增加推理成本。

Result: 大量实验表明该框架在极低光RAW增强任务上达到SOTA性能，并能鲁棒处理运动与噪声的耦合退化。

Conclusion: 这是首个在真实运动退化采集条件下系统建模并解决极低光RAW增强的工作，通过数据集与模型双方面的创新，为实际低光成像中的复杂退化提供了有效解决方案。

Abstract: Extremely low-light RAW enhancement aims to recover severely attenuated sensor signals, yet existing methods often focus on illumination and noise while overlooking the motion-induced degradations inherent in practical low-light imaging. We present a framework for robust extremely low-light RAW enhancement under realistic acquisition degradations. First, we introduce See in the Degraded Extremely Dark (SIDED), a new dataset that applies controlled motion degradation to extremely low-light RAW pairs while retaining their original sensor noise. Second, we propose a unified RAW tokenizer equipped with explicit domain-conditioned representation calibration to align extremely low-light and well-exposed RAW data, followed by a MeanFlow that performs enhancement in a single function evaluation. To our knowledge, this is the first work to formulate extremely low-light RAW enhancement under realistic motion-degraded acquisition and address it with MeanFlow. We further introduce a physics-guided refinement model to strengthen illumination--reflectance consistency, pixel fidelity, and color preservation without incurring additional inference cost. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our framework achieves state-of-the-art performance in extremely low-light RAW enhancement, and robustly handles coupled motion and noise degradations.

</details>


### [172] [G-Skin: Learning to Bind 3D Gaussians with Generative Visual Priors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01726)
