Method: 流水线分三阶段：(1) 分割阶段先隔离目标个体；(2) 物种感知预处理阶段，对lynx、海龟和蝾螈应用轻量级预处理增强身份相关视觉线索，德州角蜥仅用分割结果；(3) 相似度估计与聚类阶段，使用WildFusion框架，校准并融合MiewID全局描述符与两条局部匹配分支（ALIKED+LightGlue和DISK+LightGlue）。查询-查询相似度经过细化后通过图聚类转换身份簇，查询-数据库相似度用于将置信样本关联到已知身份。评估了训练-free和微调的MiewID变体（Dynamic ArcFace和SphereFace2-Focal），最终集成。

Result: 选定的集成模型在公开集上取得最佳ARI 0.72124，私有集ARI 0.70393，显著优于WildFusion基线；一个更简单的预处理后校准变体在私有集上取得最佳ARI 0.71087。

Conclusion: 校准的全局-局部特征融合结合物种感知的预处理策略，在具有挑战性的野外条件和视觉变化下，对开放集野生动物重识别是有效的。

Abstract: AnimalCLEF26 addresses discovery-oriented animal re-identification, where systems must both attach query images to known individuals and discover unseen individuals by clustering them correctly. We present a similarity-to-clustering pipeline for this setting across Eurasian lynx, fire salamander, loggerhead sea turtle, and Texas horned lizard images. The method first isolates the target specimen using segmentation and then applies lightweight species-specific preprocessing for lynx, sea turtle, and salamander images to enhance identity-relevant visual cues, while Texas horned lizard images are used after segmentation only. Pairwise similarities are then estimated with WildFusion by calibrating and combining a MiewID global descriptor with two local matching branches, ALIKED + LightGlue and DISK + LightGlue. The resulting query-query similarities are refined and converted into identity clusters using graph-based clustering, while query-database similarities are used to attach confident samples to known identities. We evaluate training-free and fine-tuned MiewID variants, including Dynamic ArcFace and SphereFace2-Focal adaptations, and combine them in the final ensemble. Our selected ensemble substantially improves on the WildFusion baseline, achieving the best public ARI of 0.72124 and a private ARI of 0.70393, while a simpler preprocessing-before-calibration variant achieves the best private ARI of 0.71087. These results indicate that calibrated global-local fusion with species-aware preprocessing choices is effective for open-set wildlife re-identification under challenging field conditions and visual variation. The implementation code is available on GitHub.

</details>


### [270] [Grounding Agentic VLMs with Dedicated Segmentation for Fine-Grained Vehicle Damage Assessment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02470)
*Vishwajeet Shivaji Hogale,Anjali Pai,Nitya Ravi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出TinyDamage框架，将VLM（Qwen-VL）的语义推理能力与专用的多任务分割模型相结合，解决车辆损伤评估中微小缺陷（划痕、发丝裂纹）的空间定位不准确问题。通过监督对比损失替代focal loss来提升微小目标分割性能，并在7节点LangGraph agent管线中实现每次VLM生成步骤的分割输出"接地"，将报告幻觉率从78-92%降至31%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLM在实际视觉评估任务中被广泛部署，但其细粒度空间接地（spatial grounding）能力在视觉上模糊的目标上不可靠。以车辆损伤评估为例，划痕和发丝裂纹等微小缺陷仅占用极少像素、梯度信号弱且容易与反射和表面纹理混淆，导致VLM虽然语义分类准确率高达87.3%，却在空间层面系统性地产生幻觉（在反射区域虚构损伤）、遗漏（完全错过细长划痕）和空间不一致的输出。

Method: 提出TinyDamage混合架构：1) 将空间定位任务委托给专门的多任务分割模型，VLM仅负责语义推理和报告生成；2) 在分割侧，发现focal loss会导致微小损伤检测坍缩为零，改用监督对比损失（supervised contrastive objective）以改善损伤/背景的可分离性；3) 将分割模型集成到7节点LangGraph agent管线中，每个VLM生成步骤都以分割输出为"接地"（grounding）依据；4) 提出DET_l，一种允许式（permissive）的按类别检测指标，用于在类别不平衡下评估微小目标接地。

Result: 在100份人工验证报告的受控评估中，报告幻觉率从纯文本的92%和纯图像的78%降至31%。Qwen-VL在语义分类上达到87.3%的准确率但在空间层面系统性失效，而混合架构有效弥补了这一缺陷。论文还报告了部署管线的延迟和可靠性特征。

Conclusion: 仅依赖VLM进行视觉评估不足以实现可靠的微小目标空间接地。将空间定位委托给专用分割模型、以分割输出约束VLM生成的混合架构是降低幻觉率的有效途径。此外，损失函数选择对微小目标分割性能有被低估的重大影响，focal loss在极度不平衡场景下可能适得其反，而监督对比学习更具优势。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly deployed as reasoning agents in real-world visual assessment pipelines, yet their spatial grounding remains unreliable for fine-grained, visually ambiguous targets. We study this gap in the context of automated vehicle damage assessment, where fine-grained defects such as scratches and hairline cracks occupy few pixels, produce weak gradient signal, and are easily confused with reflections and surface texture. We show that a state-of-the-art VLM (Qwen-VL) achieves strong semantic classification accuracy (87.3%) on this task but is systematically ungrounded at the spatial level: it hallucinates damage in reflective regions, misses elongated scratches entirely, and produces spatially inconsistent outputs when prompted for localization. We propose TinyDamage, a hybrid architecture that delegates spatial grounding to a dedicated multi-task segmentation model while reserving the VLM for semantic reasoning and report generation. On the segmentation side, we find that the choice of loss function has an outsized and underexplored effect on tiny-object grounding: focal loss, widely used for class imbalance, collapses tiny-damage detection to zero, while a supervised contrastive objective measurably improves damage/background separability. We integrate the segmentation model into a 7-node LangGraph agent pipeline that grounds every VLM generation step in the segmentation output, and show that this grounding reduces the report hallucination rate from 92% (text-only) and 78% (image-only) to 31% in a controlled evaluation on 100 human-verified reports. We introduce DET_l, a permissive per-category detection metric for evaluating tiny-object grounding under class imbalance, and report latency and reliability characteristics of the deployed pipeline.

</details>


### [271] [Action-grounded tissue affordance enables anticipatory auto-framing that lowers surgeon cognitive workload during laparoscopic surgery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02471)
*Jiayu Gu,Yiwei Wang,Jie Zhang,Guojun Cao,Keshen Lyu,Song Zhou,Yimeng Chen,Haorui Wang,Qingmin Feng,Shenchao Shi,Huan Zhao,Wenbin Chen,Caihua Xiong,Chidan Wan,Jing Samantha Pan,Xiong Cai,Han Ding*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DiffeoAfford是一个面向腹腔镜手术的动作引导组织可供性框架，通过微分同胚约束的组织追踪与器械轨迹分析相结合，从已完成的手术流程中回顾性地推导出视觉注意力监督标签，无需逐帧人工标注，并支持AffordView辅助自动取景系统，在真实世界评估中降低外科医生认知负荷。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 计算注意力模型有望帮助外科医生管理腹腔镜手术中的视觉需求，但这些模型通常需要密集的空间标签。由于手术意图高度专业化且属隐性知识，难以获取这些标签，因此需要一种无需人工逐帧标注即可生成视觉注意力监督的方法。

Method: DiffeoAfford结合微分同胚约束的组织追踪与器械轨迹分析，从已完成的外科手术流程中回顾性生成可供性热点标签；训练一个实时预测模型来预判相关手术区域，并集成到AffordView辅助自动取景系统中。

Result: 该框架与专家标注和术中医师注视高度一致，并在真实世界评估中通过主观、生理和行为测量指标证实能够降低外科医生的认知负荷。

Conclusion: DiffeoAfford证明了从已完成手术中自动提取可供性标签的可行性，为腹腔镜手术的注意力建模提供了一种无需人工标注的监督信号来源，并展示了其在辅助手术可视化系统中降低认知负荷的实用价值。

Abstract: Computational attention models could help surgeons manage the visual demands of laparoscopy, but they require dense spatial labels that are difficult to obtain because surgical intent is highly specialized and tacit. Here, we introduce DiffeoAfford, an action-grounded tissue affordance framework that retrospectively derives visual attention supervision from completed surgical procedures. By combining diffeomorphism-constrained tissue tracking with instrument trajectory analysis, DiffeoAfford generates affordance hotspot labels without manual per-frame annotation. A real-time prediction model trained on these labels anticipates relevant surgical regions and enables AffordView, an assistive auto-framing system for laparoscopic visualization. The proposed framework aligns with expert annotations and intraoperative surgeon gaze, and reduces surgeon cognitive workload during real-world evaluations using subjective, physiological, and behavioral measures.

</details>


### [272] [EchoCache: Energy-Guided Cross-Modal Caching for Efficient Audio-Driven Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02474)
*Jiayu Chen,Xiaoyu Wu,Rongshan Gao,Maoliang Li,Zihao Zheng,Xinhao Sun,Hailong Zou,Guojie Luo,Xiang Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: EchoCache提出了一种能量引导的跨模态缓存框架，通过利用音频时频能量作为显著性锚点来指导缓存更新，并引入动态时间步长-潜变量缓存机制，实现了A2V视频生成中延迟与质量权衡的显著改善（最高2.46x加速）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 音频驱动的视频生成（A2V）虽然取得了进展，但扩散模型的迭代去噪过程导致推理成本高昂。现有缓存方法主要利用视觉特征的时间冗余，却忽视了A2V的跨模态对齐特性——音频驱动视觉生成具有高度非均匀的时间重要性。论文识别出两种级别的错配：时间-语义错配和计算-存储错配。

Method: EchoCache包含两个核心组件：(1) 利用音频时频能量作为显著性锚点指导潜变量级别的缓存更新；(2) 引入动态时间步长-潜变量缓存机制，配合量化缓存管理，实现效率与内存的联合优化。

Result: 在主流A2V模型上的大量实验表明，EchoCache持续改善延迟-质量权衡，同时保持生成质量和音视频一致性。在Wan2.2-S2V和EMTD基准上实现2.46x加速并取得最佳综合性能。

Conclusion: EchoCache通过利用音频能量作为跨模态显著性引导的缓存策略，有效解决了A2V缓存中的时间-语义错配和计算-存储错配问题，实现了更高效的音频驱动视频生成。

Abstract: Audio-driven video generation (A2V) has achieved promising progress in synthesizing temporally coherent and audio-visually aligned videos, yet its inference remains expensive due to the iterative denoising process of diffusion models. Existing caching methods mainly exploit temporal redundancy in visual features while overlooking the cross-modal alignment of A2V, where audio drives visual generation with highly non-uniform temporal importance. In this paper, we identify two levels of misalignment in existing A2V caching methods: temporal-semantic and computation-storage misalignment. To address them, we propose EchoCache, an energy-guided cross-modal caching framework for efficient A2V generation. EchoCache leverages audio time-frequency energy as a saliency anchor to guide latent-level cache updates and further introduces a dynamic timestep-latent caching mechanism with quantized cache management for joint efficiency and memory optimization. Extensive experiments on mainstream A2V models show that EchoCache consistently improves the latency-quality trade-off while preserving generation quality and audio-visual consistency. In particular, on Wan2.2-S2V over the EMTD benchmark, EchoCache achieves a 2.46x speedup with the best overall performance. Code is available at https://github.com/IF-LAB-PKU/EchoCache.

</details>


### [273] [DyFrDet: Towards Accurate Small Object Detection via Dynamic Frequency Suppression with Label Disambiguation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02495)
*Zihan Yang,Yang Guo,Hongxing Zhang,Dan Lu,Siyuan Yao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出DyFrDet小目标检测器，通过动态频率感知特征金字塔网络（DyFrFPN）在频域抑制背景干扰，并利用标签消歧模块（LDM）建模和缓解标签模糊性，在多个基准上达到最先进性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 小目标检测因视觉线索不足而困难，现有工作主要构建判别性表征，但忽略了频域噪声（低频冗余和高频噪声）以及标签模糊性对精确目标定位的显著阻碍。

Method: 1) 提出DyFrFPN，将层级特征变换到频域表示，并引入动态频带预测器（DBP）自适应抑制低频冗余和过度高频噪声，保留小目标识别的判别性成分；2) 提出标签消歧模块（LDM），利用概率分布显式建模并缓解目标标签的内在模糊性，提升低分辨率小目标的定位精度。

Result: 在多个基准数据集上，DyFrDet实现了最先进的检测性能，验证了其在各种挑战性场景下的有效性和鲁棒性。代码已在GitHub开源。

Conclusion: 通过频域动态抑制背景干扰和标签消歧两个创新模块，DyFrDet有效解决了小目标检测中频域噪声和标签模糊性问题，显著提升了小目标的定位精度。

Abstract: Despite the remarkable progress over the past decades, accurately identifying small objects remains challenging because of their insufficient visual cues. Previous works typically attempt to construct discriminative representation of the small objects. However, the wide range frequency domain noises and label ambiguities have been greatly overlooked, which significantly hinders the accurate localization. To address these issues, we propose a novel small object detection (SOD) detector termed DyFrDet, which is able to precisely localize the small object by dynamically suppressing the background distractions in frequency domain. Specifically, we propose a Dynamic Frequency-aware Feature Pyramid Network (DyFrFPN) to adaptively suppress low-frequency redundancy and excessive high-frequency noises. The DyFrFPN transforms the hierarchical features into frequency domain representation, and introduces a Dynamic Band Predictor (DBP) to preserve the discriminative components for small object identification. Afterwards, we present a novel Label Disambiguation Module (LDM), which leverages probabilistic distributions to explicitly model and alleviate the inherent ambiguity of target labels, yielding efficient improvement in localization precision of the small objects with low-resolution. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DyFrDet achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple benchmarks, indicating its effectiveness and robustness in various challenging scenarios. Our code is available at https://github.com/ManOfStory/DyFrDet.

</details>


### [274] [Token Radius Attention for Efficient Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02504)
*Jiayu Chen,Zhikun Jiang,Maoliang Li,Jiayi Luo,Jiawei Yang,Zihao Zheng,Hengyi Zhang,Guojie Luo,Xiang Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出Token Radius Attention (TRA)，一种无需训练的框架，通过将查询熵映射为令牌预算并转换为时间衰减半径来实现注意力稀疏化，在Wan2.1、Wan2.2和HunyuanVideo的T2V/I2V任务上仅保留9-19%的注意力交互，获得1.56x-2.05x加速且生成质量相当。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频扩散Transformer（VDiTs）的密集3D自注意力带来平方级计算成本。现有头部级和块级稀疏方法在同一批次查询间共享计算预算，忽略了不同查询token各自不同的注意力需求，导致计算资源分配不合理。

Method: TRA提出三个核心洞察：(1) 保留密度在不同查询间变化但与其注意力熵呈对数线性相关；(2) 主导交互形成以查询为中心的邻域，且邻域半径随token而变。基于此，TRA将查询熵映射为解析令牌预算，并将其转换为时间衰减半径（无需显式键排序）。同时引入融合熵提取、暖启动重用和块稀疏掩码构造以降低额外开销。

Result: 在Wan2.1、Wan2.2和HunyuanVideo的T2V/I2V共七种配置上，TRA仅保留9-19%的注意力交互，实现1.56x-2.05x的推理加速，同时保持了有竞争力的生成质量。

Conclusion: TRA通过利用查询熵与注意力预算之间的相关性及查询中心邻域结构，实现了个性化的、查询自适应的注意力稀疏化，在不牺牲生成质量的前提下显著降低VDiTs的计算开销。

Abstract: Video Diffusion Transformers (VDiTs) enable high-fidelity generation but incur quadratic cost from dense 3D self-attention. Existing head- and block-level sparse methods share computation budgets across queries, overlooking token-specific attention demand. We observe that retained density varies across queries yet correlates log-linearly with attention entropy, while dominant interactions form query-centered neighborhoods with token-dependent radii. Based on these findings, we propose Token Radius Attention (TRA), a training-free framework that maps query entropy to an analytic token budget and converts it into a temporally decayed radius without explicit key ranking. Fused entropy extraction, warm-up reuse, and block-sparse mask construction further reduce overhead. Across seven Wan2.1, Wan2.2, and HunyuanVideo T2V/I2V configurations, TRA retains only 9-19% of attention interactions and achieves 1.56x-2.05x speedup with competitive generation quality. Code is available at https://github.com/IF-LAB-PKU/Token-Radius-Attention.

</details>


### [275] [ReMiX-MAE: Learning Missing-Channel Cross-Modal Representations from RGB-Only Clinical Facial Videos for Sympathetic-Mediated Pain Assessment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02561)
*Nan Bi,Taoyue Wang,Lijun Yin,Vandana Sharma*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出ReMiX-MAE，一种自监督多模态掩码预训练框架，利用同步RGB、热成像和深度视频学习可迁移的面部表征，并显式训练对缺失模态的鲁棒性，实现仅用RGB即可部署的临床疼痛自动评估。作者还构建了SMP数据集（含治疗前后多访视频与序列级自我报告标签），实验表明ReMiX-MAE在RGB-only部署下优于RGB-only掩码自编码器基线，并在外部数据集上展现出更强的鲁棒性和标签效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床疼痛自动评估面临两大挑战：一是缺乏临床情境下的面部视频数据，且标签为弱标签（通常是序列级自我报告）；二是疼痛线索在RGB中可能微妙或接近中性，而热成像和深度信号虽信息丰富却难以在日常临床中常规部署。因此需要一个在训练时利用多模态信息、但部署时仅依赖RGB的方法。

Method: 提出ReMiX-MAE（Reconstructing Missing Channel Cross-Modal Masked Autoencoder），一种自监督多模态掩码预训练框架。其核心思想是：(1) 从同步的RGB、热成像和深度视频中学习可迁移的面部表征；(2) 显式训练对缺失模态的鲁棒性，使得最终可以仅用RGB进行部署；(3) 同时支持直接特征提取和从RGB解码的伪多模态特征两种RGB-only部署方式。此外，作者构建了SMP（Sympathetic Mediated Pain）数据集，包含多次访视的配对治疗前后面部视频记录及视频级别自我报告标签。

Result: 在SMP数据集上，ReMiX-MAE在RGB-only部署下一致优于RGB-only掩码自编码器基线，且在具有挑战性的五分类设置下，伪多模态特征（从RGB解码）带来额外增益。在外部数据集上，ReMiX-MAE展现出比RGB-only基线更鲁棒且更具标签效率的迁移性能，凸显其在数据有限的临床环境中的优势。

Conclusion: ReMiX-MAE通过多模态自监督预训练结合缺失模态鲁棒性训练，成功弥合了多模态信息丰富与实际临床RGB-only部署之间的差距，为数据有限的临床疼痛评估场景提供了有效且实用的解决方案，并在弱标签条件下展现出更强的表征质量和迁移能力。

Abstract: Automated pain assessment in real clinics is limited by scarce clinically grounded facial video data with weak labels (often sequence-level self-report) and by the fact that pain cues can be subtle or near-neutral in RGB, while thermal and depth signals are informative yet impractical to deploy routinely. To address these challenges, we propose ReMiX-MAE (Reconstructing Missing Channel Cross-Modal Masked Autoencoder), a self-supervised multimodal masked pretraining framework that learns transferable facial representations from synchronized RGB, thermal, and depth videos and explicitly trains robustness to missing modalities, enabling RGB-only deployment. To fill the gap of clinically grounded facial pain data with video-level self-report and longitudinal treatment trajectories, we collect the Sympathetic Mediated Pain (SMP) dataset with paired pre- and post-recordings across multiple visits. Under RGB-only deployment, we evaluate ReMiX-MAE using both direct feature extraction and pseudo-multimodal features decoded from RGB. ReMiX-MAE consistently outperforms an RGB-only masked autoencoder baseline on SMP, with pseudo-multimodal features providing additional gains in the challenging five-class setting. Across external datasets, ReMiX-MAE further shows more robust and label-efficient transfer than RGB-only baselines, highlighting its advantage in data-limited clinical settings.

</details>


### [276] [UEmbed: Unified Sparse and Dense Multimodal Embeddings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02583)
*Tingyu Song,Mingxin Li,Yanzhao Zhang,Dingkun Long,Pengjun Xie,Zhijie Nie,Yilun Zhao,Shu Wu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: UEmbed是一个解码器-only统一多模态嵌入模型，通过在学习到的特殊token上划分词汇表子集，在单次因果前向传播中同时生成稀疏词法表示和稠密表示，统一了文本和多种模态的稀疏检索。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LSR方法局限于编码器式双向架构，且扩展到多模态时高度依赖辅助跨模态模块。作者希望突破这一限制，将稀疏检索从文本扩展到多模态场景，同时消解对辅助模块的依赖。

Method: UEmbed采用解码器-only架构，输入中附加N个可学习的特殊token，并将词汇表划分为N个不相交子集。每个特殊token的因果隐藏状态对其分配的词汇子集预测稀疏权重，N个子集的输出拼接成完整稀疏向量；同时模型也输出稠密表示，实现一种模型同时产生两种表示。

Result: UEmbed-9B在MMEB-v2上达到71.8（稠密）和71.0（稀疏），超过在公开数据上训练的多模态嵌入模型（如RzenEmbed）；在BEIR上与强基线保持竞争力。作者从有效性、效率和代理应用三个维度展示了实用性。

Conclusion: UEmbed提供了一种新范式：在单一模型中统一稠密和稀疏嵌入，同时将稀疏检索扩展至统一的文本和多模态输入场景，无需辅助跨模态模块。

Abstract: Sparse retrieval underpins modern search systems, from web search to retrieval-augmented generation. Existing work has introduced Learned Sparse Retrieval (LSR) to push beyond exact lexical matching toward richer semantics. Yet LSR has so far remained tied to encoder-style bidirectional architectures, and its extension to multimodal settings still relies heavily on auxiliary cross-modal modules. To address these limitations, we introduce UEmbed (Unified Embedding), a decoder-only multimodal embedding model that produces both sparse lexical and dense representations in one causal forward pass. UEmbed appends N learnable special tokens to the input and partitions the vocabulary into N disjoint subsets. Each token's causal hidden state predicts sparse weights over its assigned subset, and the N subsets are concatenated into the full sparse vector. Trained on public data, we release UEmbed at 2B, 4B, and 9B scales. UEmbed-9B reaches 71.8 (dense) and 71.0 (sparse) on MMEB-v2, outperforming multimodal embedding models trained on publicly available data (e.g., RzenEmbed). On BEIR, UEmbed also remains competitive with strong dense and sparse baselines. Furthermore, we demonstrate the practical utility of UEmbed across three dimensions: effectiveness, efficiency, and agentic applications. Overall, UEmbed offers a new paradigm: it unifies dense and sparse embeddings in one model, while further extending sparse retrieval to unify text and multimodal inputs.

</details>


### [277] [CAPEval: A Decoupled Caption Evaluation across Understanding and Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02589)
*Zhipeng Liu,Haochen Wang,Zhaoxiang Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出CAPEval基准，将图像描述（caption）质量分解为Coverage（覆盖度）和Precision（精确度）两个正交维度，并通过受控实验发现：理解任务更依赖Coverage，生成任务更依赖Precision，从而为不同下游任务提供针对性的描述器选择和优化指导。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有评估将caption质量视为单一标量目标，混淆了两个不同的属性：caption覆盖了多少视觉信息（Coverage）以及图像在多大程度上可靠地支持caption中的陈述（Precision）。这种单一评估方式无法细粒度诊断caption质量问题，也难以为不同下游任务提供针对性的优化方向。

Method: 设计CAPEval（Coverage And Precision Evaluation）基准：包含人类编写的ground-truth caption和人工验证的原子检查列表项。将caption质量分解为Coverage（对ground-truth事实内容的覆盖程度）和Precision（caption中所有陈述的事实正确率）。选取10个captioner，并跨4个模型家族开展受控的下游端到端实验，其中caption来源是唯一变量。

Result: 发现一致的任务依赖式解离：Coverage是理解性能的更强相关因素，而Precision是生成性能的主导预测因子。这种解耦评估范式不仅提供更细粒度的caption质量诊断，还为不同下游任务提供可操作的captioner选择和优化指导。

Conclusion: 解耦的评估范式（Coverage vs. Precision）比单一标量评估更有效，能够揭示caption质量与不同下游任务之间的差异化关系，为多模态理解和文本到图像生成提供了精细化的质量诊断和优化方向。

Abstract: Captions serve as a primary supervision signal for both multimodal understanding and text-to-image generation. However, previous evaluations treat the caption quality as a single scalar objective, which conflates two distinct properties: (1) how much visual information a caption covers and (2) how reliably the image supports its stated claims. To this end, we design a decoupled caption evaluation benchmark, CAPEval (Coverage And Precision Evaluation), with human-written ground-truth captions and human-verified atomic checklist items. Specifically, CAPEval decomposes caption quality into Coverage and Precision. The former quantifies how thoroughly a caption covers ground-truth factual content, while the latter reflects the factual correctness rate of all claims expressed in the caption. We select 10 captioners and further conduct controlled downstream end-to-end experiments with them from four model families, where the caption source is the only variable. Empirically, we find a consistent task-dependent dissociation: Coverage serves as the stronger correlate for understanding performance, whereas Precision acts as the dominant predictor for generation performance. This decoupled evaluation paradigm not only delivers a more fine-grained diagnosis of caption quality, but also offers actionable guidance for selecting and optimizing captioners tailored to different downstream tasks.

</details>


### [278] [VR3D: View-Robust 3D Representation Learning for Aerial-Ground Person Re-Identification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02598)
*Chao Ji,Shiyu Xuan,Zechao Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: VR3D是一种面向航拍-地面行人重识别的视角鲁棒3D表示学习框架，通过将2D图像特征提升到统一的3D规范空间实现视角无关的特征交互，并引入可靠性感知融合来适应不同样本的重建质量差异，在CARGO、AG-ReID.v1和AG-ReID.v2三个基准数据集上超越现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 航拍-地面行人重识别面临跨平台视角变化导致的严重遮挡和几何形变问题。现有方法仅在2D图像空间中学习视角不变表示，但剧烈的视角变化使得学到的特征仍与视角偏差耦合，无法真正解耦视角因素。

Method: 提出VR3D框架，包含两个核心组件：(1) 视角鲁棒3D表示交互(VR3I)——从单张2D观测中提取3D先验，将2D外观特征提升到规范3D空间，通过3D几何-语义注意力建立2D patch与对应身体部位3D体素之间的交互，将2D语义锚定在3D框架中；(2) 可靠性感知融合(RAF)——估计样本特定的可靠性，自适应地聚合多源表示，以应对不同样本因视角变化和3D重建误差造成的可靠性差异。

Result: 在三个基准数据集(CARGO、AG-ReID.v1、AG-ReID.v2)上的大量实验表明，VR3D优于近期方法，例如在CARGO上Rank-1指标提升5.63%。

Conclusion: 将行人重识别特征从2D图像空间提升到统一的3D规范空间，并结合可靠性感知的自适应融合策略，能够有效解决跨视角下的特征视角偏差问题，为航拍-地面行人重识别提供了新的解决范式。

Abstract: Aerial-ground person re-identification is a challenging task due to cross-platform viewpoint variations, which cause severe occlusion and geometric deformation. Existing methods attempt to learn view-invariant representations exclusively within the 2D image space, where drastic viewpoint variations cause the learned features to remain coupled with viewpoint bias. To address this, we propose VR3D, a View-Robust 3D Representation Learning framework that maps images into a unified 3D coordinate space to achieve view-independent feature interaction. Specifically, we introduce View-Robust 3D Representation Interaction, which leverages 3D priors extracted from single 2D observations to lift 2D appearance features into a canonical 3D space. VR3I employs 3D Geometry-Semantic Attention to establish interactions between 2D patches and 3D voxels from corresponding body parts based on their 3D spatial locations, effectively grounding 2D semantics within a 3D framework. In addition, as the reliability of these representations varies across samples due to viewpoint changes and 3D reconstruction errors, we introduce Reliability-Aware Fusion, which estimates sample-specific reliability and adaptively aggregates the multi-source representations. Extensive experiments on three benchmark datasets (CARGO, AG-ReID.v1, and AG-ReID.v2) demonstrate that VR3D outperforms recent methods. For example, it achieves a 5.63% improvement in Rank-1 on CARGO. Our code will be released.

</details>


### [279] [WorldExam: Benchmarking World Models from Apparent Appearance to Inherent Reactivity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02603)
*Yuxue Yang,Shuyao Shang,Jiahe Wang,Zitong Zhou,Liang Tan,Junhan Zeng,Ruizhi Li,Junyan Li,Yu Liu,Xiao Yang,Yong Li,Jun Zhu,Hongsheng Li,Tieniu Tan,Lue Fan,Zhaoxiang Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出WorldExam，一个四层级（视觉质量、控制遵循、空间一致性、世界反应性）的分层诊断基准，包含1,474个案例和8个任务，用于评估可控视频生成模型作为世界模型的能力。对20个代表性模型的评估发现，相机驱动、动作驱动和语言驱动三类范式存在明显能力分化，没有任何模型能同时兼顾广泛任务覆盖和稳定表现，高视觉质量和显式指令遵循并不能保证内在世界反应性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有可控视频生成模型正越来越多地被当作世界模型使用，但已有基准主要评估视觉质量或显式指令遵循（检查请求的动作和交互结果是否实现），忽略了"内在反应性"——即模型能否从场景状态推断世界应如何反应，并生成输入中未明确描述的合理后果。这一关键能力的缺失导致评估体系不完整，需要新的诊断基准来填补空白。

Method: 引入WorldExam基准，采用四层递进式诊断框架：①视觉质量层评估生成视频的外观质量；②控制遵循层评估显式指令（相机、动作、语言）的完成度；③空间一致性层评估场景空间结构的一致性；④世界反应性层评估场景条件反应和目标导向行为（超越输入显式指定的部分）。基准包含1,474个案例，分布在8个专属任务中，支持相机驱动、动作驱动和语言驱动三类模型范式的统一评估。

Result: 对20个代表性模型的评估揭示了清晰的能力分化：相机驱动模型在相机控制上表现优异，但其接口不支持动态交互；动作驱动模型对主体的控制更精确，但往往使世界缺乏响应性；语言驱动模型在交互方面表现更好，但对复杂控制的遵循不够忠实。没有一个模型能同时兼具广泛任务覆盖和稳定强大的性能。

Conclusion: 高视觉质量和显式指令遵循并不能保证模型具备内在式世界反应性。这一发现表明，在将视频生成模型作为世界模型评估时，必须引入反应性这类更深层的能力维度，以更全面地刻画模型的真实能力边界。

Abstract: Controllable video generation models are increasingly being developed as world models. Accordingly, evaluating them in this role extends beyond the apparent appearance of generated videos to the inherent reactivity of the worlds they depict: the ability to infer from the scene state how the world should react and to generate plausible consequences not explicitly described in the input. Yet existing benchmarks mainly assess visual quality or explicit instruction fulfillment by checking whether requested actions and interaction outcomes are realized, leaving inherent reactivity underexamined. We introduce WorldExam, a hierarchical diagnostic benchmark spanning four levels: Visual Quality, Control Adherence, Spatial Consistency, and World Reactivity. It comprises 1,474 cases across eight dedicated tasks and supports unified evaluation of camera-, action-, and language-driven model paradigms. The World Reactivity level evaluates scene-conditioned reactions and goal-directed behaviors beyond what is explicitly specified in the input. Evaluation of 20 representative models reveals a clear capability split. Camera-driven models excel at camera control, but their interfaces do not support dynamic interaction; action-driven models control subjects more precisely but often leave the world unresponsive; and language-driven models perform better on interaction but follow complex controls less faithfully. No model combines broad task coverage with consistently strong performance, showing that high visual quality and explicit instruction fulfillment do not guarantee inherent reactivity.

</details>


<div id='cs.AI'></div>

# cs.AI [[Back]](#toc)

### [280] [Evolutionary Curriculum Learning Improves Biological Sequence Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00697)
*Richard Zhu,Kento Nishi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出进化课程学习（ECL）策略，利用多序列比对中的进化结构，按幂律扩展调度逐步将模型暴露于从锚点序列到高分歧序列的递增进化距离样本中。该策略在蛋白质变异效应预测（EVE）和RNA家族序列生成（RfamGen）两个任务、两个架构不同的VAE模型上均提升了下游性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准生物VAE训练将所有序列视为可交换的，忽略了同源序列中从进化接近到高度分歧的丰富进化结构。作者认为进化距离可以作为训练课程排序的有用归纳偏置，从而提升模型性能。

Method: 提出Evolutionary Curriculum Learning (ECL)训练策略：从锚点序列出发，按照幂律扩展调度，逐步向模型暴露进化距离递增的序列。在蛋白质（EVO）和RNA（RfamGen）两个领域的两个架构不同的VAE模型上进行验证，并与固定邻域采样和均匀随机采样进行对照消融。

Result: 蛋白质方面：p53的ClinVar分类AUROC从0.981提升至0.989；PTEN在所有种子下达到1.000（基线不稳定，均值0.905，最低降至0.54）。RNA方面：在所有三个测试家族的协方差模型位分数上均值提升，15次训练中12次超过种子匹配的基线，但由于仅测试三个家族，无法在家族层面确立统计学显著性。消融实验表明按进化距离渐进扩展优于固定邻域采样和均匀随机采样。

Conclusion: 进化距离是生物序列建模中有用的训练课程排序归纳偏置，ECL通过渐进式课程学习显著改善了VAE在下游任务上的表现，尤其对不稳定的基线模型效果显著。

Abstract: Variational autoencoders (VAEs) trained on multiple sequence alignments (MSAs) have emerged as powerful generative models for biological sequences, with applications ranging from disease variant prediction to functional RNA design. However, standard biological VAE training treats all sequences as exchangeable, ignoring the rich evolutionary structure that organizes homologous sequences from evolutionarily close to highly divergent. We propose Evolutionary Curriculum Learning (ECL), a training strategy that exploits this structure by progressively exposing the model to sequences of increasing evolutionary distance from sampled anchors, following a power-law expansion schedule. Applied to two architecturally distinct VAE models and two biological domains--protein variant effect prediction with EVE and RNA family sequence generation with RfamGen--ECL improves downstream task performance across five random seeds per configuration. Mean ClinVar classification AUROC rises from 0.981 to 0.989 for p53; for PTEN, ECL attains 1.000 in every seed whereas the baseline is unstable (mean 0.905, falling as low as 0.54). For RNA, ECL raises mean covariance-model bit scores on all three families tested and exceeds its seed-matched baseline in 12 of 15 training runs, though with only three families the effect cannot be established as significant at the family level. Ablation experiments show that progressively expanding the sampled sequences by evolutionary distance outperforms fixed-size neighborhood sampling in addition to uniform random sampling. Evolutionary distance is therefore a useful inductive bias for ordering the training curriculum in biological sequence modeling.

</details>


### [281] [Nova: An End-to-End MLIR Compiler for Deep Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00029)
*Adwaid Suresh,Aparna A,Harshini V M,Jona Delcy C A,Killi Uma Maheswara Rao,Ram Charan Golla,Surendra Vendra*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文介绍了Nova，一个端到端JIT编译器，旨在通过捕获eager执行并将前向和反向传播统一为单一的值语义方言，实现硬件映射的绝对控制。它通过算术强度分析确定性地推导最优执行调度（搜索时间为零），并利用结构哈希运行时直接从计算结构合成细粒度内核。在RTX 3060上，Nova在TF32矩阵乘法上匹配或略超cuBLAS和XLA，模型吞吐量比PyTorch高10.6%，内存占用降低29%，可在12GB GPU上训练PyTorch无法训练的1.44亿参数模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高性能深度学习模型在物理硬件上的执行效率高度依赖于高层数学操作到底层硬件的映射质量，而现有eager执行框架缺乏整个计算图的全局可见性以及对硬件和内存的细粒度控制，导致无法原生最大化物理硬件利用率，因此需要一个能够实现从操作融合到寄存器级调优的自动编译方案。

Method: Nova是一个自动化的端到端JIT编译器，其核心方法包括：(1) 捕获eager执行并将前向和反向传播统一到单一value-semantic方言中，从而解锁全局图优化；(2) 利用Analytic Configurator基于算术强度确定性地推导最优执行调度，将搜索时间降为零；(3) 通过结构化哈希（structural hashing）运行时，直接从计算结构合成细粒度内核，实现跨操作融合、内存层次优化和寄存器级调优。

Result: 在RTX 3060上，Nova在大多数形状的TF32矩阵乘法上与cuBLAS和XLA相当或略优，并保持<5e-4的严格相对误差。在模型级别，对于4200万参数模型，Nova的吞吐量比PyTorch高10.6%、比XLA高4.4%，且数值保真度不受影响。此外，内存占用比PyTorch减少29%，使得1.44亿参数模型可在12GB消费级GPU上以17,900 tokens/s的速度训练，而PyTorch在同等硬件上遭遇OOM失败。

Conclusion: Nova证明了通过全图可见性的值语义编译器和确定性调度配置，可以在无需搜索的情况下实现接近乃至超越成熟库（如cuBLAS和XLA）的硬件利用效率，同时大幅降低内存占用，扩展了消费级GPU上可训练的模型规模上限，为深度学习编译器设计提供了新的范式。

Abstract: The performance of deep learning models at scale relies heavily on how effectively high-level mathematical operations are mapped to underlying physical hardware. While high-level tensor frameworks provide flexible abstractions for model design, their eager execution models inherently lack the whole-graph visibility and granular control over hardware and memory required to maximize physical hardware utilization natively. To bridge this gap, we designed Nova, an automated end-to-end JIT compiler whose defining purpose is to achieve absolute control over this hardware mapping: fusing operations across operation boundaries, optimizing complex memory hierarchies, and tuning execution down to the register level. By capturing eager executions and unifying forward and backward passes into a single value-semantic dialect, Nova unlocks aggressive whole-graph optimizations. It then utilizes an Analytic Configurator to deterministically derive optimal execution schedules based on arithmetic intensity, dropping search time to zero. Backed by a structural hashing runtime, Nova synthesizes fine-grained kernels directly from the computation's structure. In our evaluations on an RTX 3060, Nova matches or modestly exceeds cuBLAS and XLA on TF32 matmuls on most shapes, maintaining a stringent < 5e-4 relative error. At the model level, Nova achieves up to 10.6% greater throughput than PyTorch and 4.4% greater than XLA on a 42-million parameter model, without compromising on numerical fidelity. Crucially, by reducing the memory footprint by up to 29% relative to PyTorch, Nova successfully trains a 144-million parameter model at 17,900 tokens/s where PyTorch encounters Out-Of-Memory (OOM) failures on the same 12 GB consumer GPU.

</details>


### [282] [H+ Embedding: Harmonizing Global and Token-Level Retrieval with Context-Dependent Phrases](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00065)
*Shusen Zhang,Junyi Hu,Ye Feng,Ziteng Wang,Zhaoyuan Pan,Guosheng Dong,Xiaojun Yuan,Jiangshou Hong,Xiangzhi Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出H+ Embedding，一种统一的多粒度检索器，通过预测可变长度短语划分、保留未覆盖token为单例、并采用重要性引导的单元选择与加权MaxSim交互，在术语密集型（尤其医学）检索场景中实现介于全局向量压缩与token级交互之间的质量-成本中间点。在16个科学、医学和双语任务上，短语检索分支相较全局检索分支提升6.91 macro nDCG@10，并以减少13.7%文档向量的代价接近Token级交互性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有检索表示处于两个极端：单向量检索器过度压缩局部相关信号，而token级late interaction保留每个分词子词但带来巨大的索引、存储和评分开销。术语密集型检索（尤其是医学领域）依赖多词实体、缩写、数值约束和组合概念的保真度，现有方法难以兼顾质量与效率，因此需要探索上下文相关的短语能否作为介于全局向量与token之间的检索单元。

Method: H+ Embedding是一种统一的多粒度检索器，核心组件包括：(1) 预测可变长度短语分区，将文档编码为语义连贯的短语单元；(2) 未被覆盖的token保留为单例单元，避免信息丢失；(3) 引入重要性引导的单元选择机制，控制参与交互的向量数量；(4) 采用加权MaxSim交互进行相关性评分，替代标准token级MaxSim。整体框架实现了多粒度表示的统一集成。

Result: 在16个科学、医学和双语检索任务上，H+的短语检索分支相比全局检索分支提升6.91 macro nDCG@10；同时在较Token级交互减少13.7%文档向量的条件下性能几乎与Token相当，且在中等向量预算下优于基于内容无关分组规则的基线方法。

Conclusion: 上下文相关的短语交互为实际检索系统提供了一个介于全局压缩与token级交互之间的中间质量-成本选择点。H+ Embedding验证了这种多粒度表示的有效性与实用性，表明短语级单元能够在保持高效检索的同时改善术语密集场景下的相关性辨别能力。

Abstract: Terminology-intensive retrieval, especially in medical settings, depends on preserving multi-word entities, abbreviations, numerical constraints, and compositional concepts. However, existing representations lie at two extremes: single-vector retrievers often over-compress local relevance signals, while token-level late interaction retains every tokenizer subword at substantial indexing, storage, and scoring cost. This mismatch raises a natural question: can context-dependent phrases provide a useful retrieval unit between global vectors and tokens? We introduce H+ Embedding, a unified multi-granularity retriever that predicts variable-length phrase partitions, preserves uncovered tokens as singletons, and applies importance-guided unit selection with weighted MaxSim interaction. Across 16 scientific, medical, and bilingual tasks, its phrase retrieval branch exceeds the global retrieval branch by 6.91 macro nDCG@10. It also nearly matches Token while using 13.7% fewer document vectors and outperforms content-independent grouping rules under moderate vector budgets. Context-dependent phrase interaction therefore provides an intermediate quality-cost point between global compression and token-level interaction for practical retrieval systems.

</details>


### [283] [Agentic Coding in the Wild: Characterizing GitHub Copilot Traces at Production Scale](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00101)
*Banruo Liu,Haoran Qiu,Íñigo Goiri,Rodrigo Fonseca,Ricardo Bianchini,Esha Choukse*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文基于2026年6月GitHub Copilot的生产级采样数据（320万用户、1300万会话、7.61亿次LLM调用、95万亿token），首次对AI编码智能体（agentic coding）工作负载进行了大规模特性刻画。研究发现该工作负载与聊天机器人存在本质差异：会话结构为稀疏用户回合与自主agent循环交织，KV缓存命中率在回合内高达90%但在回合边界降至55%，且模型切换或上下文压缩会导致缓存大量失效。文章还提出轻量级空闲时间预测器，可捕获86-90%的总空闲时间，为agent原生基础设施的资源编排提供了实证基础。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI编码智能体（如GitHub Copilot、Claude Code、Codex）将多步LLM推理与工具执行交错进行，形成了与聊天机器人截然不同的工作负载特征。然而，现有的LLM-serving系统设计大多基于聊天工作负载的假设。为了设计agent原生的系统基础设施，需要基于生产级数据对这一新型工作负载进行全面、准确的特性刻画。

Method: 作者从2026年6月的GitHub Copilot生产环境中收集采样trace数据，涵盖320万用户、1300万会话、7.61亿次LLM调用和95万亿token。通过系统性分析会话结构（回合与agent循环的嵌套关系）、KV缓存命中率在不同粒度（回合内/跨回合/模型切换/上下文压缩）下的变化规律、token消耗与用户行为的多样性和长尾分布、以及回合间空闲时间的分布特性，并基于观察设计了一个轻量级的空闲时间预测器。

Result: 研究发现：1) agentic编码会话由稀疏用户回合组成，每个回合内部展开为自主agent循环，LLM调用几乎总是伴随工具执行；2) KV缓存命中率在回合内平均达90%，但跨回合降到55%，模型切换或上下文压缩后会被剧裂失效；3) 工作流和用户行为呈现高度多样性和长尾分布；4) agent快速响应时间与会话回合间数分钟的用户空闲期形成鲜明对比；5) 所设计的轻量级空闲时间预测器能捕获86-90%的总空闲时间。

Conclusion: 现有LLM-serving系统基于聊天工作负载的假设在agentic编码场景下不再成立（如稀疏回合、高缓存复用但易失效、长时间空闲等），研究结果为agent原生（agent-native）基础设施的设计提供了首个生产级实证基础。

Abstract: AI coding agents like GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, and Codex interleave multi-step LLM inference with tool execution, creating a workload different from chatbots. We present the first production-scale characterization of this workload using sampled GitHub Copilot traces from June 2026, comprising 3.2M users, 13M sessions, 761M LLM calls, and 95T tokens.
  Our analysis reveals distinctive workload properties with important systems implications. For example, agentic coding sessions consist of sparse user-initiated turns, each unfolding into an autonomous agent loop of LLM calls almost always coupled with tool execution. This structure yields KV cache hit rates averaging 90% within a turn, but falling to 55\% across turn boundaries and drastically invalidated after events like model switches or context compaction. Diverse workflows and user behaviors are observed with variable and long-tailed token consumption, time span, and tool calls. We highlight the difference between quick agentic turnaround times and the minutes-long user idle periods at turn boundaries, and design a lightweight idle-time predictor that captures 86-90\% of total idle time, enabling proactive decisions for efficient resource orchestration. These findings challenge assumptions underlying current LLM-serving systems and provide an empirical foundation for agent-native infrastructure.

</details>


### [284] [TRACE-TS: Attribution-Grounded and Traceable Sensor-Language Reasoning for Human Activity Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00200)
*Sparsh Rastogi,Tanmay Kumar,Baiyu Chen,Jatin Bedi,Zechen Li,Flora D. Salim*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: TRACE-TS是一个面向可穿戴传感器时间序列的框架，通过专家分类器的归因机制识别关键时空区域，构建带证据来源的DAG推理轨迹，并训练紧凑语言模型生成这些轨迹。在推理时无需额外归因计算或教师指导即可同时输出活动预测和推理轨迹。引入SNM指标（LLM作为裁判）诊断推理保真度。在7个可穿戴基准上取得最优平均准确率(84.43%)和F1(81.24%)，相比最佳LLM基线F1提升17.96%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有可穿戴传感器分析方法大多将信号简化为活动标签，无法提供细粒度行为理解；基于LM的方法虽能生成自然语言解释，但其推理与底层信号弱关联，产生的解释流畅但不可验证。

Method: TRACE-TS包含三个核心组件：(1) 利用专家分类器的归因机制识别传感器数据中显著的空时区域；(2) 基于这些区域构建具有显式证据来源的DAG推理轨迹；(3) 训练紧凑语言模型，通过门控交叉注意力对传感器记忆token进行编码以生成推理轨迹。推理时模型联合输出活动预测与推理轨迹，无需归因计算或教师指导。此外提出SNM指标，用LLM作为裁判，在观测、推理和综合三个层面诊断推理忠实度。

Result: 在7个可穿戴基准数据集上，TRACE-TS在所有评估方法中取得最佳平均准确率(84.43%)和F1(81.24%)，相比最佳LLM基线的F1提升17.96%。代码已开源。

Conclusion: TRACE-TS证明了将归因机制与结构化DAG推理轨迹相结合，可以有效增强可穿戴时间序列的推理可信度和可验证性，同时在预测性能上优于现有方法，为解决LM解释流于表面、缺乏信号支撑的问题提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Wearable sensors capture fine-grained motion patterns that support rich behavioral understanding, yet most existing methods reduce these signals to activity labels. Recent LM-based approaches generate natural-language explanations for sensor data, but their reasoning is weakly grounded in the underlying signal, leading to fluent yet unverifiable explanations. We introduce TRACE-TS (Traceable Reasoning with Attribution-Grounded Evidence), a framework for structured and signal-grounded reasoning over wearable time series. TRACE-TS uses attribution from an expert classifier to identify salient spatio-temporal sensor regions, uses them to construct DAG reasoning traces with explicit evidence provenance, and trains a compact language model to generate these traces through gated cross-attention over sensor memory tokens. At inference, the adapted model jointly outputs the activity prediction and its reasoning trace, without requiring attribution computation or teacher guidance. We introduce Semantic Node Match(SNM), an LLM-as-judge metric that diagnoses reasoning fidelity at the observation, inference, and synthesis levels, localizing hallucinated observations and broken evidence chains missed by standard NLG metrics. Across seven wearable benchmarks, TRACE-TS achieves the best average accuracy and F1 among all evaluated methods (84.43%/81.24%), and outperforms the best LLM-based baseline by 17.96% in F1. Our code is available at https://github.com/SparshRastogi/TRACE-TS.

</details>


### [285] [RMSWeb: Reflection, Failure-Mode Mining, and Salvage-DS for Web Agent Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00335)
*Chengbo Liu,Lifang Zhou,Ruijie Yan,Pei Tan,Ao Sun,Haojun Huang,Guichun Hua,Sining Wei,Yining Chen,Yingying He,Yutao Xie*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: RMSWeb是一种针对紧凑型网页代理的三部分训练配方，通过反射条件重试、失败模式挖掘和Salvage-DS奖励机制，在Qwen3-VL-Instruct 8B和32B模型上显著提升网页代理性能，减少19.7%的动作步数，并在多个基准上超越SFT基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 紧凑型网页代理虽能降低部署成本，但训练面临两大挑战：成功轨迹采集昂贵且低效，以及SFT后强化学习阶段存在奖励信号弱、被拒绝组缺乏回退学习信号等问题。现有方法未能充分解决这些瓶颈。

Method: RMSWeb包含三个核心组件：1) 反射条件重试（Reflection-conditioned retries）提高数据采集产出并缩短成功轨迹；2) 失败模式挖掘（Failure-mode mining）将离线RL集中在SFT策略暴露的关键状态；3) Salvage-DS结合动作语义极化奖励、对比与能力门控的动态采样，以及针对被拒绝组的仅动作锚点。

Result: 在WebVoyager、Online-Mind2Web和WebTailBench上，RMSWeb相比SFT在8B模型上提升2.4-7.0个百分点，在32B模型上提升1.2-7.7个百分点。反射收集数据训练的策略在已解决问题上减少最多19.7%的动作步数。8B模型在Online-Mind2Web上取得同规模开源模型最强结果，并在WebVoyager和WebTailBench上实现领先的精度-成本权衡。

Conclusion: RMSWeb通过系统化解决数据采集效率、RL奖励信号设计和关键状态聚焦三大问题，有效提升了紧凑型网页代理的训练效果与推理效率，展示了小规模模型在网页代理任务上达到领先性能的可行性。

Abstract: Compact web agents can reduce deployment cost, but training them poses challenges in both data collection and post-SFT reinforcement learning (RL). Successful trajectories are expensive to collect and often contain inefficient detours. After supervised fine-tuning (SFT), full trajectory corpora are dominated by routine states; moreover, when group-relative RL is applied to web actions, inadequately designed action-level rewards can yield weak or misleading relative updates, while groups rejected as unsuitable for such updates receive no fallback learning signal. We present RMSWeb, a three-part recipe for Qwen3-VL-Instruct at 8B and 32B. Reflection-conditioned retries increase collection yield and shorten successful trajectories; failure-mode mining concentrates offline RL on critical states exposed by the SFT policy; and Salvage-DS combines an action-semantic polarized reward, contrast-and-competence-gated dynamic sampling, and an action-only anchor for rejected groups. Policies trained with reflection-collected data use up to 19.7% fewer action steps on solved tasks. On WebVoyager, Online-Mind2Web, and WebTailBench, RMSWeb improves over SFT by 2.4-7.0 points at 8B and 1.2-7.7 points at 32B. Our 8B model also achieves the strongest reported Online-Mind2Web result among similarly sized open-weight models in our comparison and a leading reported accuracy-cost trade-off on WebVoyager and WebTailBench, with the caveat that external evaluation protocols differ.

</details>


### [286] [The Bayesian Reflex: A Predictive Coding Engine for Artificial Intelligence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00492)
*Sourabh Bhattacharya*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"贝叶斯反射"（Bayesian reflex）计算框架，通过三个支柱直接实例化预测编码理论：基于分层生成模型的信念维护、通过预测误差最小化进行的序贯贝叶斯更新、以及通过主动推理实现的不确定性驱动行动。作者利用椭球分解、递归高斯过程和导纳感知的贝叶斯优化等近期算法突破，构建了数学上严谨、可扩展且受大脑启发的持续学习、感知和决策框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预测编码是皮层计算的强大理论，但缺乏相应的可扩展人工智能算法实现。现有算法无法将预测编码的理论潜力转化为实际的、可扩展的AI系统，本文旨在弥合这一理论与算法之间的鸿沟。

Method: 作者提出"贝叶斯反射"框架，通过三个支柱直接实现预测编码：1）利用分层生成模型进行信念维护；2）通过预测误差最小化实现序贯贝叶斯更新；3）借助主动推理实现不确定性驱动的行动。框架整合了三个关键算法组件：用于精确i.i.d.采样的椭球分解、用于深度分层推断的递归高斯过程、以及导纳感知的贝叶斯优化。

Result: 该框架实现了数学上有原则、可扩展且受大脑启发的持续学习、感知和决策，并在气候变化模型评估和素数发现等多种应用中展示了其通用性。但这些结果仅是示例性说明，具体定量评估结果未在摘要中给出。

Conclusion: 本文为真正自适应的人工智能提供了蓝图，将预测编码的理论框架转化为可计算的算法实现，展示了从基础科学到实际应用的多领域适用性。

Abstract: Predictive coding offers a powerful theory of cortical computation, but corresponding scalable algorithmic implementations for artificial intelligence have remained elusive. This paper introduces the Bayesian reflex, a computational framework that directly instantiates predictive coding through three pillars: belief maintenance via hierarchical generative models, sequential Bayesian updating via prediction-error minimization, and uncertainty-driven action via active inference. We show that recent breakthroughs---ellipsoidal decomposition for exact $i.i.d.$ sampling, recursive Gaussian processes for deep hierarchical inference, and derivative-aware Bayesian optimization---provide the missing algorithmic ingredients. The resulting framework enables mathematically principled, scalable, and brain-inspired continual learning, perception, and decision-making. We illustrate its versatility through applications ranging from climate model evaluation to prime number discovery, offering a blueprint for truly adaptive artificial intelligence.

</details>


### [287] [FactorJEPA: Factorizing Monolithic Futures into Layout-Agent-Interaction Channels for Crowded and Chaotic Global South Urban Worlds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01049)
*Kapil Wanaskar,Gaytri Jena,Aman Chadha,Vinija Jain,Vasu Sharma,Amitava Das*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出FactorJEPA，一种将世界结构作为一等预测基元的联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）方法，用于人口密集、混乱的全球南方城市环境（DENSEWORLD）。作者构建了首个此场景的大规模数据集（1000小时/115k样本，覆盖22个城市），并证明FactorJEPA通过分离布局、实体和交互的潜在子空间，配合可见性门控机制，在预测准确性、因果敏感性和遮挡鲁棒性上优于现有JEPA方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有JEPA评估主要在低密度、有车道结构的场景中进行，而真实世界中大量人口密集、混乱的城市环境（全球南方城市）未被充分研究。这些场景具有软空间边界、极端代理异质性、持续遮挡和混合交通下的快速社会协商等特征，现有JEPA公式难以在此类异质性和部分可观测条件下保持密集交互动力学。

Method: FactorJEPA引入结构化的世界建模：将未来潜变量分解为布局（layout）、实体（entities）和交互（interactions）三个分离的子空间，而非使用单一整体潜变量编码未来。采用可见性门控（visibility gate）保持部分被观测的代理，并分离子空间以阻止跨因子捷径（cross-factor shortcuts）。同时发布了DENSEWORLD-115k数据集（1,000小时视频，22个城市），涵盖行车、步行和航拍视角。

Result: FactorJEPA在三项指标上取得改进：(i) 未来潜变量准确性（Future-frame L1），(ii) 干预敏感预测（Causal L1），(iii) 对视觉证据减少的鲁棒性（Mask-ratio slope），并揭示了可复现的运动信息权衡（Motion cosine）。方法排名在2B和1B V-JEPA 2.1骨干网络上均保持一致，Spearman相关系数rho=0.895至0.978。

Conclusion: 将世界结构（布局、实体、交互）作为显式预测基元而非整体编码未来，是应对密集、混乱和部分可观测场景的关键。FactorJEPA超越现有JEPA变体，且结果跨模型规模稳定可复现。作者公开了DENSEWORLD-115k数据集和FactorJEPA检查点，以促进该方向研究。

Abstract: World models have attracted significant attention for their ability to capture and predict the structure and dynamics of the physical world. In this emerging landscape, Joint Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPA) offer a particularly compelling direction.
  We study a largely unexplored regime: populous, crowded, and chaotic Global South urban environments, which we call DENSEWORLD. Unlike the lower-density, lane-structured settings that dominate existing evaluations, these scenes exhibit soft spatial boundaries, extreme agent heterogeneity, persistent occlusion, and rapid social negotiation under mixed traffic. We introduce the first large-scale dataset for this regime: 1,000 hours of drive-through, walk-through, and aerial video across 22 cities. Existing JEPA formulations struggle to preserve dense interaction dynamics under heterogeneity and partial observability.
  We introduce FactorJEPA, which makes world structure a first-class predictive primitive. Rather than encoding the future in a monolithic latent, it composes layout, entities, and interactions, using a visibility gate and separated subspaces to preserve partially observed agents and discourage cross-factor shortcuts. FactorJEPA improves (i) future-latent accuracy (Future-frame L1), (ii) intervention-sensitive prediction (Causal L1), and (iii) robustness to reduced visual evidence (Mask-ratio slope), while exposing (iv) a reproducible motion-information trade-off (Motion cosine). Method rankings replicate across 2B and 1B V-JEPA 2.1 backbones, with rho = 0.895 to 0.978.
  We publicly release the DENSEWORLD-115k dataset (https://huggingface.co/datasets/anonymousML123/denseworld-115k) and the surgery-trained FactorJEPA checkpoints (https://huggingface.co/datasets/anonymousML123/factorjepa-outputs/tree/main/outputs/full/vjepa_2_1_vitg_1B/train/m09c_surgery_3stage_DI_diheavy_encoder).

</details>


### [288] [MA-HEAD-Net: Adaptive Rule-Guided Multi-Agent DRL for AoI Minimization in UAV-Assisted Emergency Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01128)
*Yixin Zhang,Zhuohui Yao,Wenchi Cheng,Walid Saad*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究无人机辅助应急通信中的信息年龄（AoI）最小化问题。针对异构应急服务的突发分组到达和有限块长传输特性，提出了一种微型时隙嵌入调度机制，并开发了MA-HEAD-Net自适应规则引导多代理深度强化学习框架，在动态应急通信场景中实现了更低的AoI和更高的策略形成效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 灾后场景中无人机对建立应急通信网络至关重要，而时效性救援任务对信息新鲜度有极高要求——基于过时数据的决策可能导致无效控制。现有研究尚未充分解决异构应急服务下突发流量、有限块长传输与AoI演化之间的耦合关系，需要新的调度与优化机制。

Method: 采用马尔可夫调制泊松过程建模突发分组到达，引入有限块长理论刻画传输时长、分组完成率与AoI演化的耦合关系；提出微型时隙嵌入调度机制以平衡延迟容忍的长分组传输与紧急短分组响应，并引入自适应检查点间隔选择；将无人机轨迹控制、用户调度和检查点间隔选择联合优化建模为多代理决策问题，开发MA-HEAD-Net框架，将通信域规则先验融入门控多头策略，并在多代理近端策略优化下联合优化策略与门控组件。

Result: 仿真结果表明，MA-HEAD-Net相比代表性多代理深度强化学习基线提高了策略形成效率，并在动态无人机辅助应急通信场景中实现了比基于学习的方法和启发式方法更低的AoI。

Conclusion: MA-HEAD-Net通过将通信域规则先验与学习策略有效融合，在多代理深度强化学习框架下实现了无人机辅助应急通信中AoI的有效最小化，兼顾了策略形成效率与信息新鲜度性能。

Abstract: In post-disaster scenarios, unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) are critical for establishing emergency communication networks. For time-critical rescue missions, information freshness is crucial because decisions based on outdated data may lead to ineffective control actions. This paper investigates age of information (AoI) minimization for UAV-assisted emergency communications with heterogeneous emergency services. We model bursty packet arrivals using a Markov-modulated Poisson process and adopt finite blocklength theory to capture the coupling among transmission duration, packet completion, and AoI evolution. To balance delay-tolerant long-packet transmission and urgent short-packet response, we propose a mini-slot-embedded scheduling mechanism with adaptive checkpoint-interval selection. We formulate the joint optimization of UAV trajectory control, user scheduling, and checkpoint-interval selection as a multi-agent decision problem, and develop MA-HEAD-Net, an adaptive rule-guided multi-agent deep reinforcement learning framework. MA-HEAD-Net incorporates communication-domain rule priors into a gated multi-head policy, where adaptive gates regulate the contributions of rule-prior and learned-policy logits for different subtasks. The policy and gating components are jointly optimized under multi-agent proximal policy optimization. Simulation results show that MA-HEAD-Net improves policy-formation efficiency compared with representative multi-agent deep reinforcement learning baselines and achieves lower AoI than both learning-based and heuristic methods in dynamic UAV-assisted emergency communication scenarios.

</details>


### [289] [Humans Are More Diverse: Frontier LLMs Show Extreme Policies in Idealised AI Development Races](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01193)
*Phu Hoa Pham,Duy Minh Dao Sy,Trung Kiet Huynh,Phu Quy Nguyen Lam,Chi Nguyen Tran,Minh Trung Le,Phong Hao Le,Dinh Nam Nguyen,Thien Ky Nguyen Dong,Elias Fernandez Domingos,Le Hong Trang,The Anh Han*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究了多智能体LLM在AI开发竞赛中的策略安全行为，强调了在解释行为之前进行审计验证的重要性。通过验证游戏引擎、规则记忆、状态追踪、收益计算等审计门控，发现LLM在规则记忆强但状态追踪和收益计算弱的情况下，行为分析可能失真。研究比较了七个模型端点在2-5人竞赛中的表现，揭示了模型特异性差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI开发竞赛构成一个多智能体安全困境：每家公司可以选择缓慢安全地开发，或冒风险快速推进。然而，仅仅观察到有效行为并不能证明智能体真正理解游戏。许多研究直接将LLM的行为输出视为"战略性的"或"类人的"，而缺乏对模型是否真正理解游戏规则的验证，这可能导致误导性的结论。

Method: 在2至5人博弈竞赛中，采用重复博弈框架研究LLM代理的战略安全行为。研究方法包括：(1) 在行为解释之前设置审计门控，验证游戏引擎、测试规则记忆、状态追踪、收益计算以及在不同但等价任务描述下的稳定性；(2) 将LLM行动序列与进化博弈论基准及已发表的人类数据进行比较；(3) 跨模型、风险条件、人物角色和不同玩家数量进行差异探索。

Result: 审计显示强规则记忆可以与弱状态追踪和期望收益计算共存。提供已验证的算术运算和改变响应表示方式可以改变后续行动，即使游戏规则保持不变。七个测试模型端点的聚合率掩盖了行动序列、对对手的响应以及对竞赛位置的响应中的巨大差异。3-5人竞赛中的模式也是模型特异性的，而非添加竞争者所带来的单一效应。

Conclusion: 多智能体AI竞赛模拟在输出被描述为战略性、类人或安全意识之前，需要有效性检查和轨迹级分析。研究结果具有探索性质，仅适用于所测试的模型、提示和解码设置。

Abstract: An AI development race creates a multi-agent safety dilemma. Each company can develop slowly and safely, or move faster while taking a risk that may remove its final reward. We use this repeated game to study strategic safety behaviour among large language model (LLM) agents in races with two to five players. However, a valid action does not show that an agent understands the game. We therefore place an audit gate before behavioural interpretation. We first verify the game engine, then test rule recall, state tracking, payoff calculation, and stability under different but equivalent task descriptions. We then compare LLM action sequences with an evolutionary game-theory benchmark and published human data, and explore differences across models, risk conditions, personas, and two- to five-player races. The audit shows that strong rule recall can coexist with weak state tracking and expected-payoff calculation. Providing verified arithmetic and changing the response representation can also change later actions, even when the game rules stay fixed. Across seven tested model endpoints, aggregate rates hide large differences in action sequences, responses to opponents, and responses to race position. Patterns across the tested three- to five-player races are also model-specific rather than a single effect of adding competitors. These results show why multi-agent AI-race simulations need validity checks and trajectory-level analysis before their outputs are described as strategic, human-like, or safety-aware. Our findings are exploratory and apply only to the tested models, prompts, and decoding settings.

</details>


### [290] [Reusing Rollouts under Policy Lag: Prefix-Normalized Policy Optimization for LLM Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01418)
*Wenhao Zhang,Yibo Xie,Rui Wang,Jiahua Yang,Lei Jiang,Zibo Yang,Yawei Wang,Jiali Xu,jasperawang,Haoyang Long,Huan Xiong,alantzhao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究了Prefix-Normalized Policy Optimization (PNPO)，它将自回归策略梯度中的累积重要性比率替换为每个因果前缀上似然比的几何均值，以压缩动态范围同时保留前缀依赖。实验表明在四轮策略更新（更off-policy）场景下PNPO优于GSPO，而在单轮更新场景下未能一致超越。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自回归式rollout生成是LLM强化学习中的主要计算成本。复用每批rollout进行多次learner更新可以摊销这一成本，但多次更新会使策略逐渐偏离behavior policy（off-policy问题）。精确的off-policy校正需要累积重要性比率，但其乘积形式会导致动态范围过大、训练不稳定。因此需要一种既能进行校正又数值稳定的方法。

Method: PNPO用因果前缀上似然比率的几何均值替换累积重要性比率。给定token位置，不是乘以整个前缀的累积概率比（乘积形式），而是取每个前缀位置似然比的几何平均，既保留了每个位置上因果前缀的依赖关系，又将log权重的规模压缩（几何均值相当于对对数比率求平均而非求和），缓解了极端动态范围问题。

Result: 在长上下文数学推理实验中，用每批rollout做1次或4次策略更新分别诱导两种不同off-policy程度。单轮更新下PNPO未一致优于GSPO；四轮更新下PNPO在每个基准上达到最高的Avg@32，三个基准独立最优峰值的未加权均值为50.24（比GSPO高3.00个百分点）。在匹配2400次更新的预算下，四轮PNPO在150个rollout批次后达到最终宏平均Avg@32=49.66，与单轮GSPO在600批次后的49.56相当。

Conclusion: 初步证据表明，随着训练进一步偏离on-policy，PNPO能够比GSPO更有效地利用复用rollout进行多次更新，在计算效率（更少的rollout批次）和最终性能方面均有优势。

Abstract: Autoregressive rollout generation is a major computational cost in reinforcement learning for large language models. Reusing each rollout batch for additional learner updates amortizes this cost, but later updates become increasingly off-policy as the learner departs from the behavior policy. At a token position, exact off-policy correction must account for both the current action and the probability of reaching its prefix. The cumulative importance ratio provides this correction, but its product form can produce an unwieldy dynamic range. We study Prefix-Normalized Policy Optimization (PNPO), which replaces the cumulative ratio with the geometric mean of likelihood ratios along each causal prefix, preserving causal-prefix dependence at each position while compressing the log-weight scale. In controlled long-context mathematical reasoning experiments, we induce two off-policy regimes by using one or four policy-update epochs per rollout batch. PNPO does not consistently outperform GSPO with one epoch. With four epochs, it attains the highest observed Avg@32 on each benchmark; the unweighted mean of the three independently selected benchmark peaks is 50.24, 3.00 percentage points above GSPO. Under a matched 2,400-update budget, four-epoch PNPO reaches a final macro Avg@32 of 49.66 after 150 rollout batches, comparable to the 49.56 reached after 600 batches with one epoch. These results provide preliminary evidence that PNPO can be advantageous as training moves further off-policy.

</details>


### [291] [Scoring Rules! Statistical and Strategic Alignment for Text Evaluation Metrics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01423)
*Shengwei Xu,Yuxuan Lu,Yifan Wu,Jason Hartline,Grant Schoenebeck*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出参考型文本评估指标需要同时满足统计对齐（与人类评分相关）和策略对齐（抵抗无任务相关信息扰动），并提出了三个测试原则（人类评分相关性、退化敏感性、操控鲁棒性）以及一个统一的互信息指标设计框架。实验发现LLM-as-a-Judge虽然人类评分相关性高但容易受到操控，而互信息类指标在操控鲁棒性上表现更优，并发现了一个兼具鲁棒性和评分相关性的新指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的参考型文本评估指标通常仅以人类评分的统计相关性作为可靠性标准，但随着这些指标越来越被用作优化目标，仅有统计相关性是不够的——智能体可能策略性地操控（gaming）评估指标以获得虚高分数。因此需要从统计对齐和策略对齐两个互补维度来度量和设计评估指标。

Method: 提出三个测试原则：人类评分的相关性、退化敏感性（惩罚低质量的低努力信息损失）、操控鲁棒性（抵抗策略性的分数膨胀）。同时构建了一个统一的互信息指标设计框架，将现有和新的指标分解为四个选择维度：信息度量方式、估计方法、文本表示和预测机制。

Result: 在同行评审、摘要生成和问答三个任务上，发现高的人类评分相关性并不蕴含策略对齐：LLM-as-a-Judge在相关性上表现优异但易受操控；互信息类指标在操控鲁棒性上显著提升。该框架还揭示了一个在实验中整体鲁棒性最强且人类评分相关性具有竞争力的新指标。

Conclusion: 评估指标的可靠性需要同时考量统计对齐与策略对齐，不能仅以人类评分相关性作为评判标准。互信息基于的指标设计框架为构建既符合人类判断又能抵抗操控的鲁棒评估指标提供了新的方向。

Abstract: Reference-based text evaluation metrics, which are widely used to assess natural language generation systems, score a candidate response by comparing it with a reference response. The reliability of an evaluation metric is usually judged by its statistical correlation with human ratings. However, as these metrics are increasingly used as optimization objectives, correlation alone is no longer sufficient: agents may strategically game the evaluation metric. We study this issue through two complementary notions of alignment. A metric is statistically aligned if it correlates with human ratings and strategically aligned if it resists perturbations that do not add task-relevant information. We make two contributions. First, we propose test principles for reference-based metrics consisting of human-rating correlation, degradation sensitivity, and manipulation robustness. These principles evaluate whether a metric agrees with human judgments, penalizes low-effort information loss, and resists strategic score inflation. Second, we develop a unified design framework for mutual-information-based metrics that decomposes existing and new metrics into four choices: information measure, estimation method, text representation, and prediction mechanism. Across peer review, summarization, and question answering, we find that strong human-rating correlation does not imply strategic alignment: LLM-as-a-Judge achieves high correlation but is susceptible to manipulation. In contrast, mutual-information-based metrics substantially improve manipulation robustness. Our framework also uncovers a new metric that achieves the strongest overall robustness in our experiments while remaining competitive on human-rating correlation.

</details>


### [292] [PolymerGPT: Multi-property Optimization with a Decoder-Based GPT Model for Generative Polymer Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01431)
*Charlie Pyle,Adarsh Gadari,C. Adrian Figg,Zhenquan Jia,Yaohang Li,Chunjiang Zhu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: PolymerGPT是一个基于解码器GPT的生成模型，通过学习条件前缀将多达37种常见聚合物属性整合到生成过程中，支持支架条件，实现多属性同时控制的高分子逆生成设计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 聚合物性质预测已有较多研究，但面向目标性质的逆生成设计方法有限。现有方法仅支持单一性质优化，而精确预测宏观材料行为需要同时控制多个物理性质。

Method: 提出PolymerGPT，一种基于解码器架构的GPT模型，通过学习条件前缀（learned conditioning prefixes）将多达37种聚合物属性纳入生成过程，同时支持支架条件（scaffold condition）约束预测结构。

Result: 实验表明PolymerGPT在无条件生成和条件生成方面均表现优异，保持高有效性、独特性和新颖性。针对五种关键属性进行条件生成时，生成结构的预测值与所有目标属性高度匹配。

Conclusion: PolymerGPT提供了一个可同时控制多种聚合物物理属性的变革性逆生成设计框架，能够高效完成多目标约束下的聚合物结构生成。

Abstract: Polymer property prediction and inverse generative design targeting desired properties are two crucial tasks in machine learning-assisted polymer design. While the former has received considerable attention, there have been limited methods developed for the latter. Existing methods focus on single-property optimization in the generative process, whereas accurate prediction of macroscopic material behavior requires simultaneous control of multiple physical properties. In this paper, we provide a transformative framework for direct optimization of a large collection of polymer properties. We propose PolymerGPT, a decoder-based GPT model that incorporates up to 37 commonly used polymer properties into the generative process via learned conditioning prefixes. It also supports a scaffold condition that specifies a desired scaffold for predicted structures. Our experimental results demonstrate that PolymerGPT achieves exceptional performance for unconditional and conditional generation while maintaining high validity, uniqueness, and novelty. Conditioning on five key properties yields generated structures whose predicted values closely match all target properties simultaneously.

</details>


### [293] [Emergence Invariance: From Symbolized Thought to Interface Refinement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01548)
*Yi Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"符号化—子结构论题"并引入"涌现不变性"概念，形式化证明了大语言模型（LLM）在语言优先的概率架构下，尽管规模递增可以补偿推理缺口（C_s → 0），但固定任务接口必然保留一个正的"接口下限"（R_φ^* > 0），因此涌现无法完全弥补人类认知中缺失的区分。通过DeepSeek V4-Flash的对照实验验证了"接口内扩展"与"接口自身精炼"之间的分离。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM虽在规模扩展下表现出涌现能力（如上下文学习、链式推理、工具使用），但其语言优先的概率架构相对于人类认知存在本质性不完备（实体、基底和高层层面的不完备）。作者希望回答一个哲学与理论层面的核心问题：涌现是否能够补偿每一个缺失的认知区分？

Method: 作者形式化了哲学前提为"符号化—子结构论题"，引入"涌现不变性"概念，建立了尺度索引族通过共享任务接口φ作用的统一形式框架：R_s^* = R_φ^* + C_s。证明了在固定输入律下，一个接口普遍不比另一个信息更少，当且仅当其完备信息σ-域精化另一个；完全补偿当且仅当接口下限与渐近补偿缺口同时消失。该框架统一了接地、记忆、位置、注意力、贝叶斯继承、科学溯因和推理控制等既有结果。实验采用DeepSeek V4-Flash API进行指针追踪（pointer chasing）任务匹配研究。

Result: 实验结果表明：思维启发使指针追踪从0/16提升到14/16（当相关区分可用时）；精确观测孪生仍处于50%的构造下限；恢复决定性记忆使匹配性能从50%提升到100%。结果支持了"在接口内扩展规模"与"精炼接口本身"之间的理论区分。

Conclusion: 涌现可以在一个固定接口内补偿相当程度的推理缺口，但接口下限R_φ^*的存在意味着LLM无法仅凭规模扩展完全模拟人类认知的全部区分。真正的突破性进展需要精炼任务接口（而非仅扩展规模）。该框架为理解LLM与人类认知之间的本质差异提供了统一的理论基础。

Abstract: Language can be viewed as a formalized subset of thought: a consequence-governed symbolic structure projected from wider situated cognition. Large language models trained at scale exhibit compensatory emergence: sparse architectural primitives support in-context learning, multi-step reasoning, tool use, and chain of thought. Yet a language-first probabilistic architecture inherits substantive, substrate, and high-level incompletenesses relative to human cognition. Their coexistence makes an LLM a human-like thought-form generator that reconstructs increasingly human-like reasoning forms from an incomplete substrate. We ask whether emergence can compensate for every missing distinction. We formalize the philosophical premise as the Symbolization--Substructure Thesis and introduce emergence invariance. For a scale-indexed family acting through a shared task interface $φ$, $\mathcal{R}_s^*=\mathcal{R}_φ^*+C_s$: scale can reduce the compensation gap $C_s$, while a positive interface floor $\mathcal{R}_φ^*$ persists. We prove that, under a fixed input law, one interface is universally no less informative exactly when its completed information $σ$-field refines the other, and that total compensation occurs exactly when both the interface floor and asymptotic compensation gap vanish. The framework unifies existing results on grounding, memory, position, attention, Bayesian inheritance, scientific abduction, and reasoning control. In a matched DeepSeek V4-Flash API study, thinking improves pointer chasing from $0/16$ to $14/16$ when relevant distinctions are available; exact observational twins remain at their $50\%$ construction floor; and restoring decisive memory moves matched performance from $50\%$ to $100\%$. These results provide initial evidence for the predicted separation between scaling within an interface and refining the interface itself.

</details>


### [294] [Does the Competitive Component of Adversarial Self-Play Improve Legal Reasoning? A Controlled Negative Result](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01559)
*Miseog Shawn Kim*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文报告了一项对抗性自博弈训练在法律论证任务上的诚实阴性结果：通过可验证的"生存奖励"（引用验证器检查学生与对手的引用真实性）训练出的模型，与完全相同的非竞争性训练相比，在四项独立测试（bootstrap比较、双种子复制、逐案例对抗鲁棒性比较、盲审对决）以及强化对手的后续实验中，均未产生可靠的收益（盲审胜率49%，强化对手实验50%，p值均约为1.000）。早期看似+29%的优势被证实为小样本伪影。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 对抗性自博弈被认为是法律推理训练中一个有吸引力的方法：让学生模型起草论证、对手攻击、学生在其论证幸存时获得奖励。作者设计了基于可验证"生存"奖励的训练信号，并提出了一个关键问题：竞争性成分本身是否在完全相同的非竞争性训练之上带来额外收益。

Method: 设计了一种可验证的"生存"奖励机制，其中学生引用的权威和对手的反权威都由引用验证器检查，以决定生存与否，并自动中和编造的引用。通过四种独立测试（bootstrap比较、两种子复制、配对逐案例对抗鲁棒性比较、盲审头对头判断）以及一个刻意强化对抗者的后续试点实验进行系统评估。

Result: 竞争性成分未产生可靠收益：盲审评判胜率49%（二项检验p≈1.000）；强化对手试点实验胜率50%（32:32，p≈1.000）；早期看似+29%的优势在更多数据上反转，被证明是小样本伪影。

Conclusion: 作者将此报告为诚实的阴性结果，论文价值在于可复现性和具体陷阱的分享：一个初期看似有希望但随数据增加而反转的指标，以及一个一旦对手不再引用与黄金答案相同的权威就静默退化为普通召回率的对抗鲁棒性指标。此零结果与配套编程领域研究一致，表明多教师课程的价值在于构建可验证环境本身，而非竞争。

Abstract: Adversarial self-play is an appealing recipe for legal reasoning: have a student model draft an argument, have an adversary attack it, and reward the student when its argument survives the attack. We designed exactly such a training signal -- a verifiable "survival" reward in which both the student's cited authorities and the adversary's counter-authorities are checked by a citation verifier, so that survival is decided on verified grounds rather than rhetoric, and fabricated citations are automatically neutralized. We then asked a narrow but important question: does the competitive component itself -- the adversary and the survival reward -- add anything on top of an otherwise identical non-competitive training run? Across four independent tests -- a bootstrap comparison, a two-seed replication, a paired per-case adversarial-robustness comparison, and a blinded head-to-head judgment of generated arguments, plus a follow-up pilot with a deliberately strengthened self-play adversary -- the competitive component produced no reliable benefit. The blinded judgment gave a 49% win rate (binomial p approx. 1.000); the strengthened-adversary pilot gave a 50% win rate (32:32, p approx. 1.000). An early apparent +29% advantage reversed and proved to be a small-sample artifact. We report this as an honest negative result. The value of the paper is reproducibility and the sharing of concrete pitfalls: an initially promising metric that inverted on more data, and an adversarial-robustness metric that silently collapsed to plain recall once the adversary stopped citing the same authorities as the gold answer. This null is consistent with, and reconfirms in the legal domain, the conclusion of the companion coding-domain study (Kim, 2026, arXiv:2607.08255) that the value of multi-teacher curricula arises from constructing a verifiable environment rather than from competition itself.

</details>


### [295] [LongCat Sparse Attention: Taming the Lightning via Streaming-aware Hierarchical Cross-Layer Indexing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01662)
*Wen Zan,Jiaqi Zhang,Jianchao Tan,Hong Liu,Cunguang Wang,Xiang Li,Duyue Ma,Guanyu Wu,Yifan Lu,Fengcun Li,Yerui Sun,Peng Pei,Yuchen Xie,Xunliang Cai*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出LongCat Sparse Attention (LSA)，一个硬件-算法协同设计的稀疏注意力框架，通过三种正交策略（流感知索引、跨层索引、层级索引）解决DeepSeek Sparse Attention (DSA)中Lightning Indexer的O(L²)计算开销和硬件不友好的内存访问模式问题。在69B-A3B到560B-A27B规模的模型上，LSA达到与全注意力相当的性能，支持百万token上下文训练，并支撑了LongCat-2.0 (1.6T-A48B)的开发。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DeepSeek Sparse Attention (DSA)通过Lightning Indexer实现了高效的长上下文建模，但实际部署仍受限于两个关键瓶颈：Indexer昂贵的O(L²)评分开销，以及其输出导致的内存访问模式硬件不高效（非连续访问）。这些系统级瓶颈严重制约了DSA在长上下文场景中的实际部署和规模化应用。

Method: LSA采用三种互补且正交的策略：(1) Streaming-Aware Indexing：将散乱的KV条目转换为硬件对齐的连续内存布局，实现合并的HBM访问；(2) Cross-Layer Indexing：通过跨层蒸馏，让单层的索引结果在连续层间复用，摊销索引开销；(3) Hierarchical Indexing：采用由粗到细的评分方案，逐步缩小每个查询的候选集，大幅降低索引计算量。

Result: 在从69B-A3B到560B-A27B的广泛规模实验中，LSA在通用和长上下文基准上均达到与全注意力相当的性能。LSA支持多达一百万token上下文长度的原生训练，并支撑了LongCat-2.0 (1.6T-A48B)模型的开发。此外，开源了集成LSA的LongCat-Flash-Lite-Sparse (69B-A3B)及更新的长上下文训练语料。

Conclusion: LSA作为一个硬件-算法协同设计的框架，有效解决了DSA的系统级瓶颈，在不牺牲性能的前提下显著提升了长上下文稀疏注意力的硬件效率，验证了大规模高效长上下文建模方案的可行性，并为工业级部署提供了完整的技术路径。

Abstract: DeepSeek Sparse Attention (DSA) enables efficient long-context modeling through its Lightning Indexer. However, practical deployment remains constrained by the indexer's expensive $O(L^2)$ scoring overhead and the hardware-inefficient, discontinuous memory-access patterns induced by its outputs. To address these system-level bottlenecks, we introduce LongCat Sparse Attention (LSA), a hardware-algorithm co-designed framework comprising three complementary and orthogonal strategies: (1) Streaming-Aware Indexing, which selectively converts scattered KV entries into hardware-aligned contiguous layouts to enable coalesced HBM access; (2) Cross-Layer Indexing, which amortizes indexing overhead by reusing the results produced by a single layer across consecutive layers, supported by cross-layer distillation; and (3) Hierarchical Indexing, which adopts a coarse-to-fine scoring scheme to progressively narrow the candidate set for each query, thereby substantially reducing indexing computation. Extensive scaling experiments, ranging from 69B-A3B to 560B-A27B models, demonstrate that LSA consistently achieves performance on par with full attention across both general-purpose and long-context benchmarks. Moreover, LSA supports native training with context lengths of up to one million tokens and underpins the development of LongCat-2.0 (1.6T-A48B). To facilitate further research, we also introduce and open-source LongCat-Flash-Lite-Sparse (69B-A3B), which integrates LSA into LongCat-Flash-Lite and incorporates an updated long-context training corpus.

</details>


### [296] [ReasonCast: Towards Explainable Time Series Forecasting with Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01875)
*Seunghan Lee,Jun Seo,Jaehoon Lee,Junhyeok Kang,Sangjun Han,Sungdong Yoo,Minjae Kim,Tae Yoon Lim,Dongwan Kang,Hwanil Choi,Soonyoung Lee,Wonbin Ahn*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出任务融合的时间序列（TS）模型范式，将数值预测（生成）与可解释文本推理（理解）集成到单一自回归响应中。作者引入ReasonTS-Bench基准（识别TS的五个基本模式）和ReasonCast微调配方（使任意LLM联合执行两项任务）。实验表明ReasonCast在预测精度上优于LLM和专用TS模型，同时产生可验证的因果推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有TS模型要么专精理解（返回文本）要么专精生成（返回数值预测），即使最新的统一模型也将两种输出作为任务分离的路径处理，无法在单一连贯响应中同时预测序列并解释预测原因。作者主张任务融合模型，将数值TS预测与可解释文本推理集成在同一响应中。

Method: 1) 提出ReasonTS-Bench基准：识别TS中五种基本模式，实现两个任务的联合评估；2) 提出ReasonCast配方：通过微调任意LLM使其在单次自回归前向传播中同时生成推理链与数值预测。

Result: ReasonCast在预测准确率上同时优于LLM和专用TS模型，并生成可验证的因果推理。代码已开源。

Conclusion: 任务融合范式被证明可行：统一架构能够同时完成TS数值预测与文本自我解释，且不牺牲预测精度，为TS模型设计提供了新方向。

Abstract: Most time series (TS) models are specialized for a single task, either understanding (i.e., returning text answers about a TS) or generation (i.e., returning a numeric forecast). Only recently have unified models begun to handle the two within a single architecture. Even these models, however, produce the two outputs as task-separated paths and cannot predict a series and explain why that prediction arises within a single coherent response. In this paper, we argue for a task-fused model that jointly produces 1) prediction (generation) and 2) selfexplanation (understanding), thereby integrating 1) numerical TS forecasting and 2) interpretable text reasoning within a single response. To enable the systematic study of this capability, we present both a benchmark and a recipe that jointly address the two tasks. The benchmark, ReasonTS-Bench, identifies five fundamental patterns underlying TS and enables the joint evaluation of both tasks. ReasonCast, our recipe for finetuning any LLM to perform both tasks jointly, yields a model that generates a reasoning chain and a forecast together in a single autoregressive pass. Extensive experiments show that ReasonCast outperforms both LLMs and TS models on prediction accuracy while producing verifiable, causal reasoning. Code is available at: https://github.com/seunghan96/reasoncast.

</details>


### [297] [Instruction-Conditioned Exploration with Asymmetric Reinforcement Learning and Self-Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02087)
*Jim Dilkes,Vahid Yazdanpanah,Sebastian Stein*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出指令条件探索（ICE）方法，通过向训练任务提示补充多种不同指令来增加LLM推理行为的覆盖范围，并结合非对称RL/SD训练目标（结合强化学习和自蒸馏）来迁移探索到的行为到无条件测试时策略。在数学推理任务上，ICE使Qwen3-1.7B在4K响应长度的held-out pass@1上相对DAPO训练提升5.0%，且在8K上下文下依然保持改进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 使用RL对LLM进行后训练已成为提升模型能力的重要工具，但LLM动作空间的结构与经典RL不同，带来了独特的探索挑战。需要新方法利用预训练LLM的广泛知识和灵活性，在训练时有意识地生成多样化经验，以提升模型的探索能力。

Method: 提出两种方法：(1) Instruction-Conditioned Exploration (ICE) —— 在训练期间向任务提示补充多种不同的指令，增加尝试行为（behaviours）的覆盖率；(2) Asymmetric-RL/SD —— 一种结合强化学习和自蒸馏（Self-Distillation）的训练目标，用于将探索到的多样化行为迁移到无条件的测试时策略。

Result: ICE配合Asymmetric-RL/SD目标在数学推理任务上，使Qwen3-1.7B在4K响应长度下held-out pass@1性能相对DAPO训练提升5.0%，且在更长的8K上下文环境下改进依然存在。

Conclusion: ICE通过指令条件化探索结合非对称RL/SD目标，有效解决了LLM在RL后训练中探索不足的问题，并能在测试时保持无条件下策略的性能提升，表明该方法是提升LLM RL训练探索效率的有效途径。

Abstract: Post-training Large Language Models (LLMs) with Reinforcement Learning (RL) has become an important tool for improving model capabilities, but the LLM action-space structure introduces challenges distinct from classical RL, with implications for inducing exploration. New methods are required that leverage the broad knowledge and flexibility of pre-trained LLMs to deliberately generate diverse experience at training time. We propose Instruction-Conditioned Exploration (ICE), which supplements task prompts during training with one of several distinct instructions, increasing the coverage of behaviours attempted. To facilitate ICE, we propose Asymmetric-RL/SD, a combined Reinforcement Learning and Self-Distillation training objective, to transfer explored behaviours to the unconditioned test-time policy. ICE with the Asymmetric-RL/SD objective improves Qwen3-1.7B held-out pass@1 performance at $4$K response length on mathematical reasoning tasks by $5.0\%$ relative to training with DAPO, with improvement persisting at a longer 8K context.

</details>


### [298] [Trustworthy AI in Digital Health: A Comprehensive Review of Robustness and Explainability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02238)
*Abdullah Mamun,Shovito Barua Soumma,Hassan Ghasemzadeh*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文系统综述了数字健康领域可信AI的关键维度，重点聚焦鲁棒性和可解释性，提出了一个涵盖技术方法、实际挑战和解决方案的结构化框架，并涉及ICU、新生儿健康和代谢健康等具体应用场景。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可信AI是AI系统安全融入数字健康等高风险领域的关键，而现有文献虽从不同方面讨论了可信AI，但针对医疗健康场景下的鲁棒性和可解释性缺乏聚焦的系统综述。本文旨在填补这一空白。

Method: 本文按三部分组织：1）介绍可信AI的支柱（鲁棒性、可解释性、公平性、问责性、隐私）及数字健康背景下的技术和伦理挑战；2）探讨ICU、新生儿健康和代谢健康等领域的特定信任考量；3）综述提升数据稀缺和分布偏移下鲁棒性的近期技术进展，以及从特征归因到梯度解释和反事实解释的可解释AI方法，并讨论了LLM时代可信AI系统开发及评估指标。

Result: 本文提供了一份结构化的综述，涵盖了数字健康领域鲁棒性和可解释性的方法、挑战与解决方案，并详细讨论了相关贡献、面向LLM的可信AI发展以及评估鲁棒性、有效性、保真度和多样性等信任参数的指标。

Conclusion: 本文为数字健康领域的研究者和从业者提供了一份系统化的参考资料，支持其开发可靠且可解释的AI解决方案，未来方向包括在LLM时代进一步完善可信AI的框架与实践。

Abstract: Ensuring trust in AI systems is essential for the safe and ethical integration of machine learning systems into high-stakes domains such as digital health. Key dimensions, including robustness, explainability, fairness, accountability, and privacy, need to be addressed throughout the AI lifecycle, from problem formulation and data collection to model deployment and human interaction. While various contributions address different aspects of trustworthy AI, a focused synthesis on robustness and explainability, especially tailored to the healthcare context, remains limited. This review addresses that need by organizing recent advancements into an accessible framework, highlighting both technical and practical considerations. We present a structured overview of methods, challenges, and solutions, aiming to support researchers and practitioners in developing reliable and explainable AI solutions for digital health. This review article is organized into three main parts. First, we introduce the pillars of trustworthy AI and discuss the technical and ethical challenges, particularly in the context of digital health. Second, we explore application-specific trust considerations across domains such as intensive care, neonatal health, and metabolic health, highlighting how robustness and explainability support trust. Lastly, we present recent advancements in techniques aimed at improving robustness under data scarcity and distributional shifts, as well as explainable AI methods ranging from feature attribution to gradient-based interpretations and counterfactual explanations. This paper is further enriched with detailed discussions of the contributions toward robustness and explainability in digital health, the development of trustworthy AI systems in the era of LLMs, and various evaluation metrics for measuring trust and related parameters such as validity, fidelity, and diversity.

</details>


### [299] [Self-Certification of Representation Adequacy: Sequential Certification at Minimum Task Loss](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02267)
*Zijie Huang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一个四层理论框架，用于解决基于压缩历史表征行动的智能体所面临的"表征充分性自证"问题。该框架涵盖静态验证、顺序最优停止、认证复杂度下界与策略，以及边界层（明确区分固定核保证与表征修复的开放性）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能体若基于压缩表征行动，当表征将具有不同最优行动的历史混为一谈（aliasing）时，任何基于该表征的可测规则都会产生不可约的每回合损失，且智能体无法从自身记录中检测此问题。这构成了结构性的安全风险。

Method: 四层理论构建：(1) 静态层：通过贝叶斯风险分组恒等式定义决策论充分性，并以精确全变差阈值定价一次性外部验证；(2) 顺序层：将认证建模为以任务损失为货币的最优停止问题，通过覆盖线性规划定义环境级认证复杂度常数，给出信息-任务损失下界（对所有delta-正确策略），并提出Certification Track-and-Stop策略使成本渐近匹配下界；(3) 最终边界层：给出显式核切换示例，识别覆盖策略切换或表征修复所需的开放定理。

Result: 证明了两个主要定理（信息-任务损失下界与Track-and-Stop策略的渐近最优性），并在附录中给出完整证明。边界层明确不声称固定核保证可扩展到表征修订。

Conclusion: 该工作为表征充分性的自认证提供了完整的理论框架，确立了静态验证与顺序认证的复杂度刻画，同时诚实地标识出表征修复场景下仍需解决的开放理论问题。

Abstract: Agents that act on a compressed representation of their history face a structural risk: if the representation aliases histories with different optimal actions, no rule measurable with respect to the representation can avoid an irreducible per-round loss, and the agent may be unable to detect this from its own transcript. This paper develops a four-layer theory of self-certification of representation adequacy. The static layer defines decision-theoretic adequacy through a Bayes-risk grouping identity and prices a one-shot external verification by an exact total-variation threshold. The sequential layer poses certification as an optimal-stopping problem in the currency of task loss: we define an environment-wise certification complexity constant through a covering linear program, prove an information-task-loss lower bound for every delta-correct strategy, and give a Certification Track-and-Stop policy whose cost matches the bound asymptotically. A final boundary layer gives an explicit kernel-switching example and identifies the open theorem needed to cover policy switching or representation repair; it does not claim that the fixed-kernel guarantees extend to representation revision. The proofs of the two main theorems are given in full in the appendices.

</details>


### [300] [Trajectories That Segment Themselves: Agent-Declared Boundaries as a Training Unit](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02302)
*Jingxi Wei*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"采集时语义自分割"（collection-time semantic self-segmentation）协议：在长程编码智能体轨迹生成过程中，由声明性契约（declarative contract）使智能体主动暴露自身操作边界，从而将长轨迹切分为语义阶段。该方法无需里程碑词汇表、金标准补丁、环境回放、教师logits或回溯分割器。由于智能体以名称标注其猜想，评审者可按名否定之，从而可制造"错误原因-修正"转换对，一个采集即可产生四种监督目标。实验表明分割后的阶段具有语义一致性（归因准确率超过随机两倍），DPO训练在此分割上可带来正确方向的改进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长程编码智能体的轨迹与其可用的训练信用单元之间存在严重不匹配：单个动作没有稳定价值，整条轨迹的标签混入了有效探索与废弃方向，固定窗口切割则与日志记录机制脱节。现有监督信号（如金标准补丁、教师logits）无法在该粒度上提供有效学习信号，因此需要一种能够在采集时自然产生边界与语义单元的方法。

Method: 采用声明性契约使运行中的智能体在轨迹生成时自主暴露语义边界，形成变量长度的语义阶段（variable-length semantic phases）。协议要求智能体以名称标注其猜想（hypothesis），使评审者能按名否定之，从而天然产生"错误原因-修正"（wrong-cause-then-correction）的转换样本。一次采集可得到四种监督目标：阶段标签、边界、修正转换对、以及针对失败区域的审计监督。

Result: 1）在给定切割点但无假设的条件下，模型将动作块归属到其支配假设的准确率超过随机两倍（配对符号检验p=0.0002），且通过词法对照、随标签置换而坍塌；2）边界放置任务中，代码盲注标注者匹配24/40，随机放置匹配11.5，而机械测试事件规则在严格到宽松的扫描范围两端均未超过随机；3）DPO在2,551个阶段边界对上训练，对91个对抗性保留项不改变任何决策，对60个匹配结构项中4个从错误改为正确，而两个对照不改变任何项。

Conclusion: 语义自分割产生的阶段具有一致性与非平凡性（coherent且非廉价可复制），无法被简单的规则或词法线索替代。分割后的阶段边界本身已经是有效的训练信号，DPO受益于此但下一步改进应集中在语料多样性而非边界质量上。该框架为长程智能体训练提供了超越单一episode标签的、更细粒度且因果合理的监督单元。

Abstract: Long-horizon coding-agent trajectories are poorly matched to the credit units available to train on: a single action has no stable value, an episode label merges productive exploration with abandoned directions, and a fixed window cuts where the logging mechanics fall. We introduce collection-time semantic self-segmentation, in which a declarative contract has the acting agent expose its own boundaries while the trajectory is generated. Instantiated with falsifiable causal hypotheses, successive adoptions expose variable-length semantic phases, and no milestone vocabulary, gold patch, environment replay, teacher logits, or retrospective segmenter places a boundary.
