Because the agent names its conjecture, a reviewer can negate it by name, which lets our protocol manufacture wrong-cause-then-correction transitions that recorded work rarely contains; one collection then yields four supervised targets, including audit supervision from exactly the failed regions an episode label discards. We then ask what survives deleting the declaration. Given the cut points but not the hypothesis, a model attributes action blocks to their governing hypothesis at over twice chance, beating equal-length blocks over the same trajectories (paired sign test $p = 0.0002$), surviving a lexical control and collapsing under label permutation. Asked instead to place boundaries, a code-blind annotator matches 24 of 40 where random placement matches 11.5, while a mechanical test-event rule beats chance at neither end of a strict-to-permissive sweep. The segments are therefore coherent and not cheaply reproducible. Downstream, DPO on 2,551 phase-boundary pairs changes no decision on 91 adversarial held-out items, while four of 60 change on matched-construction items, all wrong to right, where two controls change none: with 1,825 pairs from one generator, the variable to vary next is corpus diversity, not the boundary.

</details>


### [301] [Hard Constraints, Smooth Gradients: Learning Feasible Inventory Policies via Differentiable Projection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02343)
*Patrick Helm,Jan-Niklas Doerr,Joren Gijsbrechts,Stefan Minner*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种将可微凸优化模块嵌入深度强化学习策略的新方法，通过神经网络生成连续动作目标、二次规划投影到松弛可行集、对偶整型映射恢复整数性，从而在具有相互依赖硬约束的随机序列决策问题中同时实现MILP的约束灵活性和DRL的可扩展性。在多级生产库存规划中，该方法在小型实例上最优性差距低于1%，在大型网络中优于最先进的echelon base-stock策略最高9.75%，并在ASML工业案例中降低平均成本达3.22%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 许多实际运营问题是具有大规模组合动作空间和相互依赖可行性约束的序列决策过程。MILP能灵活处理此类约束但在随机环境中扩展性差；DRL虽具可扩展性但现有方法要么惩罚约束而非强制执行，要么依赖在约束交互时会失效的可行性机制。亟需一种方法能够兼取两者之长。

Method: 在策略内嵌入一个可微凸优化模块：1）神经网络提出连续动作目标；2）二次规划将动作投影到松弛可行集；3）对偶信息整型映射恢复整型性并保持可行性。利用路径梯度从采样轨迹中进行端到端训练，无需依赖精确整数投影即可实现有界误差的可行性执行，并确保整个可行动作空间可达。

Result: 在小型多级生产库存实例中平均最优性差距低于1%；在大型网络中，相比顶尖echelon base-stock策略提升最高9.75%，比滚动时域多阶段随机规划至少提升7.7%；ASML工业案例中相比最优基准策略平均成本降低3.22%，且在容量受限、需求波动大的最难规划场景中节省最显著。

Conclusion: 该工作表明DRL能够在具有相互依赖硬约束的序列决策问题中带来显著的经济性改进。这种问题在实践中广泛存在，方法架起了MILP约束灵活性与DRL可扩展性之间的桥梁，具有广泛的工业应用前景。

Abstract: Many operational problems are constrained sequential decision processes with large, combinatorial action spaces and interdependent feasibility constraints. Mixed-integer linear programs (MILPs) handle such constraints flexibly but scale poorly in stochastic environments. Deep reinforcement learning (DRL) promises scalable decision rules, but existing methods either penalize constraints rather than enforce them, or rely on feasibility mechanisms that break down once constraints interact. We bridge this gap by embedding a differentiable convex optimization module inside the policy: a neural network proposes continuous action targets, a quadratic program projects them onto the relaxed feasible set, and a dual-informed integer mapping restores integrality while preserving feasibility. Given a differentiable simulator, the policy trains end to end from sampled trajectories using pathwise gradients, while handling hard constraints with similar flexibility to MILPs. We show that our feasibility enforcement has bounded error relative to an exact integer projection and ensures the entire feasible action space is reachable. We apply the method to multi-echelon production-inventory planning under shared resource and material constraints. Our policy attains an average optimality gap below 1% on small instances. It further outperforms state-of-the-art echelon base-stock policies by up to 9.75% and a rolling-horizon multi-stage stochastic program by at least 7.7% in larger networks. On an industry-scale case study from ASML, it reduces average cost by up to 3.22% relative to the best-known benchmark policy. The savings are largest where planning is hardest: in tightly capacitated systems with high demand variability. More broadly, our work shows that DRL can deliver economically significant savings in sequential decision problems with interdependent hard constraints, which are widespread in practice.

</details>


### [302] [Faster-WAM: Do World Action Models Need Deep Action Modules?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02365)
*Liheng Ma,Rui Heng Yang,Zhanguang Zhang,Mateo Clemente,Ziwen Hu,Tongtong Cao,Yingxue Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出DoT（Dock of Transformer）架构设计原则和其WAM实例化Faster-WAM，通过将预训练视频Transformer作为表征中枢并dock轻量级输出头，解耦动作头深度与视频骨干深度，在仅66.5ms/次推理延迟下（较Fast-WAM提速3.2×）实现与现有WAM相当的LIBERO和RoboTwin 2.0性能及更强的分布外泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有World Action Models（WAMs）采用shared-backbone或Mixture-of-Transformers设计，动作模块深度被绑定在视频骨干深度上，导致大量计算开销和高推理延迟。作者希望解耦动作模块与视频骨干的深度耦合，实现灵活的头设计并降低延迟。

Method: 提出DoT设计原则：将预训练视频Transformer视作表征中枢（hub），通过docking interfaces连接轻量级输出头，可访问骨干所有层的表征。Faster-WAM是该原则的实例化，在30层视频骨干上dock单层动作头，docking interface融合所有视频层的keys和values并应用RoPE realignment。

Result: Faster-WAM在无额外具身预训练的情况下，在LIBERO和RoboTwin 2.0上取得竞争性性能，并在LIBERO-Plus上展示强分布外泛化能力。端到端推理延迟仅66.5ms，较Fast-WAM提速3.2×，在受控比较中延迟最低。

Conclusion: 视频中心的DoT架构支持灵活的任务特定head设计，同时实现低推理延迟、强动作预测性能和稳健泛化，验证了解耦动作模块深度与视频骨干深度这一设计思路的有效性。

Abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) couple robot action prediction with video world models. Existing WAMs with shared-backbone and Mixture-of-Transformers designs generally tie the depth of the action module to that of the video backbone, resulting in substantial computational overhead and high inference latency. To address this limitation, we introduce Dock of Transformer (DoT), a video-centric design principle that treats a pretrained video Transformer as a representation hub and connects lightweight output-heads through docking interfaces. This enables flexible output-head design while providing direct access to representations from all layers of the backbone. We then introduce \textbf{Faster-WAM}, an instantiation of DoT for WAMs, which docks a single-layer action head onto a 30-layer video backbone. The docking interface fuses keys and values from all video layers and applies RoPE realignment. Without additional embodied pretraining, Faster-WAM achieves competitive performance on LIBERO and RoboTwin 2.0 while demonstrating strong out-of-distribution generalization on LIBERO-Plus. Faster-WAM also achieves the lowest end-to-end latency in our controlled comparison, requiring only 66.5 ms per inference --- a \(3.2\times\) speedup over Fast-WAM. Overall, these results demonstrate that the video-centric DoT architecture supports flexible task-specific head design while delivering low inference latency, strong action-prediction performance, and robust generalization.

</details>


### [303] [Cooperative Coevolution for Resource-Constrained Agentic LLM Post-Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02391)
*Zhiyuan Wang,Shengcai Liu,Jiahao Wu,Ning Lu,Hui Ouyang,Shaofeng Zhang,Haoze Lv,Ke Tang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出Cooperative Parameter-subspace Evolution Strategy (CoPES)，一种合作协同进化方法，将全参数空间分解为低维子空间并进行合作搜索，以提高工具使用LLM智能体后训练的优化效率。在GPU时间预算相同时，CoPES恢复了GRPO验证精度增益的92%（标准ES仅67%），且理论GPU内存需求不到全参数GRPO的1/8，在多个基准上持续优于标准ES和LoRA-based GRPO。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工具使用的大语言模型智能体产生长序列、多轮轨迹，基于梯度的后训练内存开销巨大。进化策略(ES)虽然可以避免反向传播、实现内存高效的全参数后训练，但在资源受限场景下（仅少量GPU）其高GPU小时需求导致训练时间过长，难以实际应用。因此需要一种既能保持内存高效性又能提升优化效率、缩短训练时间的方法。

Method: CoPES采用合作协同进化（cooperative coevolution）的方式：将全参数空间分解为多个低维子空间，各子空间独立进化，并通过合作机制协同搜索全局最优解，从而提升优化效率、加速收敛，同时保持ES无需反向传播的内存高效特性。

Result: 在Qwen3.5-4B工具使用智能体的数学任务上，对5个不同难度的基准进行评估：在全参数GRPO最优验证检查点的GPU时间预算下，CoPES恢复了GRPO验证精度增益的92%（标准ES仅67%）；理论GPU内存需求不到全参数GRPO的1/8；在所有基准的pass@k指标上一致优于标准ES和LoRA-based GRPO；在问答任务上也有额外优势。

Conclusion: CoPES在资源受限条件下为智能体LLM后训练提供了改进的内存与训练时间权衡，兼顾内存效率与性能恢复率，是一种实用的替代方案。

Abstract: Tool-using large language model (LLM) agents produce long, multi-turn trajectories, making gradient-based post-training memory-intensive. Evolution strategies (ES) enable memory-efficient full-parameter post-training without backpropagation and can eventually match the performance of gradient-based reinforcement learning (RL). However, resource-constrained settings typically offer only a few GPUs, so the high GPU-hour requirements of ES translate into prohibitively long training times. To address this, we introduce Cooperative Parameter-subspace Evolution Strategy (CoPES), a cooperative coevolutionary method that decomposes the full parameter space into lower-dimensional subspaces and searches over them cooperatively to improve optimization efficiency. We post-train a Qwen3.5-4B tool-using agent for the math task and evaluate it on five benchmarks of varying difficulty. Under the GPU-hour budget of full-parameter GRPO's best validation checkpoint, CoPES recovers 92% of GRPO's validation-accuracy gain, versus 67% for standard ES, while its theoretical GPU memory requirement is less than one-eighth that of full-parameter GRPO. It consistently outperforms standard ES and LoRA-based GRPO on all evaluated pass@k metrics across the five benchmarks. Additional experiments further show the advantage of CoPES on the question-answering task. These results demonstrate an improved trade-off between memory requirements and training time for agentic LLM post-training under resource constraints. The code is open-sourced in https://github.com/MetaronWang/CoPES

</details>


### [304] [Real-Time Detection and Repair of LLM Agent Failures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02464)
*Sunny Dubey*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于遥测数据（每步约200微秒）的轻量级LLM代理故障检测方法：采用一类回声状态网络集成+CUSUM告警，在2823个真实代理回合中达到0.71召回率（5%误报预算，AUROC 0.872）；叠加确定性验证层后误报为零；并将检测闭环到修复，使任务成功率从52%提升至73%，每回合仅需约一次额外模型调用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM代理在任务执行中经常中途失败（死循环、级联工具错误、目标漂移、结果编造、内容污染等），而标准的补救措施——用第二个LLM逐步骤评判——代价甚至高于代理本身。作者希望探索仅依赖步骤遥测数据（每步仅需微秒级开销）能实现多大程度的故障检测，且监控器只在健康运行上训练。

Method: 方法包含两层检测：(1) 学习型监控——一类回声状态网络（one-class ESN）集成结合CUSUM告警，仅用健康轨迹训练，基于可观测的逐步遥测数据检测异常；(2) 确定性验证——重算运行声称的总结果与代理实际收到的工具输出是否一致，并确认所有必要调用均已执行。检测后通过回滚+实时重跑将故障闭环为修复。

Result: 在三个框架、三个本地模型（qwen2.5 7b/3b、llama3.1 8b）及一个商业API（gemini-2.5-flash）上的2823个代理回合中：ESN集成检测到0.71的失败（5%误报预算，AUROC 0.872），优势随事后时间窗口增加而单调上升（+0.09至+0.40）；跨语料库无需重训迁移（AFTraj-2K 0.745、ATBench 0.779）；学习型监控需每部署的健康零假设校准（冷启动0.527 vs 重校准0.885）；确定性验证以0/63误报捕获60%的失败；修复环节恢复45%的失败，任务成功率从52%提升至73%。

Conclusion: 仅靠微秒级遥测监控即可实现有意义的代理故障检测，与昂贵的LLM评判相比降低三到四个数量级开销；确定性验证作为零误报补充层，可将检测闭环到实际修复，显著提升任务成功率。该方案在保持跨模型、跨语料库泛化性的同时，以极小成本实现可部署的代理可靠性保障。

Abstract: LLM agents fail mid-episode -- they loop, cascade tool errors, drift off goal, fabricate results, or silently absorb corrupted content -- and the standard remedy, judging every step with a second LLM, costs more than the agent itself. We ask how much detection is achievable from observable step telemetry alone, using monitors costing microseconds per step and trained only on healthy runs.
  On 2,823 committed agent episodes across three frameworks, three local models (qwen2.5 7b/3b, llama3.1 8b) and a commercial API (gemini-2.5-flash), a one-class echo-state-network ensemble with CUSUM alarms detects 0.71 of failures at a 5% false-alarm budget (AUROC 0.872). Its advantage over a memoryless baseline is a monotone function of post-onset horizon (+0.09 at <=3 steps, +0.40 at >=9), predicting its own failure region out of sample on AFTraj-2K. Ranking transfers with no retraining to two corpora from other groups (AFTraj-2K 0.745, ATBench 0.779).
  Monitors carry two burdens: a per-deployment healthy null (they do not transfer -- AUROC 0.527 cold against 0.885 recalibrated) and a residual false-alarm rate. We add a layer carrying neither: deterministic verification, which recomputes a run's stated total from the tool results it actually received and confirms every required call was made. Head-to-head it catches 60% of failures (96% with the coverage check) at 0 of 63 false positives against the monitor's 54% at 17%, transfers unchanged to llama3.1:8b (110 of 110 at 0 of 10), and trips on 0 of 1825 healthy episodes.
  Detection is then closed into repair: each flagged run is rolled back and re-run live, recovering 45% of failures against a 16% resampling control (p=0.0005) and lifting task success from 52% to 73% for about one extra model call per run. The system runs at ~200 microseconds per step, three orders of magnitude below a judge call. Code, traces and results are released.

</details>


### [305] [Optimizing Minimax Regret in Uncertain MDPs with Small Sets of Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02509)
*Sterre Lutz,Daniël Vos,Matthijs T. J. Spaan,Anna Lukina*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出k可适应性策略综合（k-adaptable policy synthesis）问题，在不确定马尔可夫决策过程（UMDP）中预先准备k个策略，模型不确定性在执行前才被解决，采用极小化最大遗憾（minimax-regret）目标来优化这k个策略的集合。作者证明该问题是NP-hard的，并提出KAPS精确嵌套分支定界算法，实验表明从1个策略增加到2个策略时遗憾下降最大，且单策略场景下KAPS在解质量和最优性证明能力上优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实中的序贯决策常面临环境模型的不确定性，UMDP用一组共享状态和动作但转移概率和奖励可能不同的MDP来表示可能的环境。单一策略在所有MDP上可能牺牲性能，而为每个MDP单独优化策略又可能违反运营、监管或可解释性对策略数量的限制。因此需要在不完全建模所有环境的情况下，预先准备有限数量的策略，在不确定性解除后选择最合适的一个。

Method: 将问题形式化为k-adaptable policy synthesis，在minimax-regret目标下优化一组k个策略，并联合决定哪些MDP共享同一个策略以及策略本身。作者证明该问题是NP-hard的，并设计了KAPS，一种精确的嵌套分支定界算法，结合了问题特定的界和启发式方法。

Result: 在多种UMDP基准实验上，KAPS表现出：最大的遗憾下降通常发生在策略数量从1增加到2时；在单策略设置中，KAPS在解质量上与现有方法竞争力相当，且能显著更频繁地证明最优性。

Conclusion: KAPS为不确定性环境下的策略预备问题提供了精确求解方案，有效权衡了性能与策略数量约束之间的冲突，为实际应用中如何在有限策略预算内做出最优决策提供了理论保证和实用算法。

Abstract: Sequential decision-making in real-world applications often involves uncertainty about the environment's model. Uncertain Markov decision processes (UMDPs) represent the possible environments as a set of MDPs with shared states and actions but potentially different transition probabilities and rewards. Optimizing a single policy across all possible MDPs may sacrifice performance, while preparing an individually optimized policy for every MDP may violate operational, regulatory, or interpretability constraints on the number of policies that can be prepared and deployed. We consider settings in which model uncertainty is resolved shortly before execution, allowing the most suitable policy to be selected from a limited set prepared in advance. We introduce $k$-adaptable policy synthesis, which optimizes such a set of $k$ policies under a minimax-regret objective. We prove that the problem is NP-hard and develop KAPS, an exact nested branch-and-bound algorithm with problem-specific bounds and heuristics. KAPS jointly optimizes which MDPs share a policy and the policies themselves. Experiments across various UMDP benchmarks show that the largest reduction in regret consistently occurs when increasing from one to two policies. In the single-policy setting, KAPS is competitive with existing methods in solution quality and proves optimality substantially more often.

</details>


### [306] [Linguistic Context Recodes Visual Representations in Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00035)
*Brian Song,Michael A. Lepori,Ellie Pavlick*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文通过因果干预实验证明了视觉-语言模型（VLM）中语言提示能够动态重编码视觉表征，具体表现为两种机制：抽象参考表征（识别目标相关对象）和属性调制（放大目标相关属性），反驳了视觉token作为静态信息存储的传统观点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 以往研究将VLM中的视觉表征视为静态的信息存储库，由语言表征进行操控，但对语言如何主动改变视觉表征的机制缺乏清晰刻画。作者希望揭示目标导向语言是否以及在何种机制下能够主动重编码视觉表征，从而更准确地理解跨模态处理过程。

Method: 首先，通过提取对比转向向量（contrastive steering vectors）来识别抽象的参考表征，该表征编码了自然语言提示下哪些对象与目标相关，并通过因果干预验证其对模型预测的因果作用。其次，在后层网络中使用表征分析证明语言诱导的属性调制——特定层选择性放大目标相关属性，并通过因果干预证明该调制中介了VLM的响应分布。实验覆盖多种提示、不同对象、不同任务场景，并从合成图像推广到自然图像。

Result: 发现两种具体的语言诱导视觉表征重编码实例：(1) 抽象的参考表征在不同对象、任务语境乃至从合成到自然图像中均可泛化，且因果性地影响模型预测；(2) 后层网络选择性放大目标相关属性，该属性调制在不同提示下稳定出现，并通过因果干预证实其中介了模型响应分布。

Conclusion: VLM中的视觉表征并非静态信息库，而是会被语言目标动态调制以支持查询任务。这一动态跨模态处理视角为理解VLM工作机制提供了新的理论框架，暗示更灵活和自适应的视觉表征架构设计方向。

Abstract: Goal-directed visual processing is a hallmark of human visual intelligence, resulting in representations that support downstream tasks such as categorization or search. Though vision-language models (VLMs) are often faced with these same tasks, their ability to recode visual representations when presented with goal-directed language remains poorly characterized. Indeed, prior work largely treats visual representations in VLMs as static repositories of visual information that are manipulated by language representations. In the present work, we provide evidence for two concrete instances of language-induced recoding of visual representations. First, we identify an abstract reference representation that denotes which objects are goal-relevant under a natural language prompt. We extract contrastive steering vectors corresponding to this reference representation and demonstrate that they are causally implicated in model predictions. These reference representations are abstract in that they generalize to different objects, different task contexts, and even from synthetic to naturalistic images. Second, we demonstrate language-induced attribute modulation: later layers selectively amplify goal-relevant attributes in visual representations of objects. We demonstrate this phenomenon across a range of different prompts. Finally, we provide a causal intervention that demonstrates that attribute modulation mediates a VLM's response distribution. Together, our results support a more dynamic account of cross-modality processing in VLMs -- rather than vision tokens serving as static repositories of information, they are modulated to support queries articulated in language.

</details>


### [307] [Where did the ambiguity go? Examining how multimodal models interpret polysemous words](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00410)
*Jasin Cekinmez,Addison J. Wu,Raja Marjieh,Thomas L. Griffiths*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究了多义词（如"bank"、"palm"）在文本生成和图像生成模型中的意义分布差异。通过对17个文生图模型和15个文本生成模型进行测试，发现存在明显的多模态差距：图像生成模型产生的词义多样性远低于文本生成模型，而两者都远低于人类想象的词义多样性（归一化熵分别为0.10、0.25和0.47）。此外，模型对自身输出分布的预测比实际输出的词义分布更加多样。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人类语言高度多义，许多常见词携带多个不同含义。虽然已有研究表明大语言模型能够理解词义的多重性，但多义词在其他模态（如图像）中如何呈现仍缺乏系统研究。理解这一多模态差距对于评估基础模型在不同模态间是否忠实、平等地迁移语义理解至关重要。

Method: 研究者对17个文生图模型和15个文本生成模型进行测试，向每个模型提供无上下文的多义词，通过多次采样测量模型生成的不同词义。使用归一化熵量化词义多样性，并与人类对该词想象结果的多样性（归一化熵0.47）进行对比。同时，还直接询问模型自身对各词义生成频率的预测，以检验模型自我认知与实际行为的一致性。

Result: 发现三个关键结果：（1）多模态差距显著——每个模型家族中，图像生成的词义多样性远低于句子生成（归一化熵0.10 vs 0.25）；（2）模型输出多样性整体低于人类想象（归一化熵0.47）；（3）模型预测自身输出分布时给出的词义多样性高于其实际生成空间的多样性，表明模型对自身行为的认知与实际行为存在偏差。

Conclusion: 基础模型在表达多义词含义时存在显著的多模态差距，其语义理解在不同模态间未能忠实且平等地迁移。图像生成模型在词义多样性方面尤为受限，且模型对自身行为的预测与实际输出不一致，这对多模态基础模型的发展提出了重要挑战。

Abstract: Human language is highly polysemous. Many common words (e.g., 'bank' or 'palm') carry several distinct meanings that shape what humans communicate and imagine. Large language models (LLMs) have been shown to understand this multiplicity of meaning, but much less is known about how polysemy surfaces in other modalities such as images. We study this across 17 text-to-image and 15 text-generation models by giving each a polysemous word with no context to fix its meaning and measuring which senses are produced over many samples. We find a clear multimodal gap, where within every model family, generated images settle on far fewer senses than generated sentences (normalized entropy 0.10 vs. 0.25), and both are far less varied than what people imagine for the same words (normalized entropy 0.47). However, when we instead ask a model to list how often it would generate outputs corresponding to each possible meaning of a word, it predicts distributions that are more diverse than the actual space of outputs. These results reveal a multimodal gap in how foundation models express meaning, and how their understanding may not transfer faithfully nor equally across modalities.

</details>


### [308] [Through the LENS: Local Geometric Decomposition of Vision-Language Model Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00561)
*Shalom Kachko,Raz Lapid,Margarita Vald,Almog Dubin,Moshe Sipper*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出LENS方法，通过混合因子分析器（MFA）将视觉-语言模型（VLM）激活分解为局部低秩高斯邻域，揭示LLaVA和Qwen3-VL两种模型的深度相关融合轨迹差异，并证明这些局部邻域作为可解释且因果有效的操作单元，在生成引导、跨模态检索等任务中显著优于对比方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大多数可解释性方法仅识别全局线性方向，这可能遗漏那些全局高维但局部低维的表征。作者指出VLM在共享残差流中处理图像补丁和文本标记，但两种模态相互作用的局部几何结构尚未被充分理解，因此需要一种能够捕捉局部低维结构的分析方法。

Method: 提出LENS方法，使用混合因子分析器（Mixture of Factor Analyzers, MFA）将VLM激活分解为局部低秩高斯邻域。具体包括：在LLaVA-1.5-7B和Qwen3-VL-8B上应用该方法，通过自动化多模态标签流水线为邻域赋予语义描述，并通过向邻域质心插值激活来实现因果重定向生成。

Result: LENS揭示了两种模型不同的深度相关融合轨迹：LLaVA在较深层逐步混合模态，而Qwen3-VL在早期融合、部分重新分离、并在输出附近重组。MFA引导在多数评估条件下优于差均值方法和VL-SAE；在LLaVA视觉到视觉设置中MFA得分是VL-SAE的5.7倍。人类评估表明MFA引导与提示竞争相当，且显著强于其他干预基线。在Qwen3-VL图像到渲染文本检索中，最深层MFA系数空间将R@1从14.9%提升至48.6%。消融实验证实融合轨迹在组件数量、局部秩和模态纯度阈值下保持稳定。

Conclusion: 局部几何邻域是分析跨模态表征的有用可解释单元和因果单元，该结果支持VLM中局部低维邻域结构作为理解和干预跨模态信息的有效工具。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) process image patches and text tokens in a shared residual stream, but the local geometry through which the two modalities interact remains poorly understood. Most interpretability methods identify global linear directions, which may miss representations that are globally high-dimensional but locally low-dimensional. We introduce LENS (Local Explanation of Neighborhood Subspaces), a method that decomposes VLM activations into local low-rank Gaussian neighborhoods using a Mixture of Factor Analyzers. Applied to LLaVA-1.5-7B and Qwen3-VL-8B, LENS reveals distinct depth-dependent fusion trajectories consistent with each model's fusion mechanism: LLaVA progressively mixes modalities at later layers, whereas Qwen3-VL mixes them early, partially re-segregates them, and recombines them near the output. An automated multimodal labeling pipeline assigns concise semantic descriptions to these neighborhoods. Interpolating activations toward neighborhood centroids causally redirects generation within and across modalities and outperforms difference-in-means and VL-SAE in most evaluated conditions; in one LLaVA vision-to-vision setting, MFA achieves 5.7 times the VL-SAE score. Human evaluation finds MFA steering competitive with prompting and substantially stronger than the other intervention baselines. Finally, the MFA coefficient space improves Qwen3-VL image-to-rendered-text retrieval at the deepest evaluated layer from 14.9% to 48.6% R@1. Ablations show that the reported fusion trajectories are stable across component counts, local ranks, and modality-purity thresholds. These results support local geometric neighborhoods as useful interpretable and causal units for analyzing cross-modal representations in the evaluated VLMs.

</details>


### [309] [Similarity Weighted Aggregation with Global Differential Privacy for Federated Brain Lesion Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00872)
*Muhammad Irfan Khan,Eero Lehtonen,Joni Obradovic,Elina Kontio,Esa Alhoniemi,Suleiman A. Khan,Mojtaba Jafaritadi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出DP-SimAgg，一个结合相似度加权聚合与服务器端差分隐私的联邦学习框架，用于医学影像（脑肿瘤分割）中的隐私保护协作训练。在FeTS 2022数据集上，该框架在严格隐私预算下（ε=1/轮）仍能维持有竞争力的分割性能（Dice：ET 0.6357, TC 0.5305, WT 0.5274），展示隐私保护协作学习的潜力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦学习虽可实现跨机构协作训练而不共享原始数据，但面临两大挑战：不同机构间的数据异构（non-IID分布）影响模型性能，以及模型更新可能泄露敏感信息。本文旨在同时解决这两个问题，为医学影像场景提供隐私保护与性能兼顾的联邦学习方案。

Method: DP-SimAgg框架包含三个核心组件：(1) 对参与者的模型更新应用L2裁剪以约束更新范数；(2) 计算基于相似度的聚合权重，缓解non-IID数据分布带来的负面影响；(3) 在中心服务器注入校准的高斯噪声，在假设灵敏度界下提供每轮的(ε, δ)-DP保证。框架基于Intel的OpenFL平台实现。

Result: 在FeTS 2022数据集（1251个多模态MRI扫描，脑肿瘤分割任务）上：严格隐私预算（每轮ε=1，20轮累计ε_total=20）下，ET/TC/WT的Dice分数分别为0.6357/0.5305/0.5274；宽松预算（每轮ε=10，累计ε_total=200）下性能接近无隐私保护的基线。

Conclusion: DP-SimAgg展示了在医学影像场景中实现隐私保护与良好分割性能兼顾的可行性，为隐私保护协作医学学习提供了有效的解决方案。

Abstract: Federated Learning (FL) enables collaborative training of machine learning models across multiple institutions without sharing sensitive data, making it particularly suitable for medical imaging applications. However, heterogeneous data distributions across institutions and potential information leakage through model updates remain important challenges. In this work, we propose DP-SimAgg, a privacy-preserving federated learning framework that integrates similarity-weighted aggregation with a server-side differential privacy mechanism. The proposed method applies L2 clipping to bound collaborator updates, computes similarity-based aggregation weights to mitigate the effects of non-IID data distributions, and injects calibrated Gaussian noise at the central server, providing per-round privacy guarantees under the assumed sensitivity bound. The framework is implemented using Intel's OpenFL platform and evaluated on the FeTS 2022 dataset consisting of 1251 multi-modal MRI scans for brain tumor segmentation. Experimental results demonstrate that DP-SimAgg maintains competitive segmentation performance while providing privacy protection. Under a strict per-round privacy budget (epsilon = 1, cumulative epsilon_total = 20 over 20 rounds), the method achieves Dice scores of 0.6357, 0.5305, and 0.5274 for the enhancing tumor (ET), tumor core (TC), and whole tumor (WT) regions, respectively. With a more relaxed per-round budget (epsilon = 10, cumulative epsilon_total = 200), performance approaches that of the non-private baseline while incorporating a central Gaussian mechanism with per-round (epsilon, delta)-DP accounting under the assumed sensitivity bound. These results highlight the potential of DP-SimAgg for enabling privacy-preserving collaborative learning in medical imaging applications.

</details>


### [310] [V-Mem: Modality-Routed Retrieval for Long-Term Multimodal Agentic Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01543)
*Dingyi Kang,Dongming Jiang,Yi Li,Guanpeng Li,Bingzhe Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: V-Mem是一个多模态智能体记忆系统，通过按查询和目标证据的模态进行路由检索，以及使用基于LLM生成的锚点（hypothetical caption和enriched search anchor）来弥合模态鸿沟和相似性-相关性鸿沟，在多模态问答记忆任务上显著优于现有基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的智能体记忆系统主要针对文本设计，即使少数支持多模态对话的系统在处理视觉相关问题时仍然失败。作者指出根本原因在于相似性搜索的基本假设（索引空间中查询应靠近相关证据）在多模态场景下被两个"鸿沟"破坏：模态鸿沟（查询总是更靠近自身模态的内容而非另一模态的证据）和相似性-相关性鸿沟（与查询最相似的内容往往不是能回答它的证据，尤其是当查询同时包含文本和图像时）。

Method: V-Mem通过两个关键设计解决上述问题：(1) 按模态路由：从查询中识别查询模态和目标证据模态，将对话组织为回合（rounds），在匹配后返回同一回合中的目标模态内容，避免跨模态直接比较；(2) 锚点搜索：利用LLM生成一个比查询更接近相关证据的搜索锚点——当纯文本查询需要找图像时，生成一个假设性图像描述（hypothetical caption）；当证据需要文本和图像组合才能触达时，使用"enriched search anchor"，即查询文本加上从查询图像中提取的相关关键词。

Result: 在Mem-Gallery基准上，V-Mem的LLM-judge评分达到0.82，而第二名只有0.56；在携带图像的查询上优势最大（0.87 vs 所有基线均低于0.47）。在LoCoMo基准上V-Mem得分为0.69，对比基线为0.58。

Conclusion: V-Mem通过显式处理多模态检索中的模态感知机制，有效解决了现有记忆系统在多模态视觉问答中的失效问题，证明了基于模态感知的路由和锚点生成策略是弥合检索鸿沟的有效途径。

Abstract: Interaction between users and LLM agents is increasingly multimodal: conversations interleave text with images, and a later question may target either. Yet most agent memories are designed around text, and even the few that support multimodal conversations still fail on vision-related questions. We trace this failure to an assumption behind the similarity search they rely on: in the index space, a query lies close to the relevant evidence that answers it. In multimodal settings, two gaps break it. By the modality gap, a query lies closer to memory content of its own modality than to evidence in another, even in a trained joint embedding space. By the similarity-relevance gap, the content most similar to a query is often not the evidence that answers it, most acutely when a query carries both text and image and its evidence resembles neither part alone. We present V-Mem, a multimodal agentic memory system that routes retrieval by the modality of the query and that of the target evidence, both recognized from the query alone. To cross the modality gap, V-Mem organizes the conversation into rounds and returns the target-modality content from the same round as the match, without comparing across modalities. To close the similarity-relevance gap, it searches with an LLM-generated anchor that sits closer to the relevant evidence than the query does: a hypothetical caption for a text-only query seeking an image, and an enriched search anchor, the query text plus relevant keywords extracted from the query image, when the evidence is reachable only by combining the two. On Mem-Gallery, V-Mem reaches an LLM-judge score of 0.82 versus 0.56 for the second best, with the largest margin on questions carrying an image (0.87, no baseline above 0.47); on LoCoMo it scores 0.69 versus 0.58.

</details>


### [311] [Abduction Without a Body? Representational Grounding and the Abduction Loop for Scientific Hypothesis Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02505)
*Michael Farmer*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"同一性溯因"（identity abduction）这一概念，主张在线具身（online embodiment）并非科学溯因的必要条件。作者提出"约定空间"（convention space）作为跨学科数学检索机制，并设计了"溯因回路"（Abduction Loop）架构及DAB-30基准来测试该机制，以证明无需连续感觉运动耦合也能产生科学假设。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近期AI与科学哲学领域的论证认为，真正的假设生成需要代理与物理世界持续耦合。作者反对这一强主张，认为对于特定类型的溯因（即通过表征锚定而非身体交互来识别两个独立结构为同一对象的"同一性溯因"），在线具身并非必要。此外，作者试图解决跨学科检索的难题：当两个领域缺乏共享词汇时，如何找到数学上相关的工作。

Method: 作者提出"约定空间"概念——科学图式所体现的跨学科约定（对称性、拓扑、算子结构）可被规范化用于检索。在此基础上构建"溯因回路"架构，包含六个环节：表征生成、模体提取、约定空间规范化、跨域检索、同一性假设生成、对抗性验证，并以弃权（abstention）作为默认行为。文中以一例多模态模型从引力记忆输运模型的图中生成并验证其中心微分复形与弱引力透镜宇宙学的球形Kaiser-Squires质量映射复形等价的假设作为"可能性见证"（possibility witness）。

Result: 作者给出了一个具体的演示案例（引力记忆输运模型与弱透镜宇宙学Kaiser-Squires复形的等价性假设），展示了该架构的可行性线索。同时提出了DAB-30基准测试作为可证伪的评估程序，但明确说明该案例只是架构构建的动机性见证，而非通用能力的证据。

Conclusion: 这项工作的贡献在于三方面：一个机制性提案（同一性溯因可脱离在线具身）、一个架构（溯因回路）、一个测试程序（DAB-30基准）。作者持谨慎立场，将弃权设为默认行为，承认架构是从单次见证中抽象出来的，需要通过基准测试进一步验证。

Abstract: Can scientific abduction occur without continuous sensorimotor embodiment? Recent arguments in AI and philosophy of science hold that genuine hypothesis generation requires an agent continuously coupled to the physical world. We defend a narrower claim: online embodiment is not necessary for every abductive scientific act. Our focus is identity abduction: the inference that two independently developed structures are one object under an explicit correspondence, reached through representational grounding rather than bodily interaction. An agent may acquire new inferential affordances not through physical interaction but through transformations into representations that expose latent invariants. Scientific diagrams are a practical substrate because they embody independently evolved conventions that partially canonicalize symmetry, topology, and operator structure across disciplines - a property we develop as convention space, which answers a hard retrieval problem: finding mathematically related work when two fields share no discriminating vocabulary. We operationalize the mechanism as an architecture, the Abduction Loop: representation generation, motif extraction, convention-space canonicalization, cross-domain retrieval, identity-hypothesis generation, and adversarial verification, with abstention as the designed default. A documented episode, in which a multimodal model given a figure of a gravitational-memory transport model generated and then verified the hypothesis that its central differential complex is equivalent to the spherical Kaiser-Squires mass-mapping complex of weak-lensing cosmology, serves as a motivating possibility witness from which the architecture is abstracted, not as evidence of general capability. We close with a falsifiable evaluation program, the DAB-30 benchmark. The contribution is a mechanistic proposal, an architecture, and a test program.

</details>


<div id='stat.ML'></div>

# stat.ML [[Back]](#toc)

### [312] [A reproducible and extensible framework for benchmarking competing risks survival models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00271)
*Begoña B. Sierra,Colin McLean,Peter S. Hall,Sarah Friedrich-Welz,Catalina A. Vallejos*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个开源基准测试框架，用于系统比较竞争风险模型，涵盖校准、判别、预测误差和临床效用等多个性能维度，并扩展了SHAP用于竞争风险场景下的模型可解释性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管已有大量统计和机器学习方法用于竞争风险分析（如癌症死亡与心血管死亡互为竞争事件），但缺乏全面、可复现且可扩展的基准测试框架来系统评估和推广这些方法。

Method: 开发了一个开源基准测试框架，支持在多个数据集上从校准、判别、总体预测误差和临床效用四个维度系统比较竞争风险模型；同时引入竞争风险场景下的SHAP扩展，实现模型无关的、随时间变化的协变量贡献可解释性分析。

Result: 框架及全部代码已通过GitHub公开提供（https://github.com/BBolosSierra/CompRisksBenchmark）。

Conclusion: 该基准测试框架填补了竞争风险模型缺乏系统评估工具的空白，并通过SHAP扩展增强了竞争风险模型的可解释性，有助于推动该领域方法的标准化评估与临床应用。

Abstract: A wide range of statistical and machine learning methods have been proposed for survival analysis with competing risks, where the occurrence of one event (i.e., cancer death) precludes the occurrence of other events (i.e., cardiovascular disease death). Despite these methodological advances, their systematic evaluation and adoption are limited by the lack of comprehensive, reproducible and extensible benchmarking frameworks. We developed an open-source benchmarking framework for competing risks models that enables their systematic comparison across multiple datasets under different aspects of performance; calibration, discrimination, overall prediction error and clinical utility. We additionally introduce an extension of SHAP for competing risks, allowing model-agnostic interpretability of covariates contributions over time. All our code is publicly available via GitHub:https://github.com/BBolosSierra/CompRisksBenchmark

</details>


### [313] [Causal Inference with Unstructured Treatments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00657)
*Kevin Christian Wibisono,Yixin Wang*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文针对非结构化处理变量（如文本、图像、临床决策序列）提出因果查询新目标——最大影响力特征（MIF），即最强烈影响结果的治疗特征，并给出其形式化定义、识别条件、估计算法及可操作的"助推"（nudging）算法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统因果推断关注标量处理变量，但对于非结构化处理（如课程描述文本），平均处理效应无法估计（几乎不存在完全重复的处理值）且缺乏实用性（人们不希望所有处理都完全相同）。实际需求是识别处理中哪些特征最能影响结果，并可跨对象推广应用。

Method: 形式化MIF为治疗的二元特征，由特征评分函数定义，约束条件是两个取值均保持充足样本量，目标是最大化该特征所诱导的因果效应。开启该特征使处理分布向展示该特征的方向偏移，关闭则反之，MIF效应对比两种平均潜在结果。研究MIF的识别条件，开发估计算法，并提出沿MIF修改治疗以产生结果改善版本的助推算法。

Result: 在文本、图像和动态治疗序列等多个应用中验证了MIF算法的有效性，展示了其在非结构化处理因果推断中的可行性与可操作性。

Conclusion: MIF为处理为非结构化数据的因果推断提供了实用且有可识别性的目标，弥补了传统平均处理效应在非结构化场景下的不可估计和无用性缺陷，并通过助推算法使因果发现转化为实际改进。

Abstract: Causal inference usually concerns a scalar treatment, yet in many problems the treatment is unstructured: a text, an image, or a sequence of clinical decisions. Consider an instructor writing a course description to attract more students: the treatment is the course description, and the outcome is enrollment. The standard target, the average treatment effect of fixing the treatment to one exact value versus another, runs into two problems. It cannot be estimated, because almost no exact description recurs across courses, leaving no comparable group from which to measure its effect; and it would be of little use even if it could, since no one wants every course to carry the same description. What the instructor actually wants to know is which features of a description raise enrollment, and which of those features can be acted on across many courses. To this end, we propose a causal query for unstructured treatments: the maximally influential feature (MIF), the feature of the treatment that most strongly influences the outcome. We formalize the MIF as a binary feature of the treatment, defined by a feature-scoring function, constrained so that both of its values stay well populated, and chosen to maximize the causal effect it induces. Turning the feature on shifts the distribution of treatments toward those that display it, turning it off shifts away, and the MIF effect contrasts the two average potential outcomes. We study identification conditions for the MIF, develop algorithms to estimate it, and make it actionable through a nudging algorithm that revises a treatment along the MIF into an outcome-improving version. We illustrate the MIF algorithm across applications in text, image, and dynamic treatment sequences.

</details>


### [314] [Round-Trip Consistency: Bidirectional Diffusion Models Can Predict Their Own Rollout Errors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00675)
*Alexander Scheinker*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出使用单个条件潜在扩散模型，通过一个方向标志同时向前和向后推进动力学系统。该双向性提供了一个免测量的测试时误差信号：向前i步再向后i步应回到起点，其往返差异C_i可作为不可观测推出误差的自监督代理。在磁流体动力学、湍流辐射混合层和人脸视频上验证，C_i能有效排序推出误差、检测分布外数据并减少累积误差，且双向训练零成本甚至优于单向专家模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自回归模型在长期推出（rollout）过程中会累积误差，但在部署时没有真实值（ground truth）来测量该误差。现有方法依赖集成（ensembles）、保留数据或控制方程来估计误差，但这些方法代价高昂或不可用。作者希望利用可逆性的物理先验：如果模型能同时学习前向和后向动力学，那么往返一致性可以作为一种自监督的、免测量的测试时误差信号。

Method: 训练一个条件潜扩散模型，通过方向标志（direction flag）控制模型向前或向后推进动力学系统。在测试时，将模型向前滚动i步再向后滚动i步，计算往返差异C_i作为误差代理。具体验证包括：(1) 在压缩磁流体动力学（MHD）上验证C_i与推出误差的相关性（Spearman相关系数）；(2) 拟合简单校准器预测误差幅度；(3) 利用C_i检测分布外数据（Orszag-Tang涡旋）；(4) 将C_i作为早期停止或修正信号以减少累积误差；(5) 在LE-PDE-UQ纳维-斯托克斯湍流基准上与十模型集成对比。

Result: 在MHD上，C_i与推出误差的Spearman相关系数达到0.91-0.98（固定深度）和0.69±0.16（轨迹内）；校准器预测误差幅度68%置信区间内1.14倍、95%置信区间内1.29倍，覆盖接近名义水平，且仅比深度独预测器多1 nat，可迁移到全部六个解码物理场。该信号检测分布外数据AUROC达0.98（深度10时1.0），此时采样离散基线失效；在80%覆盖率下减少15%累积误差，为深度基线三倍。双向训练零额外代价，向后方向可作为快速逆求解器。在湍流Navier-Stokes基准上，单一双向模型达到十模型集成1.3倍内的精度，训练成本仅为其十分之一。

Conclusion: 往返一致性（round-trip consistency）将可逆性转化为生成模型的实际信任信号，提供一种无需集成、无需真实数据、无需控制方程的自监督测试时误差估计方法，同时双向训练本身不仅无额外成本，还优于单向专家，并能额外提供快速逆求解能力。

Abstract: Autoregressive models accumulate error over long rollouts, yet at deployment there is no ground truth to measure it against. We train a single conditional latent diffusion model that steps a dynamical system forward or backward in time via a direction flag, and show that this bidirectionality supplies a measurement-free test-time error signal: rolling forward $i$ steps and then backward $i$ steps must return the model to its start, so the round-trip discrepancy $\mathcal{C}_i$ is a self-supervised proxy for the unobservable rollout error: no ensembles, no held-out data, no governing equations, for one extra rollout. We validate on compressible magnetohydrodynamics (MHD), an astrophysical turbulent radiative mixing layer, and natural face videos (CelebV-HQ). On held-out MHD trajectories, $\mathcal{C}_i$ ranks rollout error (Spearman $0.91$-$0.98$ at fixed depth; $0.69 \pm 0.16$ within trajectories), and a simple calibrator fit on training rollouts predicts its magnitude to within $1.14\times$ ($68\%$) and $1.29\times$ ($95\%$) with near-nominal coverage - one nat beyond a depth-only predictor, transferring to all six decoded physical fields. The same signal flags the out-of-distribution Orszag-Tang vortex (AUROC $0.98$; $1.0$ by depth $10$) exactly where sampling-dispersion baselines invert, and it cuts incurred error by $15\%$ at $80\%$ coverage - three times the depth-only baseline. Bidirectional training comes at negative cost, beating direction specialists in both directions, and the backward direction doubles as a fast inverse solver. On LE-PDE-UQ's turbulent Navier-Stokes benchmark, a single bidirectional model reaches accuracy within $1.3\times$ of their ten-model ensemble at a tenth of the training cost, with the best training-free pixel-level calibration. Round-trip consistency turns reversibility into a practical trust signal for generative models.

</details>


### [315] [Model-Agnostic FDR Control via Group Gaussian Mirror and Permutation SHAP](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00989)
*Jiaan Han,Junxiao Chen,Yanzhe Fu*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出一个分组特征FDR控制框架，用于处理特征以块（block）形式出现（如时序模型的滞后项、循环状态、注意力交互）的假设检验问题。框架同时覆盖分组线性模型（基于矩阵扰动的零对称镜像统计量）和神经序列模型（基于Permutation SHAP导数与核依赖度量），在低维和高维分组线性模型下证明FDR控制，并可退化为Gaussian Mirror和Neural Gaussian Mirror。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大多数FDR控制的特征选择方法仅针对坐标级假设（每个特征一个权重或重要性分数），无法处理序列模型和分组模型中原始特征对应一组子特征（如滞后项、循环状态、注意力交互）的场景，因此需要一种针对分组特征级别的FDR控制框架。

Method: 1）对分组线性模型，构造零对称的块级镜像统计量，使用矩阵值扰动；2）对神经序列模型，将Permutation SHAP导数作为模型无关的块级重要性分数，并与基于核的依赖度量结合；3）框架跨网络架构模型无关，无需指定协变量分布，块大小为1时退化为Gaussian Mirror或Neural Gaussian Mirror。

Result: 1）在低维和高维分组线性模型下证明了FDR控制性质；2）在固定拟合非线性模型下证明了平滑Permutation SHAP导数的渐近对称性；3）模拟与真实数据实验表明在相关分组特征信号下能可靠控制FDR并提升统计功效。

Conclusion: 该框架为分组特征场景提供了严格理论保证的FDR控制方法，兼具模型无关性和通用性，填补了现有FDR特征选择方法对分组结构模型支持的空白。

Abstract: Most FDR-controlled feature selection methods are designed for coordinate-wise hypotheses, where each feature has a single weight or importance score. This abstraction fails in sequential and grouped models, where one original feature is represented by a block of sub-features, such as lags, recurrent states, or attention-based interactions. We propose a grouped-feature FDR control framework for such settings. For grouped linear models, we construct null-symmetric block-level mirror statistics with matrix-valued perturbations. For neural sequential models, we combine Permutation SHAP derivatives as model-agnostic block-level importance scores with kernel-based dependence measure. The framework is model-agnostic across network architectures, does not require specifying the covariate distribution, and reduces to Gaussian Mirror or Neural Gaussian Mirror when the block size is one. We prove FDR control for low- and high-dimensional grouped linear models and asymptotic symmetry of smoothed Permutation SHAP derivatives under fixed fitted nonlinear models. Experiments on simulated and real-world datasets show reliable FDR control and improved power under correlated grouped-feature signals.

</details>


### [316] [How fine a change can moments see? A scale law for detecting distribution shift, with a kernel calibration rule](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01268)
*Adel Kaleche*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出一个针对高维嵌入流变化检测的标度律（scale law），证明任何基于矩的检验若要验证空间尺度ε、质量分数f的特征，需多项式检验次数N* ≥ log(1/f)/(2ε)；该律由Chebyshev极值问题证明，并通过Gauss求积构造给出阈值。该律为上界（单侧），存在反例（环与圆盘矩相同但H₁不同）。实用意义是校准规则：上界由RBF核的高斯检验函数达到，据此可预测MMD检验的带宽。真实嵌入流上中位σ*/ε=1.12，数据驱动带宽AUC≥0.95。对持久同调，结论取决于隐式选择，汇总比过滤更重要；持久性虽有潜力但代价高（116x峰度），核检验（带宽由该律设定）总体上占优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高维嵌入流变化检测通常被框定为统计量的选择问题，缺乏统一的理论约束来指导统计量（尤其拓扑方法）的选择与校准。

Method: 通过Chebyshev极值问题证明多项式检验次数下界N* ≥ log(1/f)/(2ε)；用Gauss求积构造给出N* ≥ 4b-1的拓扑版本；构造反例（矩匹配但拓扑不同）；并以RBF核MMD检验实现上界，将带宽与特征尺度对应。

Result: 标度律预测的带宽与实际最优带宽高度吻合（中位σ*/ε=1.12，IQR 1.01-1.52，n=26）；带宽匹配的核检验在对抗设置中仍能检测，而其他统计量失效；持久同调方面总分持久性与一阶持久景观性能差异大，且持久性成本为峰度的116倍而效果不优于核检验。

Conclusion: 结论并非拓扑汇总无用，而是在该任务中，由标度律设定带宽的核检验优于拓扑方法；特征细度（而非特征数量）决定检测成本。

Abstract: Detecting that a stream of high-dimensional embeddings has changed is usually framed as a choice of statistic. We give a scale law that constrains any moment-based choice and test it against topological alternatives. The law: certifying a feature of spatial scale eps carrying mass fraction f requires polynomial tests of degree N* >= log(1/f)/(2 eps), proved via the Chebyshev extremal problem; a Gauss-quadrature construction gives N* >= 4b-1 for a b-scale topology, so cost is set by feature fineness, not feature count. The law is one-sided: we exhibit an annulus whose mean, covariance and all fourth-order moments equal those of a filled disk, yet H_1 is nonzero.
  Its practical content is a calibration rule. The upper bound is attained by Gaussian test functions, the RKHS witness of an RBF kernel, so the law predicts which bandwidth an MMD test should use: the feature scale. On real embedding streams we measure sigma*/eps with median 1.12 (IQR 1.01-1.52, n=26) over three settings and three scales, and a data-driven bandwidth reaches AUC >= 0.95. Against an adversary optimised against the defender's statistics (mean, covariance, k-NN, kurtosis), only a bandwidth-matched kernel test still detects.
  For persistent homology the verdict is mixed and depends on choices usually left implicit. The summary matters more than the filtration: total persistence attains recall 0.75 at FPR 1% where the first persistence landscape attains 0.00. What survives is a cost gap, not a power gap: where persistence works it costs 116x kurtosis, which works at least as well. We conclude not that topological summaries are useless, but that on this task a kernel test whose bandwidth the law sets dominates them.

</details>


### [317] [Dominant Arm Identification with Mixing and Recycling Observed Samples](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01545)
*Jonghyun Sim,Wonyoung Kim*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文研究了多臂老虎机中主导臂（dominant arm）的识别问题，目标是在臂的所有动作中找出以最高概率超过所有其他动作实现奖励的动作。作者提出了一种新的主导臂准则和高效估计器，包含两项关键技术：基于分区奖励空间的支配评分准则，以及联合混合与回收机制结合双重稳健估计器，保证所有臂的经验分布函数同时收敛。所提出的消除算法以接近最优的样本复杂度识别出最佳主导臂，实验表明其能一致地实现真实主导臂的精确恢复，优于现有基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统基于均值估计的方法仅关注每个臂的平均奖励，而基于两两比较的算法也无法捕捉臂在奖励分布上的整体优势。二者均无法可靠地识别出具有最高已实现奖励的臂（即主导臂），这一问题在现实场景（如推荐系统、投资决策）中尤为关键，因为最优决策往往取决于奖励的分布而非期望值。

Method: 提出了两个核心技术创新：(i) 一种支配评分准则，通过将奖励空间划分为若干区域，评估臂在每个区域中是否击败局部主导臂，从而构建全局主导性的判据；(ii) 一种联合混合与回收机制，结合双重稳健（doubly robust）估计器，确保所有臂的经验分布函数能够同时收敛。基于此设计了消除（elimination）算法来识别最佳主导臂。

Result: 所提出的消除算法在样本复杂度上达到近乎最优的速率。数值实验表明，该算法能够一致性地精确恢复真实的主导臂，并且在识别准确率上优于现有基线方法。

Conclusion: 该工作为多臂老虎机中的主导臂识别提供了新的理论框架和高效算法，克服了均值准则和两两比较准则的局限性，为需要关注奖励分布而非仅期望值的决策场景提供了可靠的解决方案。

Abstract: We study the problem of identifying the dominant arm in multi-armed bandits, where the objective is to find the action with the highest probability of exceeding the realized rewards of all other actions. Conventional mean-based and pairwise comparison-based algorithms often fail to identify the arm with the highest realized reward. To address this challenge, we introduce a novel dominant arm criterion and an efficient estimator with theoretical guarantees. Our approach relies on two key technical innovations: (i) a dominance score criterion that an arm beats the locally dominant over the partitioned reward space and (ii) a joint mixing and recycling mechanism coupled with a doubly robust estimator that guarantees simultaneous convergence of the empirical distribution functions for all arms. These key innovations pave a way to efficient computation of global arm dominance. Our proposed elimination algorithm identifies the best dominant arm with nearly optimal rate of sample complexity. Numerical experiments demonstrate that our algorithm consistently achieves exact recovery of the true dominant arm, outperforming existing baselines.

</details>


### [318] [Finite-Probe Total-Variation Certificates for Finite-Basis Drifting Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01547)
*Sam Andersson,Ricky Molén*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文研究"漂移目标"（drifting objectives）这一分布比较框架下的统计推断问题。在仅能有限位置、含噪观测向量场的前提下，作者建立了一个条件诊断框架：通过非归一化采样分子与探针依赖矩阵之间的向量恒等式，给出后验总变差（TV）上置信界，并系统地处理了探针可观测性、秩退化、带宽极限行为等理论问题，最后通过合成实验验证了方法的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在现实场景中，我们往往只能通过有限位置上的含噪向量场观测来比较目标分布与模型分布，这种"冻结测量系统"（frozen measurement system）所能支撑的分布结论在理论上尚不清楚。作者希望回答：在这种约束下，我们能对目标分布与模型分布之间的差异（以TV距离度量）得出什么样的置信结论？尤其是在存在未观测场噪声、估计算子误差和外部验证的L1残差半径的情况下。

Method: 方法核心包括：(1) 建立非归一化采样分子与探针依赖矩阵之间的恒等式 vec(V_X)=Mc，其中c为反对称失配，M为探针依赖矩阵；(2) 基于该恒等式推导a posteriori TV上置信界，综合考虑held-out场噪声、估计算子误差和外部验证的L1残差半径；(3) 引入非正可观测性裕度（observability margin）时的弃权（abstention）机制；(4) 对于高斯RBF核，构造全局包络以支持无分布假设和empirical-Bernstein半径；(5) 通过总体Gram矩阵刻画随机探针可观测性，分析秩与对称性退化，证明大带宽下坍缩为均值匹配；(6) 提出联合基大小/维度应力路径以扩展评估至m=8。

Result: 合成立方实验对Gaussian和Laplace分子进行了验证，分别测试了预设的有界向量半径与方差自适应半径、Monte Carlo校准算子、围绕归一化有限基近似器的非零残差半径、向外取整的可观测性边界以及设计弃权行为。结果显示，该方法能够提供非平凡的条件TV上置信界，并在可观测性不足时正确弃权。

Conclusion: 该框架是对有限密度类（或带外部残差半径的归一化有限基密度近似器）的条件诊断工具，而非基于小训练漂移的通用保证。它明确了什么情况下一个冻结测量系统能给出有意义的分布差异结论，什么情况下应当弃权，为拒绝推断（hypothesis testing）与审计场景提供了理论基础。

Abstract: Drifting objectives compare a target and model distribution through a vector field observed noisily at finitely many locations. We ask what distributional conclusion such a frozen measurement system warrants. For integrable antisymmetric interactions and absolutely continuous laws in a declared finite density basis, the unnormalized sampled numerator satisfies $\operatorname{vec}(V_X)=Mc$, where $c$ is an antisymmetric mismatch and $M$ is probe-dependent. This identity yields an a posteriori total-variation (TV) upper confidence bound accounting for held-out field noise, estimated-operator error, and externally validated $L^1$ residual radii around normalized density approximants in the span; a nonpositive observability margin returns the trivial TV bound and abstains. The audit recomputes this numerator from held-out samples; a normalized drift statistic requires a separate joint numerator--denominator analysis. For Gaussian-RBF interactions, a global envelope supports distribution-free and empirical-Bernstein radii without truncation, with companion bounds for the Laplace similarity in the original drifting objective. We characterize random-probe observability by a population Gram matrix, identify rank and symmetry degeneracies, and prove large-bandwidth collapse toward mean matching. Synthetic studies exercise Gaussian and Laplace numerators, separately prespecified bounded-vector and variance-adaptive radii, Monte Carlo-calibrated operators, nonzero residual radii around normalized finite-basis approximants, outward-rounded observability bounds, and designed abstention. A joint basis-size/dimension stress path extends evaluation through $m=8$. The result is a conditional diagnostic for a finite density class, or for normalized finite-basis density approximants with external residual radii, not a universal guarantee from small training drift.

</details>


### [319] [The Label Defines the Timescale: Trait-State Limits of Temporal-Aggregate Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01587)
*Xizhe Zhang*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文研究机器学习基准中"短窗口输入预测长期标签"的任务，指出其表现上限可能来自采集协议而非模型容量。作者通过精确的贝叶斯风险恒等式，将标签方差分解为O(1)的稳定特质成分与O(T^{-1})的状态成分，推导了任务依赖的有效时间跨度，并证明在固定分段预算下，时间上分散的观测比重复单点观测能持续提升状态可解释性，从而区分架构限制与协议限制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有机器学习基准常以短时间窗口输入去预测聚合了长期时间视野的标签，其观测到的性能天花板可能源于采集协议（如窗口长度、采样方式）而非模型容量本身。作者希望厘清这一混淆，为理解算法上限提供可诊断的理论工具。

Method: 以隐高斯过程Z(t)为框架，标签定义为Θ_{g,T}=T^{-1}∫_0^T g{Z(t)}dt。推导协议条件下的精确贝叶斯风险恒等式；将标签方差分解为O(1)的特质项与O(T^{-1})的状态项；分别求均值标签与占用时间标签的任务依赖有效时间跨度；分析状态驱动的占用时间标签方差在稳定特质位于阈值时的最大化行为；通过精确风险计算和蒙特卡洛实验对比重复分段与时间分散观测的效果。

Result: 快照输入能保持横截面可预测性但难以追踪个体内变化；均值标签依赖普通相关时间，占用时间标签依赖高阶相关时间谱；窗口效率在特质处于阈值时衰减最慢；时间分散观测持续提升状态可解释性而重复分段快速饱和；特质天花板可用重测数据估计，仅状态天花板需短滞后时间校准。

Conclusion: 性能天花板须区分架构上限与协议上限；决定相关时间尺度的是标签本身，而非时长或分段数。该框架为基准设计与采集策略提供了理论依据。

Abstract: Machine-learning benchmarks often pair a label that aggregates a long temporal horizon with input observed through one or a few short windows. Their apparent performance ceiling may therefore be an acquisition-protocol ceiling rather than a model-capacity ceiling. We study labels of the form $Θ_{g,T}=T^{-1}\int_0^T g\{Z(t)\}\,\mathrm{d}t$ when the latent Gaussian process contains both a stable individual trait and a correlated within-individual state. An exact protocol-conditioned Bayes-risk identity provides a common tool. First, we decompose label variance into an $O(1)$ trait component and an $O(T^{-1})$ state component, explaining why a snapshot can retain cross-sectional predictability while poorly tracking within-person change. Second, we derive task-dependent effective temporal spans: mean labels depend on the ordinary correlation time, whereas occupation-time labels depend on an entire spectrum of higher-order correlation times. Third, state-driven occupation-label variance is maximal when the stable trait lies at the threshold; window efficiency decays much more slowly away from that boundary. Under an equal segment budget, exact risks and Monte Carlo experiments show that repeated segments at one time rapidly saturate, whereas temporally dispersed observations continue to increase state explainability. The trait ceiling uses quantities available from ordinary test-retest data; only the state ceiling requires short-lag temporal calibration. The results distinguish architectural limits from protocol limits and show that the label, rather than duration or segment count alone, defines the relevant timescale.

</details>


### [320] [Detecting Nonproperness of Likelihood Equations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01976)
*Xiaoxian Tang,Bican Xia,Tianqi Zhao*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种计算似然方程系统非正常性集合（nonproperness set）的新方法，该方法在计算代数统计模型中似然函数的正临界点数量（即真实根分类问题）方面起关键作用。作者证明了该方法的正确性，并通过实验表明其效率远优于现有文献中的已知方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在代数统计模型中，根据似然函数正临界点的数量对数据进行分类是一个具有挑战性的问题。临界点对应于似然方程的正解，因此识别正临界点的数量本质上是一个真实根分类问题。判别簇中的非正常性集合描述了似然方程系统在无穷远处有解的数据，当数据穿过该集合时，实数解的数量会发生变化。因此，识别非正常性集合对于真实根分类至关重要，但现有方法的计算效率不足。

Method: 作者开发了一种全新的计算似然方程系统非正常性集合的方法。该方法的核心思想尚未在摘要中详细展开，但作者证明了该方法的正确性，并通过实验对比验证其相对于文献中已有方法的效率优势。

Result: 实验结果表明，所提出的新方法在计算非正常性集合方面远优于文献中已知的现有方法，展现出显著的效率提升。

Conclusion: 该工作为似然方程系统的真实根分类提供了更高效的计算工具，非正常性集合的有效计算将有助于更好地理解代数统计模型中数据分类的结构，并可能推动该领域后续研究的发展。

Abstract: Given an algebraic statistical model, a challenging problem is classifying the data according to the number of positive critical points of the likelihood function. The positive critical points are the positive solutions to an algebraic system, say likelihood equations. So, identifying the number of positive critical points is a real root classification problem for the likelihood equations. A discriminant variety of a likelihood-equation system geometrically describes the data for which the number of real solutions becomes unusual. As an essential component of the discriminant variety, the nonproperness set collects the data such that the likelihood-equation system has a solution at infinity. So, the number of real solutions varies when the data passes the nonproperness set, and identifying the nonproperness set plays a crucial role in the real root classification. In this work, we develop a novel method for computing nonproperness sets of likelihood-equation systems. We prove the correctness of this method. We show experimentally that it is far more efficient than the known methods in the literature.

</details>


### [321] [Private Generative Bootstrap via Blocking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02480)
*Jinwon Sohn,Veronika Ročková*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 提出了一种私有生成式贝叶斯自助法（PGBB），通过分组策略隐藏个体贡献、在训练阶段注入校准噪声实现差分隐私，从而在不牺牲额外隐私预算的情况下进行后验采样和不确定性量化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着AI系统越来越多地访问个人数据，仅对统计答案进行隐私保护是不够的，还需要对回答中的不确定性（如置信区间、后验分布）进行同样的私有化。传统的私有贝叶斯方法通常需要指定数据生成模型且隐私代价高昂，亟需一种无需模型指定且高效的私有不确定性量化方法。

Method: 采用贝叶斯似然无关（likelihood-free）框架，对贝叶斯自助法进行私有化。核心策略是"分组阻塞"（blocking）：将个体随机分组并为每组分配单一权重，从而隐藏组内个体的贡献以增强差分隐私。训练阶段注入校准噪声进行摊销推断，学习从观测权重到后验样本的推前映射（push-forward map），使得后续后验采样不再消耗额外隐私和计算预算。

Result: 建立了差分隐私保证，分析了向非私有阻塞自助目标收敛的性质，量化了普通与阻塞贝叶斯自助后验之间的差异。推导了Dirichlet浓度参数的无数据调优方案以渐近恢复后验离散度。单次PGBB拟合可在无额外隐私成本下同时支持多种基于损失函数的决策规则。在模拟实验、美国人口普查教育回报率及出生体重分位数应用中，PGBB在常见设置下优于需要指定数据生成模型的私有贝叶斯替代方案。

Conclusion: PGBB通过分组阻塞策略和摊销私有推断，实现了无需模型指定、隐私高效的不确定性量化，在差分隐私框架下为统计答案及其不确定性提供了统一的私有化解决方案，并在实证中表现出对模型无关私有贝叶斯方法的竞争优势。

Abstract: With AI systems gaining more access to individuals' information, it is important to protect privacy when reporting statistical answers. Equally important is to privatize the reporting of uncertainty in such answers. To this end, we adopt a Bayesian likelihood-free framework and make simulation from the posterior private. In particular, we propose a new private instantiation of the Bayesian bootstrap using a blocking strategy. Rather than assigning idiosyncratic random weights to each individual, we randomly group individuals and assign a single weight to each group. By concealing individuals' contributions within a group, we fortify differential privacy gates. We harness amortized inference that decouples private learning from posterior sampling. A push-forward map from observation weights to posterior samples is learned privately by adding calibrated noise during training. Subsequent posterior draws require no additional privacy and computation budget. We call the resulting method the Private Generative Bayesian Bootstrap (PGBB). We establish a differential privacy guarantee, analyze convergence to the non-private blocked-bootstrap target, and quantify the discrepancy between the ordinary and blocked Bayesian-bootstrap posteriors. In addition, we derive data-free tuning of the block Dirichlet concentration parameter that restores posterior dispersion asymptotically. We also show a single fit of PGBB can support a family of loss-based decision rules simultaneously without additional privacy cost. In simulations and in applications to U.S. Census returns to schooling and U.S. natality birthweight quantiles, PGBB gives competitive private uncertainty quantification and improves over private Bayesian alternatives that require a specified data-generating model in common settings.

</details>


### [322] [Computational and Statistical Guarantees of the \textit{c}-Rectified flow](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02487)
*Leda Wang,Zhehao Xu,Qiang Liu,Harrison H. Zhou*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文研究了c-整流流（c-rectified flow）这一成本感知的整流流框架的理论保证。研究发现普通整流流在高斯情形下仅当源与目标协方差矩阵可交换时才收敛到最优传输耦合；而c-整流流在紧凑性和一致可积性假设下总是收敛到最优传输耦合。论文还建立了投影稳定性假设下的定量一步收缩和指数收敛保证，并在Hölder球假设下发展了极小极大最优的分数估计率，结合迭代c-整流流得到最优传输的速率最优估计器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 整流流虽然在大规模图像生成（如FLUX.1和Stable Diffusion 3）中取得了显著成功，但其迭代过程的计算和统计保证缺乏理论理解。作者旨在填补这一空白，特别是探究整流流迭代是否能恢复最优传输耦合这一核心问题。

Method: 论文引入c-整流流，这是一类成本感知的整流流，将速度场投影到梯度类同时保持端点边际。作者通过高斯情形案例分析普通整流流的收敛条件，并在一般假设下分析迭代c-整流流的收敛性，同时建立定量收敛保证和极小极大最优的分数估计率。

Result: 1）普通整流流在高斯情形下收敛到最优传输耦合当且仅当源和目标协方差矩阵可交换；2）迭代c-整流流在适定假设下总是收敛到最优传输耦合；3）在投影稳定性假设下，对二次和强凸位移成本建立了一步收缩和指数收敛的定量保证；4）在Hölder球假设下获得极小极大最优分数估计率，结合迭代c-整流流对d≥3获得速率最优估计器，对d=1,2获得近参数速率。

Conclusion: c-整流流提供了一种理论上保证收敛到最优传输耦合的整流流框架，弥补了普通整流流在耦合恢复方面可能失败的不足，并首次为其迭代过程提供了系统的计算与统计收敛保证。

Abstract: Recently, rectified flow has emerged as a fundamental framework for large-scale image generation, powering state-of-the-art systems such as FLUX.1 and Stable Diffusion 3. Despite its remarkable empirical success, the computational and statistical guarantees of iterative rectified flow have remained largely unexplored. We address this problem by studying \textit{c}-rectified flow, a cost-aware class of rectified flow that projects velocity fields onto a gradient class while preserving endpoint marginals. The ordinary rectified flow can fail to recover the optimal transport coupling: in a Gaussian case study, the iteration converges to the optimal coupling if and only if the source and target covariance matrices commute. In contrast, under suitable compactness and uniform-integrability assumptions, iterative \textit{c}-rectified flow always converges to the optimal transport coupling. We further establish quantitative one-step contraction and exponential convergence guarantees under projection-stability assumptions for both quadratic and strongly convex displacement costs. Finally, under a Hölder ball assumption, we develop new minimax-optimal score estimation rates and show that, when combined with iterative \textit{c}-rectified flow, they yield a rate-optimal estimator of the optimal transport for the dimension \(d \ge 3\) and a nearly parametric rate for \(d=1,2\).

</details>


### [323] [Interaction Is Not Necessary for Order-Optimal 1-Bit Mean Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02538)
*Jiachen Hu,Han Zhong*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文研究一比特均值估计问题，证明可以通过完全非自适应的随机协议达到与最优自适应协议相同的样本复杂度，从而否定了COLT 2026开放问题中关于交互必要性的猜想。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在先前的工作中，一比特均值估计的最优样本复杂度需要两阶段协议：第一阶段定位均值，第二阶段在定位后自适应地选择查询。这引发了一个核心理论问题：交互（自适应查询）是否是达到最优样本复杂度的必要条件？COLT 2026开放问题1明确询问了这一交互是否必要。

Method: 作者构造了一个完全非自适应的随机协议，所有查询在观测数据之前就已固定。该协议通过巧妙的随机化设计，将原本自适应的两阶段交互过程转化为固定查询，同时保持与最优自适应协议相同的样本复杂度。文章针对均值的k阶绝对中心矩有界的分布族进行分析，并按k>2、k=2、1<k<2三种情况分别给出样本复杂度上界。

Result: 该非自适应协议的样本复杂度与最优自适应协议相匹配：当k>2时复杂度为(σ/ε)²log(1/δ)；当k=2时为(σ/ε)²log(σ/ε)log(1/δ)；当1<k<2时为(σ/ε)^{k/(k-1)}log(1/δ)，均乘以log(λ/σ)因子。在已知下界覆盖的范围内达到极小极大最优。

Conclusion: 交互对于一比特均值估计达到阶最优的样本复杂度并非必要。这否定了COLT 2026开放问题1的猜想，表明即使完全固定所有查询，也能实现与最优自适应协议相同的性能。

Abstract: This paper is concerned with one-bit mean estimation, where each independent sample is represented by a single binary message. We consider distributions on $\mathbb{R}$ with mean in $[-λ,λ]$ and absolute $k$-th central moment at most $σ^k$, where $k>1$ is fixed. For this class, previous work attained the optimal sample complexity for general queries using a two-stage protocol. The first stage localizes the mean. The second-stage queries are chosen after localization and refine the estimate around the decoded center. We show that this interaction can be avoided by constructing a randomized fully non-adaptive protocol that fixes all queries before observing the data and matches the optimal adaptive sample complexity. For target accuracy $ε$ and confidence $1-δ$, its sample complexity scales as \[ \log\fracλσ +
\begin{cases} (σ/ε)^2\log(1/δ), & k>2,\\ (σ/ε)^2\log(σ/ε)\log(1/δ), & k=2,\\ (σ/ε)^{k/(k-1)}\log(1/δ), & 1<k<2, \end{cases} \] up to constants depending only on $k$. In the range covered by the known lower bound, this rate is minimax optimal even among fully adaptive protocols. This gives a negative answer to the COLT 2026 open problem asking whether interaction is necessary for order-optimal one-bit mean estimation with general queries \citep[Open Problem~1]{lau2026open}.

</details>


<div id='cs.LG'></div>

# cs.LG [[Back]](#toc)

### [324] [Uncertainty-Aware Simulation-Based Inference for Operations Research with Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00019)
*Liang Guo,Lin Shaochong,Shen Zuo-Jun Max,Zhang Kun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种无需训练的、基于不确定性感知的推理框架，通过短前瞻模拟和重要性重采样动态选择候选步骤，以提升大语言模型在运筹学数学建模任务中的连贯性与正确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型在运筹学（OR）任务上的部署具有挑战性，因为其正确性依赖于连贯的建模过程而非仅仅正确的最终答案。标准自回归生成采用短视策略，无法预先判断部分公式能否合法扩展为全局一致的优化模型，导致局部看似合理的步骤可能传播为灾难性的下游公式或求解器代码错误。

Method: 提出不确定性感知、免训练的推理框架。具体包括：(1) 不更新模型参数；(2) 通过短前瞻模拟（lookahead simulation）评估中间候选步骤，量化下游预测不确定性或概率集中度；(3) 采用重要性重采样（importance resampling）动态选择更可能产生连贯数学表述的候选步骤。

Result: 在多个OR基准测试（包括NL4OPT、MAMO和IndustryOR）上的实证评估表明，该框架一致优于标准基线和低温（low-temperature）基线，建立了高效、免训练的可靠OR公式生成范式。

Conclusion: 该工作验证了通过推理时不确定性量化与前瞻采样，可以在不微调模型的前提下显著提升LLM在OR建模任务中的可靠性，为免训练的可靠公式生成提供了新范式。

Abstract: Deploying large language models (LLMs) for operations research (OR) tasks remains challenging because correctness depends on a coherent modeling process, not merely a correct final answer. Standard autoregressive generation operates on a myopic policy, which sometimes fails to anticipate whether a partial formulation can be validly extended into a globally consistent optimization model. Consequently, locally plausible steps may propagate into catastrophic downstream formulation or solver code errors. To address this, we propose an uncertainty-aware, training-free inference framework for OR mathematical modeling. Without updating model parameters, our method evaluates intermediate candidate steps using short lookahead simulations to quantify downstream predictive uncertainty or probability concentration. Candidates that demonstrate a higher likelihood of yielding coherent mathematical formulations are then dynamically selected via importance resampling. Empirical evaluations across multiple OR benchmarks (including NL4OPT, MAMO, and IndustryOR) demonstrate that our framework consistently outperforms both standard and low-temperature baselines, establishing an efficient, training-free paradigm for reliable OR formulation generation.

</details>


### [325] [Learning Compositional Meta-Routing for Agentic Workflows: An Executable Benchmark](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00106)
*Natan Vidra,Alina Kapanova,Arun Kanhai,Spurthi Setty*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个可执行的路由基准测试和一个预算感知的元路由器，该路由器从任务文本中组合异构操作（直接回答、分解请求、检索证据、执行代码、委派专家、验证中间结果等）。在保留测试集上，学习策略达到100%成功率，比强静态工作流低43%成本；但在词汇偏移挑战集上成功率降至75.9%，暴露出词汇泛化是主要局限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 代理系统不仅要决定产生什么答案，还要决定其推理和执行操作序列。现有路由工作大多孤立地选择模型端点、检索深度或工具，缺乏从原始任务文本中组合异构操作的统一方案，也缺乏可执行、可机器校验的基准测试平台。

Method: 构建包含216个训练、72个开发、108个保留测试和108个词汇偏移挑战任务的基准，任务覆盖数据分析、冻结语料库研究和文档处理，结果在执行后由机器检查。方法采用独立的正则化逻辑回归头，从词和字符特征预测操作概率，在开发数据上进行温度缩放，并在路线成本和动作数量预算下进行贪心组合。

Result: 在保留测试集上，学习策略达到100%成功率（强静态/固定工作流为93.5%），成本比静态策略低43%；匹配的one-shot路由器仅达56.5%。在未触及的词汇偏移挑战集上，学习成功率降至75.9%，落后于静态路由（93.5%），但成本仍低49%，且超过one-shot路由34.3个百分点。

Conclusion: 性能差距表明词汇泛化而非路由执行是主要局限。本研究建立了可复现的测试平台和有限的概念验证，但不代表实时LLM性能的证据。

Abstract: Agentic systems must decide not only what answer to produce, but which reasoning and execution operations should precede it. A controller may answer directly, decompose a request, retrieve evidence, execute code, delegate to a specialist, or verify an intermediate result. Existing routing work largely selects model endpoints, retrieval depth, or tools in isolation. We introduce an executable benchmark and a budget-aware meta-router that composes heterogeneous operations from raw task text. The benchmark contains 216 training, 72 development, 108 held-out test, and 108 locked lexical-shift challenge tasks across data analysis, frozen-corpus research, and document processing. Outcomes are machine checked after operations execute. Independent regularized logistic heads predict operation probabilities from word and character features, are temperature-scaled on development data, and are greedily composed under route-cost and action-count budgets. On the held-out test, the learned policy achieves 100% success versus 93.5% for strong static and fixed workflows, with 43% lower cost than the static policy; a matched learned one-shot router reaches 56.5%. On the untouched challenge split, learned success falls to 75.9% and trails static routing at 93.5%, while remaining 49% cheaper and exceeding one-shot routing by 34.3 points. The gap identifies lexical generalization, rather than route execution, as the principal limitation. These results establish a reproducible testbed and a bounded proof of concept, not evidence of live-LLM performance.

</details>


### [326] [MetaRoute-Bench: Evaluating Meta-Decision Policies for Agentic Workflow Routing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00107)
*Natan Vidra,Alina Kapanova,Arun Kanhai,Spurthi Setty*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: MetaRoute-Bench是一个开放的、可检查的基准框架，用于比较智能体系统在共享执行模型下的元决策策略（是否直接回答、分解任务、调用工具、执行代码、委托专家、验证中间结果或从失败中恢复）。初始基准包含180个合成任务画像、8种路由策略和30对随机种子，在43,200条追踪轨迹上评估发现，任务感知的组合策略达到79.4%的成功率，优于静态策略（76.7%）、一次性任务路由（67.4%）和直接回答（52.9%）。消融实验显示限制路由组合为单一操作和移除验证环节时性能下降最大。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能体系统的元决策（如直接回答、分解任务、调用工具等）显著影响任务成功率、成本和延迟，但现有评估通常将这些决策嵌入编排框架中，仅通过聚合任务准确率进行评价，缺乏对路由策略本身进行系统化比较的开放框架。

Method: 构建MetaRoute-Bench开放基准框架，包含180个涵盖数据分析、研究和文档处理的合成任务画像；实现8种路由策略（包括直接回答、一次性任务路由、静态策略和任务感知组合策略）；采用30对随机种子的离线执行模型，生成43,200条追踪轨迹；通过配对95%置信区间进行统计比较，并实施消融实验分析路由组合约束和验证环节的影响。

Result: 任务感知组合策略达到79.4%成功率，优于静态策略（76.7%）、一次性任务路由（67.4%）和直接回答（52.9%）；相对静态策略提升2.7个百分点（配对95% CI为±2.0），但平均成本增加4.7%、延迟增加6.4%；消融实验表明当路由组合被限制为单一操作以及移除验证环节时性能损失最大。

Conclusion: MetaRoute-Bench的主要贡献是可复现的评估方法和路由策略权衡分析，而非生产环境有效性的证据。该框架为智能体系统的元决策策略比较提供了标准化的共享执行环境，并发布了任务生成、策略、轨迹、测试和分析制品以支持在实时系统中的验证。

Abstract: Agentic systems must repeatedly decide whether to answer directly, decompose a task, invoke a tool, execute code, delegate to a specialist, verify an intermediate result, or recover from failure. These meta-decisions affect not only task success but also operating cost and latency, yet they are often embedded inside an orchestration framework and evaluated only through aggregate task accuracy. We present MetaRoute-Bench, an open, inspectable framework for comparing meta-decision policies under a shared execution model. The initial benchmark contains 180 synthetic task profiles spanning data analysis, research, and document processing, eight routing policies, and 30 paired random seeds. Across 43,200 traces, a task-aware compositional policy achieves 79.4% success compared with 76.7% for a strong workload-specific static policy, 67.4% for one-shot task routing, and 52.9% for direct answering. Relative to the static policy, this is a 2.7 percentage-point improvement with paired 95% CI of plus or minus 2.0 points, at 4.7% higher mean cost and 6.4% higher latency. Ablations show the largest losses when route composition is restricted to one operation and when verification is removed. These results are generated by a seeded offline execution model rather than a live deployment; accordingly, the primary contribution is a reproducible evaluation method and an analysis of routing-policy tradeoffs, not evidence of production effectiveness. We release task generation, policies, traces, tests, and analysis artifacts to support live-system validation.

</details>


### [327] [Progressive$^2$: A Teacher-Student Progressive Co-Evolving Knowledge Distillation Method for Substantial Model Compression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00129)
*Tiancong Cheng,Ying Zhang,Zhiwen Yu,Yifang Yin,Bin Guo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Progressive²，一种渐进式知识蒸馏框架，通过逐渐增强的教师模型与逐渐缩小的学生模型相结合，解决大模型与小模型能力差距过大导致的蒸馏性能下降问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 知识蒸馏在大模型压缩中被广泛使用，但当教师模型（服务器端）与学生模型（客户端）之间能力差距过大时，蒸馏性能会显著下降。现有方法未能有效解决这一"能力鸿沟"问题。

Method: Progressive²包含两个核心渐进策略：(1) 教师侧：按raw-to-rich语义顺序逐步选择更多层参与蒸馏，形成系统化的学习课程；同时设计教师侧多特征融合适配器，利用Lipschitz连续性理论框架提升训练稳定性。(2) 学生侧：逐步减小网络规模，实现与教师的迭代协同进化。教师侧的渐进策略可独立部署，也可与学生侧联合使用。

Result: 教师侧的渐进蒸馏策略可独立部署，在准确率与训练效率之间取得最优平衡；教师与学生联合集成可进一步提升整体性能。

Conclusion: Progressive²作为一个灵活框架，通过逐步增强教师和逐步缩小学生的双向渐进策略，有效缓解了模型能力差距过大时的蒸馏性能退化问题，为知识蒸馏在服务端模型压缩中的应用提供了新思路。

Abstract: Knowledge distillation (KD) is a widely utilized technique for transferring knowledge from a large model (the teacher) to a smaller model (the student). Owing to its flexibility and broad applicability, KD has been extensively applied in the compression of server-side models to meet the Quality of Service (QoS) requirements of client users. Despite significant advancements, the performance of distillation is substantially compromised when a large disparity exists between the capabilities of the server and the requirements of the client. To alleviate this problem, we propose a novel distillation approach, named Progressive$^2$, which operates through the combination of a progressively stronger teacher and a progressively smaller student. On the side of the teacher, rather than involving all layers simultaneously, we progressively select additional layers for distillation following a raw-to-rich semantic progression, establishing a systematic learning curriculum. Furthermore, we design a teacher-side multi-feature fusion adapter for the teacher to improve training stability, which is theoretically supported by the framework of Lipschitz continuity. On the side of the student, rather than directly training a tiny model, we gradually reduce the size of the network to facilitate an iterative co-evolution with the teacher. Progressive$^2$ serves as a flexible framework; the progressive strategy of the teacher can be deployed independently to achieve an optimal balance between accuracy and training efficiency, while the joint integration of the teacher and the student yields further improvements in overall performance.

</details>


### [328] [Rethinking Pretraining for Specialized Design Data: Evidence from the JONES-19 Cultural Design Dataset](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00135)
*Alexandros Haridis,Charles Zhou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文基于JONES-19设计档案数据集，比较了CNN在ImageNet预训练与从零训练两种策略下的判别性能，发现多裁剪（multi-crop）增强的从零训练可以有效弥补领域通用预训练带来的性能优势，表明在专门的设计领域中，精心策划的小规模高质量数据集可能比大规模通用预训练更具效力和信息价值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 设计与建筑档案以图形格式编码了专家人类知识，为设计启发的机器学习挑战提供了关键测试平台，而这些挑战在典型计算机视觉基准测试中并不存在。作者旨在检验在专门设计领域中，CNN模型是否需要依赖大规模通用预训练，还是可以通过精心设计的小规模数据集实现等效甚至更优的性能。

Method: 基于JONES-19数据集（源自《装饰文法》1857年伦敦版的小规模图像数据集），评估CNN在两种训练策略下的判别性能：（a）ImageNet预训练以获得领域通用的"视觉常识"；（b）在JONES-19设计数据上从零开始训练，并辅以重复局部采样（multi-crop）增强。

Result: 实验发现，虽然领域通用先验（ImageNet预训练）能提升判别性能，但从零训练并结合多裁剪局部采样的策略能够有效弥合这种性能差距。对于高度结构化的设计数据，局部设计驱动的表示已能为学习提供充分基础。

Conclusion: 研究对大规模通用预训练的依赖提出了挑战。在专门的设计领域中，精心策划包含经验和形式设计原则的小型高质量数据集，比优先追求大规模数据收集更为有效，并且能更好地揭示特定设计领域的本质特征。

Abstract: Design and architectural archives encode expert human knowledge in graphical formats, providing a critical testbed for design-inspired Machine Learning (ML) challenges absent with typical computer vision benchmarks. Building on JONES-19, a small-size image dataset based on The Grammar of Ornament (London, 1857), we evaluate the discriminative performance of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) in two model training strategies: (a) ImageNet pretraining for domain-general "visual common sense," and (b) learning from scratch on the design data in JONES-19. We find that while domain-general priors improve discriminative performance, learning from scratch augmented with repeated local sampling (multi-crop) effectively recovers these gains. For highly structured design data, local design-driven representations provide sufficient foundation for learning, challenging a reliance on massive general-purpose pretraining. These findings suggest that in specialized design domains, careful curation of smaller high-quality datasets that capture empirical and formal design principles may prove more effective and informative on the nature of a particular design domain than prioritizing large-scale data collection.

</details>


### [329] [Leak It: A Probabilistic Approach to Training-Data Extraction from Black-Box Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00144)
*Victor Maricato*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文指出语言模型成员推断（MIA）用聚合ROC-AUC衡量会产生误导，因为盲基线仅凭表面文本即可分离成员与非成员。作者通过概率视角研究黑盒采样式训练数据泄漏，发现采样与盲基线相比几乎无增量优势，但真正的风险在于逐文档的标识符提取：在Pythia-6.9B上，16.6%的带真实标识符的文档被精确复现，该泄漏随模型规模增长、代码领域比散文强约3倍，且去重无明显缓解。作者主张隐私审计应报告按领域分解的逐文档提取率，而非单一AUC，并发布leakit工具。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有成员推断评估普遍使用聚合ROC-AUC，但这种度量被模型无关的盲基线的性能所混淆，掩盖了真实风险。作者希望通过概率化视角重新审视黑盒采样下的训练数据泄漏，揭示聚合指标无法捕捉的逐文档提取风险。

Method: 将N个采样输出p(.|x)视为输出分布的估计，将泄漏信号建模为该分布的函数泛函；在WikiMIA和MIMIR等基准上对比盲基线与采样方法；以Pythia系列（410M至6.9B）为对象，通过匹配/错配前缀控制实验验证逐文档标识符泄漏的可归因性，并按领域（代码vs散文）分解风险。

Result: 盲朴素词袋分类器在WikiMIA上达AUC 0.97，采样几乎无增量；在MIMIR上自浓度与黄金延续恢复均未显著超越盲基线。但真正的泄漏在逐文档层面：Pythia-6.9B中16.6%的带标识符文档被精确提取且可归因于特定文档，泄漏率从410M的5.6%升至6.9B的16.6%；代码比散文强约3倍；任意延续恢复仅限代码领域；温度与核采样影响甚微，16 token前缀即足够，去重无缓解。

Conclusion: 聚合AUC会掩盖逐文档提取的真实风险，隐私审计应报告按领域分解的逐文档提取率。作者发布leakit工具用于黑盒提取审计。

Abstract: Membership inference (MIA) on language models is usually summarised by an aggregate ROC-AUC, but such evaluations are confounded: model-free blind baselines separate members from non-members from surface text alone. We study black-box, sampling-based training-data leakage through a probabilistic lens, treating N samples from p(.|x) as an estimate of the output distribution and casting leakage signals as functionals of it. We extend the blind-baseline critique into the sampling regime: on WikiMIA a blind bag-of-words classifier reaches AUC 0.97 (TPR 0.90 at 5% FPR) and sampling adds nothing, while on an IID Pile split (MIMIR) neither self-concentration nor gold-continuation recovery significantly beats a blind baseline (incremental AUC 95% CI includes zero). Aggregate metrics hide the real harm. The same sampling verbatim-extracts training data for a tail of documents no blind attack can reach. On Pythia-6.9B, 83 of 500 Pile documents bearing a real identifier (16.6%; 21.3% of those bearing an email address) have that exact identifier reproduced AND not reproduced under a mismatched-prefix control, so each leak is attributable to that document, not to a globally common string. This per-document disclosure is invisible to aggregate AUC and grows with capacity (5.6% to 16.6% from 410M to 6.9B). The risk is uneven: identifier leakage is ~3x stronger in code than prose, though prose stays clearly positive and also grows with capacity (4.0% to 12.1%), while recovery of arbitrary held-out continuations is confined to code (+0.44 member gap on GitHub vs at most +0.014 on prose). Temperature and nucleus sampling matter little, a 16-token prefix suffices, and we detect no reduction from corpus deduplication. Privacy audits should report per-document extraction, decomposed by domain, not a single AUC. We release leakit, a black-box extraction-audit tool.

</details>


### [330] [Response Magnitude as a Dominant Signal for Held-Out CRISPRi Perturbation Effect Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00152)
*Mehrdad Shoeibi,Niloofar Yousefi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本研究系统分析了CRISPRi扰动单细胞转录组预测中简单基线超越深度学习模型的现象。在VCC基准严格的目标基因划分下，发现目标（log Anderson-Darling距离）可由四个确定性标量函数高度预测，线性回归优于深度MLP编码器，随机森林结合输入与四标量则大幅超越深度模型。零样本跨细胞系迁移中，幅度预测器正向迁移而表达预测器为负；将幅度暴露给深度编码器可改善迁移但未超过四标量线性回归。论文进一步指出Anderson-Darling列衡量的是转录组响应广度而非靶基因效应强度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预测CRISPRi扰动对留出目标基因的转录组效应是单细胞生物学中的重要开放问题。近期的研究表明简单基线往往达到或超过深度预测模型，但对其背后的机制缺乏系统理解。作者旨在VCC基准下严格拆分目标基因，找出驱动这一差距的具体低维信号，并刻画其跨细胞类型的迁移特性。

Method: 在VCC基准下采用严格留出目标基因划分；识别出4个2,000维输入的确定性标量函数作为低维信号；对比深度MLP编码器、线性回归、随机森林及经典x-only模型；通过两个预先设定的控制实验区分行对齐效应与维度增加效应；在两个外部CRISPRi筛选上做零样本迁移测试，并将幅度信息暴露给深度编码器评估迁移改善。

Result: 四个幅度标量的线性回归超过最强的x-only经典模型；随机森林（输入+四个标量）大幅优于深度编码器；控制实验确认性能提升来自逐行对齐而非维度增加；零样本迁移中幅度预测器正向迁移，表达预测器为负或无法解析；对深度编码器暴露幅度可改善迁移但仍不及四标量线性回归；Anderson-Darling列衡量的是转录组响应广度而非靶基因效应强度。

Conclusion: 深度模型在CRISPRi转录组效应预测中的劣势源于其无法有效利用嵌入在输入中的低维幅度信号，而简单线性方法可直接捕获该信号。基于Anderson-Darling距离的评估指标本身衡量的是响应广度而非靶基因特异性效应，需要重新审视该基准的评价语义。

Abstract: Predicting the magnitude of a CRISPRi perturbation's transcriptomic effect on held-out target genes is an important open problem in single-cell biology. Recent work has documented that simple baselines often match or exceed deep perturbation predictors on related protocols. We study this phenomenon on the Virtual Cell Challenge (VCC) benchmark under a strict held-out target-gene split, identify the specific low-dimensional signal that drives the gap, and characterize how it transfers across cell types. The target is the log Anderson-Darling distance from non-targeting controls, which is strongly predictable from four deterministic scalar functions of the 2,000-dimensional input. A deep MLP encoder with direct access to the full input collapses toward the marginal training mean, and standard remedies do not close the gap. A linear regression on the four magnitude scalars alone exceeds the strongest x-only classical model, while a Random Forest on the input plus the four scalars substantially outperforms our deep proof-of-concept encoder. Two pre-specified controls attribute the magnitude gain to per-row alignment rather than added dimensionality. Under zero-shot transfer to two external CRISPRi screens evaluated against a target-gene endpoint rebuilt from single-cell data, magnitude-only predictors transfer positively whereas expression-only predictors are negative or unresolved. Exposing magnitude to the deep encoder improves transfer over its expression-only counterpart, yet the encoder does not outperform a four-scalar linear regression on the same features. We also find that the Anderson-Darling column distributed with these screens measures transcriptome-wide response breadth rather than target-gene effect strength, so evaluating transfer against it scores a different outcome.

</details>


### [331] [Inference-Time Policy Alignment for Fair Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00175)
*Umer Siddique,Peilang Li,Conor Wallace,Yongcan Cao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种推理时策略整形框架，在不更新基础策略参数的前提下，通过乘性调整动作概率来引导预训练深度强化学习策略实现基于福利的公平性目标，类似于大语言模型中的推理时对齐方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度强化学习智能体通过优化标量奖励函数获得强性能，但部署后策略往往僵化，难以适应新的性能标准（如公平性偏好）。现有公平性强化学习方法通常假设偏好预先已知，且需要基于公平性导向指标完全重新训练策略，成本高昂且不灵活。

Method: 将推理时公平性对齐形式化为策略整形问题，提出一种乘性策略整形框架，利用与动作相关联的福利分数调整动作概率，无需修改基础策略参数。该框架具有通用性，兼容任何深度强化学习智能体。

Result: 在多个领域的广泛实验中，推理时策略整形在显著改善基于福利的公平性目标的同时，保持了核心任务性能。

Conclusion: 推理时策略整形能够在无需重新训练基础策略的情况下有效实现福利导向的公平性，为深度强化学习策略的灵活适配提供了新的范式，灵感源自大语言模型的推理时对齐技术。

Abstract: Deep reinforcement learning (RL) agents achieve strong performance by optimizing scalar reward functions. However, once deployed, the policies of these RL agents are often rigid and costly to adapt to new performance criteria. For instance, an agent trained to maximize expected cumulative reward may not accommodate previously unknown stakeholder preferences. Existing approaches to achieve fairness, a type of preference, in RL typically assume that such preferences are known a priori and require complete retraining of the policy under a fairness-oriented metric. Inspired by inference-time alignment in large language models, we investigate the problem of steering a pretrained RL policy toward welfare-based fairness objectives at inference time without updating the base policy's parameters.
